table.name: Idle Air Adaptation Diagnosis - Result Limit (new)
table.description: Idle air adaptation diagnosis: limit beyond which an anomaly is reported; 255 = never.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation Diagnosis - Filter Factor (new)
table.description: Idle air adaptation diagnosis: filter factor.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation Diagnosis - Load Offset (new)
table.description: Idle air adaptation diagnosis: air flow offset added to the corrected value.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Accumulator Step (new)
table.description: Rate at which the integral term of the idle speed control approaches the adapted value.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Timer (Vehicle Moving) (new)
table.description: Delay armed when the vehicle is moving (exact effect not identified).

table.name: ISR - Derivative - Min. Time (new)
table.description: Minimum active time of the idle speed control derivative term after an engine speed drop below 'Intercept - RPM'.

table.name: Idle Speed - RPM Drop Threshold (new)
table.description: Engine speed drop, relative to the return-to-idle reference speed, beyond which 'Idle Speed - RPM Drop Hold Time (new)' is armed.

table.name: Idle Speed - RPM Rise Threshold (new)
table.description: Engine speed rise, relative to the return-to-idle reference speed, beyond which the second correction mode is activated. 0 in this file.

table.name: Idle Speed - RPM Drop Hold Time (new)
table.description: Delay armed after an engine speed drop larger than 'Idle Speed - RPM Drop Threshold (new)'.

table.name: Idle Speed - RPM Error Ramp Offset (new)
table.description: Offset added to the stored speed error to compute the idle exit threshold.

table.name: Idle Speed - RPM Error Integrator Min. (new)
table.description: Lower limit of the speed error integrator used on return to idle (0 = neutral).

table.name: Idle Speed - RPM Error Integrator Gain (new)
table.description: Gain of the speed error integrator used on return to idle.

table.name: Idle Speed - RPM Error Ramp Rate (new)
table.description: Slope of the speed error ramp when the filtered error is strongly negative.

table.name: Idle Speed - Target Rise Rate (new)
table.description: Maximum rise rate of the target idle speed (per calculation, every 10 ms).

table.name: Idle Speed - Voltage Interpolation Max. RPM (new)
table.description: Below this engine speed (engine running), a battery voltage dependent value is filtered and taken into account in the target idle speed calculation.

table.name: Idle Speed - Voltage Interpolation Rate (new)
table.description: Filter coefficient of the battery voltage dependent value used by the target idle speed (below 'Idle Speed - Voltage Interpolation Max. RPM (new)').

table.name: K-Line - Idle Speed Offset Max. (new)
table.description: Maximum idle offset accepted when the idle speed is adjusted with the diagnostic tester (K-line).

table.name: K-Line - Idle Speed Adjust Min. ECT (new)
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature to accept an idle speed adjustment with the tester (engine idling, automatic transmission not in gear).

table.name: K-Line - CO Adjust Min. ECT (new)
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature to accept a CO adjustment with the tester (vehicles without lambda control), at idle and with no stored fault.

table.name: IACV - AC Ramp Initial Value (new)
table.description: Start value of the ramp applying the A/C opening (see 'IACV - AC Compressor Ramp-in Rate (vs RPM) (new)').

table.name: IACV - Rate Limit Step (new)
table.description: Rate limiter of the idle valve target: maximum change step.

table.name: IACV - Rate Limit Deadband (new)
table.description: Rate limiter of the idle valve target: dead band.

table.name: IACV - Rate Limit Tolerance (new)
table.description: Rate limiter of the idle valve target: tolerance around the A/C pre-control.

table.name: IACV - Map Rise Step (new)
table.description: Maximum rise rate of the pre-control from 'IACV - TPS', per idle control calculation.

table.name: IACV - Map Fall Step (new)
table.description: Maximum fall rate of the pre-control from 'IACV - TPS', per idle control calculation.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Fuel Cut Offset (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heater: duty offset applied during overrun fuel cut.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Overrun Duty Step (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: change step towards 'O2 Sensor Heater - Overrun Duty (vs RPM) (new)' during overrun fuel cut.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Condensation Phase Factor (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: factor applied to the base duty cycle during the condensation phase.

table.name: Fuel - Injection Time Decrement Limit (new)
table.description: Maximum decrease of the injection time from one calculation to the next in some phases (limits sudden drops).

table.name: Rev Limiter - Catalyst Protection Fuel Factor (new)
table.description: Fuel factor applied during rev limiting for catalyst protection: applied fuel factor = 1 - this value (1 = full cut).

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limiter - Fuel Factor (new)
table.description: Fuel factor applied during vehicle speed limiting: applied fuel factor = 1 - this value.

table.name: Fuel - Minimum Injection Time (new)
table.description: Minimum injection time (before the injector dead time is added), during cranking and running.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Cranking - Initial Pulse Factor (new)
table.description: Factor applied to the first injection during cranking in a particular case (exact condition not identified).

table.name: Fuel Injection - Hot Restart ECT Margin (new)
table.description: Hot restart detection: if coolant temperature at start is higher than the temperature stored at shutdown minus this margin, the restart is considered hot (Hot Start Factor tables).

table.name: CH 2 - Fuel Correction (Acceleration) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: fuel correction applied on acceleration, multiplied by the VANOS position.

table.name: CH 2 - Fuel Correction (Warm-up) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: fuel correction applied during warm-up, multiplied by the VANOS position.

table.name: CH 2 - Fuel Correction Decay Step (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: decay step of the fuel correction.

table.name: Fuel - Overrun Exit Correction Step (new)
table.description: Rate at which the re-entry correction after a fuel cut ('Fuel Injection - Overrun Exit Correction A (vs ECT) (new)' to D) returns to 0, removed at each ignition.

table.name: Fuel - Overrun Exit Correction Step (Alt.) (new)
table.description: Like 'Fuel - Overrun Exit Correction Step (new)', in a particular re-entry case.

table.name: Fuel - Re-entry Correction Increment (new)
table.description: Fuel re-entry correction: increment per engine cycle during the fuel cut.

table.name: Fuel - Overrun Exit Correction Counter Init (new)
table.description: Number of steps of the re-entry correction after a fuel cut.

table.name: CH - Ignition Weight Decay Rate (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating: decay rate of the ignition weighting per engine cycle.

table.name: CH 2 - Ignition Weight Decay Rate (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: decay rate of the ignition weighting per engine cycle.

table.name: Spark Plug Cleaning - Factor Decrement (new)
table.description: Decrement step of the spark plug cleaning weighting factor.

table.name: Fuel - Correction Table ECT Threshold (new)
table.description: Coolant temperature below which 'Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Reduction Gradient (Low ECT)' is used instead of 'Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Reduction Gradient (Normal ECT)'.

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Max. Cycle Fraction (new)
table.description: Load increase enrichment: maximum remaining-session fraction for a re-trigger.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Ramp Down Rate (new)
table.description: Rate at which the applied advance decreases towards the target, in some phases (fuel cut). Value added to the applied advance at each ignition.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Ramp Up Rate (Load) (new)
table.description: Rate at which the applied advance increases towards the target, under load (above 'Ignition Timing - Ramp RPM Threshold (new)' or 'Ignition Timing - Ramp Load Threshold (new)'). Value added to the applied advance at each ignition.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Ramp Up Rate (Low Load) (new)
table.description: Rate at which the applied advance increases towards the target below 'Ignition Timing - Ramp Load Threshold (new)'; also used for the advance return after knock. Value added to the applied advance at each ignition.

table.name: Ignition Timing - ASC Retard Step (new)
table.description: Ignition retard step applied on an ASC torque reduction request, per ignition.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Ramp RPM Threshold (new)
table.description: Engine speed above which 'Ignition Timing - Ramp Up Rate (Load) (new)' is used.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Ramp Load Threshold (new)
table.description: Load below which 'Ignition Timing - Ramp Up Rate (Low Load) (new)' is used.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Ramp Bypass Enable (new)
table.description: Non-zero: in some phases, the applied advance takes the target directly without a ramp.

table.name: CH - Ignition Rate Limit (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating: ignition rate limit per engine cycle.

table.name: CH 3 - Ignition Rate Limit (Part Load) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 3: ignition rate limit at part load per engine cycle.

table.name: CH 3 - Min. Idle Time (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 3: minimum idle time before the coolant threshold 'CH 3 - Min. ECT (Lambda) (new)' / '(No Lambda)' is tested.

table.name: CH 3 - Min. ECT (Lambda) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 3: minimum coolant temperature (vehicles with lambda control).

table.name: CH 3 - Min. ECT (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 3: minimum coolant temperature (vehicles without lambda control).

table.name: CH 3 - Vehicle Speed Threshold (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 3: vehicle speed threshold; at or below it the idle time counter is reset.

table.name: CH 3 - Part Load Time Threshold (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 3: part-load time (below 'CH 3 - Part Load Max. RPM (new)' and 'CH 3 - Part Load Max. Load (new)') beyond which the heating correction is activated.

table.name: CH 3 - Part Load Time Max. (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 3: cap of the part-load time counter.

table.name: CH 3 - Part Load Max. RPM (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 3: maximum engine speed for the part-load time counter to advance.

table.name: CH 3 - Part Load Max. Load (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 3: maximum load for the part-load time counter to advance.

table.name: CH 2 - Max. Vehicle Speed (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: maximum vehicle speed.

table.name: CH 3 - Ignition Weight (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 3: ignition weighting factor.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Offset (TPS & Load Fault) (new)
table.description: Offset added to the base advance when both the throttle sensor and the load measurement are faulty.

table.name: Spark Plug Cleaning - Max. ECT (new)
table.description: Coolant temperature below which spark plug cleaning ('Spark Plug Cleaning - Ignition Timing (vs RPM/Load) (new)') is applied.

table.name: Spark Plug Cleaning - Min. ECT (new)
table.description: Coolant temperature above which spark plug cleaning is evaluated.

table.name: VANOS - Min. Load Offset (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Offset added to 'VANOS - Min. Load (Light Throttle) (AT)' / '(MT)' on vehicles without lambda control.

table.name: Ignition Dwell - Per Cylinder Step (new)
table.description: Rate at which the per-cylinder dwell factor returns to 1.0. 0 in this file: inactive.

table.name: Ignition Dwell - Maximum Factor (new)
table.description: Maximum per-cylinder dwell factor (1.0 = nominal dwell time).

table.name: Ignition Dwell - Cranking Init (new)
table.description: Internal initial value of the ignition feedback tracking during cranking.

table.name: Ignition Dwell - Feedback RPM Threshold (new)
table.description: Engine speed above which an internal flag of the dwell management is activated (exact effect not identified).

table.name: Ignition Current Diagnosis - Max. Value (new)
table.description: Maximum ignition current used by the per-cylinder ignition circuit diagnosis.

table.name: VSS Limiter - Time Base Divisor (new)
table.description: Calibration constant of the vehicle speed calculation used by the speed limiter (speed = 3600 / this value x sensor frequency). Only change it for another sensor or final drive ratio.

table.name: VSS Plausibility - Max. Count (new)
table.description: Vehicle speed sensor plausibility (DTC 214): number of checks with zero speed while engine speed and load are high before the fault is reported.

table.name: VSS Plausibility - Min. RPM (new)
table.description: Minimum engine speed for the vehicle speed sensor plausibility check (DTC 214).

table.name: VSS Plausibility - Min. Load (new)
table.description: Minimum load for the vehicle speed sensor plausibility check (DTC 214).

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limiter - Mode (new)
table.description: Speed limiter mode: 1 = mode with delay ('Vehicle Speed Limiter - Timer (new)'); 0 in this file.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limiter - Hysteresis (new)
table.description: Speed limiter exit hysteresis: the intervention stops below 'Vehicle Speed Limit' minus this value.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limiter - Timer (new)
table.description: Speed limiter delay.

table.name: Engine Speed Limiter - TPS & MAF Fault (new)
table.description: Engine speed limit when both the throttle sensor and the air flow meter are faulty.

table.name: Engine Speed Limiter - TPS Fault (new)
table.description: Engine speed limit when the throttle sensor is faulty.

table.name: Fuel Cut - RPM Gradient Threshold (new)
table.description: Engine speed drop (negative gradient) from which injection is forced back on during a deceleration fuel cut below 'Intercept - RPM', to avoid stalling.

table.name: Engine State - Idle Entry RPM (new)
table.description: Engine speed below which the engine enters the idle state. 0 in this file (not used).

table.name: Dashpot - Min. RPM (new)
table.description: Minimum engine speed for the dashpot.

table.name: Fuel Cut - Min. RPM (Diagnosis) (new)
table.description: Minimum engine speed for the overrun fuel cut diagnosis.

table.name: Engine State - Running RPM Threshold (Anti-Theft) (new)
table.description: Engine speed above which the engine is considered running for the anti-theft (immobiliser) logic, once EWS is validated.

table.name: Fuel Pump - Run-On After Last Crank Signal (new)
table.description: Fuel pump run time after the last crankshaft sensor signal (switches the pump off if the engine stalls).

table.name: Fuel Pump - Prime Time (Ignition On) (new)
table.description: Fuel pump prime time at ignition on; the pump is then switched off if the engine is not turning.

table.name: System - Main Relay After-Run Time (new)
table.description: Main relay hold time after the engine stops (6.0 s in the ID41; 300 s if the engine has not run). Ignition off is detected by the voltage drop on the battery input AN5 (after-run state); the ECU saves the EEPROM (adaptations, faults) then releases P3.0.

table.name: Spark Plug Cleaning - Duration (new)
table.description: Duration of the spark plug cleaning after reset. Unit: cycles (720 deg crank).

table.name: System - Coding Check Timer (new)
table.description: Time allowed for the EWS immobiliser check at ignition on (message 0x109 relayed by the satellite, before the starter acts); without a valid message within this time: DTC 18. 4.0 s in the ID41.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Adaptation Factor Init (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: initial value of the adaptation factor at start (1.0 = neutral).

table.name: VANOS - Enable Delay after Start (new)
table.description: Delay after the end of cranking before VANOS is allowed (5.0 s in the ID41): timer B+0x18 armed by EngineState_Machine; when it expires, SoftTimerB_Cb12 sets word_FD2E.6, without which the cam stays at rest. Canister purge is reset at the same place in the program.

table.name: IAT/ECT Diagnosis - Delay after Start (new)
table.description: Delay after start before the intake air / coolant temperature diagnosis is evaluated.

table.name: Hot Restart - Max. Time (new)
table.description: Maximum time after shutdown for a restart to be treated as a hot restart.

table.name: CH 2 - Max. Part Load Time (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: maximum part-load time.

table.name: ABS/ASC - Max. Duration P1.12 (Cut) (new)
table.description: Maximum duration of the ABS/ASC injection and ignition cut request (wire P1.12); beyond it: DTC 80.

table.name: ABS/ASC - Max. Duration P1.14 (Torque Reduction) (new)
table.description: Maximum duration of the ABS/ASC torque reduction request (wire P1.14); beyond it: DTC 82.

table.name: ABS/ASC - Max. Duration P1.13 (MSR) (new)
table.description: Maximum duration of the MSR request (engine drag torque control, wire P1.13); beyond it: DTC 81.

table.name: CAN DME4 - Temperature Display Hysteresis (new)
table.description: Hysteresis of the coolant temperature value sent to the gauge (CAN DME4): the stored value is updated when the temperature rises by more than this value.

table.name: Knock Adaptation - Max. ECT (new)
table.description: Maximum coolant temperature for the knock adaptation.

table.name: Knock Adaptation - Min. ECT (new)
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature for the knock adaptation.

table.name: Full Load Detection - Min. Vehicle Speed (new)
table.description: Minimum vehicle speed for full-load detection.

table.name: Full Load Detection - Min. ECT (new)
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature for full-load detection.

table.name: Load Filter - Coefficient (Intercept) (new)
table.description: Load filter coefficient on intercept (resumption after overrun fuel cut).

table.name: Load Filter - Coefficient (Idle) (new)
table.description: Load filter coefficient at idle.

table.name: Load Mode - Filter Coefficient (new)
table.description: Final filter coefficient of the engine load.

table.name: Knock - Dynamic Mode Factor (new)
table.description: Factor applied to the noise level deviation in transient mode.

table.name: Knock - Mode Enable (new)
table.description: 0 = blocks the learning of the knock retard in the speed/load zone.

table.name: Knock - Reference Upper Limit (new)
table.description: Maximum value of the per-cylinder noise reference level.

table.name: Knock - Reference Lower Limit (new)
table.description: Minimum value of the per-cylinder noise reference level; when the reference is at this limit the cylinder is flagged for the knock sensor diagnosis (above 'Knock Sensor Diagnosis - Minimum RPM (new)').

table.name: Knock - Reference Filter (Normal) (new)
table.description: Filter coefficient of the per-cylinder noise reference level in normal operation.

table.name: Knock - Reference Filter (Dynamic) (new)
table.description: Filter coefficient of the per-cylinder noise reference level in dynamic mode (engine speed gradient above 'Knock Detection - Dynamic Mode RPM Gradient (vs RPM) (new)', for 'Knock Detection - Dynamic Mode Duration (vs RPM) (new)') and during the tip-in duration.

table.name: Knock - Load Change Threshold (new)
table.description: Load change beyond which knock detection switches to transient mode.

table.name: Knock - RPM Change Threshold (new)
table.description: Engine speed change beyond which knock detection switches to transient mode.

table.name: Knock - Retard Step (new)
table.description: Transfer step of the knock retard to the adaptation cell on a cell change.

table.name: Knock - Idle Error Factor (new)
table.description: Internal factor compared with the idle speed error in the knock control (exact effect not identified).

table.name: Knock Sensor Diagnosis - Minimum RPM (new)
table.description: Engine speed above which the knock sensor diagnosis (DTC 57/59) is evaluated.

table.name: Knock - Gain Adaptation Upper Limit (new)
table.description: Upper limit of the knock signal gain adaptation.

table.name: Knock - Gain Adaptation Lower Limit (new)
table.description: Lower limit of the knock signal gain adaptation.

table.name: Knock - Gain Adaptation Rate (new)
table.description: Knock signal gain adaptation rate (targets a mean level normalised by 'Knock Detection - Reference Level Initial (vs RPM) (new)').

table.name: Knock - Offset Adaptation Delay (Up) (new)
table.description: Time before the adaptive knock offset is increased by one step. Unit: segments (120 deg crank).

table.name: Knock - Offset Adaptation Delay (Down) (new)
table.description: Time before the adaptive knock offset is decreased by one step. Unit: segments (120 deg crank).

table.name: Knock - Offset Adaptation Low Threshold (new)
table.description: Low deviation threshold to decrease the adaptive knock offset.

table.name: Knock - Offset Adaptation High Threshold (new)
table.description: High deviation threshold to increase the adaptive knock offset.

table.name: Adaptation Cells - EEPROM Save Offset (new)
table.description: Offset added to the adaptation cells before they are saved to EEPROM.

table.name: Engine Roughness - Filter Coefficient (new)
table.description: Misfire detection: filter coefficient of the per-cylinder speed irregularity.

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Max. Detections (new)
table.description: Number of detections from which the threshold 'Anti-Jerk - Detection Threshold (Next Oscillations) (new)' replaces the first-oscillation threshold.

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Retard Factor (2nd Oscillation) (new)
table.description: Factor applied to the retard 'Ignition Timing - Anti-Jerk (new)' on the 2nd oscillation (1 = full retard).

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Retard Factor (Next Oscillations) (new)
table.description: Factor applied to the retard 'Ignition Timing - Anti-Jerk (new)' from the 3rd oscillation (1 = full retard).

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Timer A (new)
table.description: Delay armed when anti-jerk triggers (exact effect not identified).

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Timer B (new)
table.description: Second delay armed when anti-jerk triggers (exact effect not identified).

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Hold Time (new)
table.description: If non-zero: hold delay armed during the anti-jerk intervention (exact effect not identified).

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Hold Time 2 (new)
table.description: If non-zero: second hold delay armed during the anti-jerk intervention (exact effect not identified).

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Minimum ECT (new)
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature to allow anti-jerk.

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Minimum RPM (new)
table.description: Minimum engine speed to allow anti-jerk (and no active sensor fault).

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Maximum RPM (new)
table.description: Maximum engine speed to allow anti-jerk.

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Minimum Vehicle Speed (new)
table.description: Minimum vehicle speed to allow anti-jerk.

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Maximum Vehicle Speed (new)
table.description: Maximum vehicle speed to allow anti-jerk.

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Gradient Source RPM (new)
table.description: Measurement switch-over speed: below it, the speed variation is measured over 120 crank degrees (one ignition), above it over 360 degrees (one revolution).

table.name: AC - WOT Cut-off Time (new)
table.description: A/C compressor cut-off time when going to full load (to free power). 4.0 s in the ID41; the compressor is re-engaged 0.5 to 1 s after returning to part load.

table.name: AC - WOT Cut-off Enable (new)
table.description: Option of the full-load compressor cut-off: non-zero = an additional internal flag is activated during the cut-off (exact effect not identified).

table.name: AC - Cut-off Time at Start (new)
table.description: Time during which the A/C compressor stays off after engine start.

table.name: AC - Timer (Exhaust Flap Reset) (new)
table.description: Delay armed during the full-load compressor cut-off, together with the exhaust flap reset (exact effect not identified).

table.name: AC - WOT Cut-off Max. Speed (Lambda) (new)
table.description: Vehicle speed below which the full-load compressor cut-off is allowed (vehicles with lambda control).

table.name: AC - WOT Cut-off Max. Speed (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Vehicle speed below which the full-load compressor cut-off is allowed (vehicles without lambda control).

table.name: VANOS - Immediate Release RPM (new)
table.description: Below this engine speed, the cam returns to rest as soon as VANOS is no longer requested; above it, the return waits for 'VANOS - Release Delay (new)'.

table.name: VANOS - RPM Hysteresis (new)
table.description: Engine speed hysteresis of the VANOS command.

table.name: VANOS - Release Delay (new)
table.description: VANOS release delay before the cam returns to rest, above 'VANOS - Immediate Release RPM (new)'.

table.name: VANOS - DTC 212 Delay (new)
table.description: Delay before DTC 212 is evaluated after each VANOS position change.

table.name: VANOS - Cam Tolerance (Learned) (new)
table.description: Tolerance added to 'VANOS - Rest Window (new)' once the cam rest position is learned. Value in crank degrees (half in camshaft degrees), measured relative to a reference tooth of the software, not to the absolute timing.

table.name: VANOS - Learning Convergence Threshold (new)
table.description: Deviation between the measured cam position and the learned rest position below which learning is considered finished. Value in crank degrees (half in camshaft degrees), measured relative to a reference tooth of the software, not to the absolute timing.

table.name: VANOS - Cam Tolerance (Not Learned) (new)
table.description: Tolerance added to 'VANOS - Rest Window (new)' while the rest position is not learned; also limits the learned value around 'VANOS - Cam Rest Position Default (new)'. Value in crank degrees (half in camshaft degrees), measured relative to a reference tooth of the software, not to the absolute timing.

table.name: VANOS - Rest Window (new)
table.description: Base half-width of the cam rest position window (before the tolerance is added). Value in crank degrees (half in camshaft degrees), measured relative to a reference tooth of the software, not to the absolute timing.

table.name: VANOS - Advanced Window Extra (new)
table.description: Extra half-width of the full-advance window relative to the rest window. Value in crank degrees (half in camshaft degrees), measured relative to a reference tooth of the software, not to the absolute timing.

table.name: VANOS - Cam Advance Travel (new)
table.description: Expected difference between the cam rest position and the full-advance position; used to compute the VANOS position (0 to 100 %) weighting the VANOS corrections of the maps. Value in crank degrees (half in camshaft degrees), measured relative to a reference tooth of the software, not to the absolute timing.

table.name: VANOS - Cam Rest Position Default (new)
table.description: Default cam rest position, after the adaptations are cleared. Value in crank degrees (half in camshaft degrees), measured relative to a reference tooth of the software, not to the absolute timing.

table.name: VANOS - Cam Rest Learning Filter (new)
table.description: Filter coefficient of the cam rest position learning.

table.name: Exhaust Flap - TPS Hysteresis (new)
table.description: Exhaust flap closing hysteresis: once open, the flap only closes again when the throttle angle falls below the 'Muffler Flap Solenoid' threshold minus this value.

table.name: Exhaust Flap - Minimum Vehicle Speed (new)
table.description: Vehicle speed below which the exhaust flap stays closed; above it, it opens according to the 'Muffler Flap Solenoid' throttle threshold. Also read by VANOS_Control_Update: below this speed, VANOS stays at rest (0 in the ID41: no effect).

table.name: Exhaust Flap - Delay After Start (new)
table.description: Time after start during which the exhaust flap stays open before being controlled normally.

table.name: CAN EGS1 - Idle Request Max. Duration (new)
table.description: Maximum time during which a non-zero request from the automatic transmission (byte 2 of message EGS1, taken into account at idle by the idle control and the ignition ramp) is accepted; beyond it, word_FD08.12 is set and the request is forced to 0. 3.0 s in the ID41.

table.name: Byte 4 - A/C and VANOS (new)

state.name: VANOS + A/C with wired inputs (0x26, stock)
No VANOS, A/C with wired inputs (0x06)
No VANOS, A/C with pressure sensor (0x10)

table.description: Air conditioning and VANOS configuration. VANOS: present when bits 5-7 = 001 (0x20). A/C: absent when bits 0-4 = 0. With bit 4 set, the A/C request and the A/C-on information are taken from the A/C pressure sensor (bits 0-3 ignored). With bit 4 = 0, they come from the two A/C inputs of the satellite: the compressor request (compressor control, cut at full load) and the A/C switch (idle speed raise, used only when bit 2 = 1 and bit 3 = 0). Bit 0 / bit 1 = 1: compressor request / A/C switch input taken as read; 0: input inverted. Stock 0x26: VANOS, wired A/C inputs, compressor request inverted, A/C switch used. Other combinations: see 'Byte 4 - A/C and VANOS - Bits (new)'.

table.name: Byte 4 - A/C and VANOS - Bits (new)

bit.name: Bit 0 - A/C compressor request input not inverted
Bit 1 - A/C switch input not inverted
Bit 2 - A/C switch input used for the idle speed (bit 3 = 0)
Bit 4 - A/C pressure sensor instead of the inputs
Bit 5 - VANOS present (bits 6-7 = 0)

table.description: Detail of coding byte 4. A/C present if any of bits 0-4 is set. Bits 3, 6 and 7 must stay at 0 (bit 3 = 1 disables the A/C switch input, bits 6-7 = 1 disable the VANOS).

table.name: Byte 5 - Transmission (new)
table.description: Gearbox type (bits 0-5): 0x00 manual, 0x2B automatic (EGS on CAN), 0x2C detection at power-up. Bit 6: propagation of the stored-fault state. Bit 7: knock control (keep set). CAN monitoring = bus-off monitoring and EGS message 0x43F monitoring (with their faults). It is on when the gearbox is coded automatic or auto-detection (Byte 5), or when Byte 6 bits 5-7 are not 0, or when Byte 7 bit 2 = 1. Stock: 0xAC.

table.name: Byte 5 - Options (new)

bit.name: Bit 6 - Propagation of the stored-fault state
Bit 7 - Knock control active

table.description: Bit 6: propagation of the stored-fault state. Bit 7: knock control active (keep set).

table.name: Byte 6 - CAN Monitoring / EWS Input (new)

bit.name: Bit 0 - EWS removed: external immobiliser input on the satellite (bit 1 = 0)
Bit 5 - CAN monitoring forced on

table.description: Bit 5 (bits 6-7 act the same, keep them at 0): CAN monitoring = bus-off monitoring and EGS message 0x43F monitoring (with their faults). It is on when the gearbox is coded automatic or auto-detection (Byte 5), or when Byte 6 bits 5-7 are not 0, or when Byte 7 bit 2 = 1. Bit 0 (with bit 1 = 0), used only when EWS is removed (Byte 8 bit 7): satellite input bit 2 (Sat_ACInputs_F13F) becomes an external immobiliser input; while it is active the engine is blocked as after an EWS refusal. Without this bit, EWS removed means no immobiliser at all. Bits 2-4: see 'Byte 6 - O2 Feedback'. Stock: 0x1C.

table.name: Byte 7 - ABS/ASC / Purge / CRC (new)

bit.name: Bit 0 - ABS/ASC interface by wires P1.12-P1.14 (bits 1-2 = 0)
Bit 2 - CAN monitoring on (no ABS/ASC wire interface)
Bit 3 - Canister purge active
Bit 4 - Calibration CRC check disabled

table.description: Bits 0-2: ABS/ASC (traction control) interface. 001 (bit 0 alone): torque reduction and MSR requests by the three wires P1.14, P1.13 and P1.12, with their duration faults. Any other non-zero value only enables the input states (reported over the K-line) and does not start the interface; bit 2 = 1 also switches CAN monitoring on. Bit 3: canister purge. Bit 4: no CRC check of the calibration regions (a modified calibration is then accepted without checksum correction). Bits 5-7: no effect. Stock: 0x09.

table.name: Byte 8 - OBD / EWS (new)

bit.name: Bit 2 - Idle valve diagnosis
Bit 3 - Exhaust flap (DTC 52)
Bit 7 - EWS removed

table.description: Bit 2: idle valve output diagnosis. Bit 3: exhaust flap. Bit 7: EWS removed (no ISN check). Other bits: no effect. Stock: 0x0F.

table.name: Checksum - Program Code Section (new)
table.description: Enables or disables the integrity check (CRC) of the flash memory. Disabled (0xFF): a wrong CRC is ignored (no fault 100). Stock (0x30): a wrong CRC triggers fault 100 (ECU self-test). Useful after changing the program code (e.g. 'MAF Mode - 2048 kg/hr (new)').

table.name: Checksum - Program Code CRC (new)
table.description: Expected CRC of the program area (the calibration is not covered). Value specific to each file, to recompute after any change of the program code (e.g. 'MAF Mode - 2048 kg/hr (new)') or of bytes 0x2066-0x2067 of the identity block, unless 'Checksum - Program Code Section (new)' = Disabled. Algorithm: reflected CRC-16, polynomial 0xA001, start value = bytes 0x2066-0x2067, over addresses 0x2100-0x36AD, 0x4000-0x5E7F and 0x20000-0x32815.

table.name: Checksum - Boot Sector CRC (new)
table.description: Expected CRC of the boot sector (addresses 0x0000-0x1C13; reflected CRC-16, polynomial 0xA001, start 0x4711). Value specific to the file. Sector 0x0000-0x1FFF is not rewritten by K-line programming: a change here only applies with a programmer, out of the vehicle.

table.name: MAF Mode - 2048 kg/hr (new)
table.description: Choice of the air flow meter scale: 1024 kg/h (stock) or 2048 kg/h (computed flow doubled, for a larger air flow meter). In 2048 mode, edit the curve with 'MAF (2048 kg/hr Mode) (EDIT) (new)'. This setting changes the program code: recompute 'Checksum - Program Code CRC (new)' or set 'Checksum - Program Code Section (new)' to Disabled. Procedure: open the 256 KB file, choose 2048 kg/hr, adjust the curve, correct the CRC, program, then read back the 24 KB.

table.name: MAF (2048 kg/hr Mode) (EDIT) (new)
0 to 5 Volts - Each row is ~0.3 Volts wide

table.description: Air flow meter curve (same bytes as 'MAF') shown with the 2048 kg/h mode scale. Use only if 'MAF Mode - 2048 kg/hr (new)' is set to 2048.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Trim per Cylinder (new)
table.description: Multiplicative factor of the effective injection time of each cylinder (Ext_Trim_InjCyl, 0xDC28-0xDC2D), in firing order 1-5-3-6-2-4: factor = 0.5 + x/256, 0x80 = 100 %. Stock ID41 value: 0x80 everywhere; some modified files have 0x64 on all six cylinders (-11 % effective time). Block 0x0050-0x0063 (CRC region no. 4, sum at 0x0064-0x0065), copied with its sum at every start into external RAM 0xDC20-0xDC35 (CopyBlock_ToFixedAddr_DC20); the area 0xDC20-0xDC36 can also be written over the K-line. Changing a value requires recomputing the region sum (checksum correction function of MS41 ECU Tool), otherwise code 100.

table.name: Knock Control - Retard Offset per Cylinder (new)
table.description: Signed offset added to the knock advance reduction of each cylinder (Ext_Trim_KnockCyl, 0xDC2E-0xDC33), firing order 1-5-3-6-2-4. Stock ID41: 0. Block 0x0050-0x0063 (CRC region no. 4, sum at 0x0064-0x0065), copied with its sum at every start into external RAM 0xDC20-0xDC35 (CopyBlock_ToFixedAddr_DC20); the area 0xDC20-0xDC36 can also be written over the K-line. Changing a value requires recomputing the region sum (checksum correction function of MS41 ECU Tool), otherwise code 100.

table.name: Injector - Dead Time Offset (new)
table.description: Signed adjustment of the injector dead time (Ext_Trim_InjDeadTime, 0xDC23). Stock ID41: 0. Block 0x0050-0x0063 (CRC region no. 4, sum at 0x0064-0x0065), copied with its sum at every start into external RAM 0xDC20-0xDC35 (CopyBlock_ToFixedAddr_DC20); the area 0xDC20-0xDC36 can also be written over the K-line. Changing a value requires recomputing the region sum (checksum correction function of MS41 ECU Tool), otherwise code 100.

table.name: IACV - Duty Offset (new)
table.description: Signed adjustment of the idle valve command (Ext_Trim_IACV, 0xDC24). Stock ID41: 0. Block 0x0050-0x0063 (CRC region no. 4, sum at 0x0064-0x0065), copied with its sum at every start into external RAM 0xDC20-0xDC35 (CopyBlock_ToFixedAddr_DC20); the area 0xDC20-0xDC36 can also be written over the K-line. Changing a value requires recomputing the region sum (checksum correction function of MS41 ECU Tool), otherwise code 100.

table.name: Byte 4
table.description: Raw value of coding byte 4 (stock 0x26 = 38). See 'Byte 4 - A/C and VANOS (new)'.

table.name: Byte 5
table.description: Raw value of coding byte 5 (stock 0xAC = 172). See 'Byte 5 - Transmission (new)'.

table.name: Byte 6 - O2 Feedback

state.name: Lambda control - 1 sensor, auto-detection + CAN monitoring (0x38)
Lambda control - 2 sensors, auto-detection + CAN monitoring (0x3C)
No lambda control (engine without catalyst) + CAN monitoring (0x24)

table.description: Lambda configuration (bits 2-4 of coding byte 6). Bit 5 set: CAN monitoring forced on (see 'Byte 6 - CAN Monitoring / EWS Input (new)').

table.name: Byte 7
table.description: Raw value of coding byte 7 (stock 0x09 = 9). See 'Byte 7 - ABS/ASC / Purge / CRC (new)'.

table.name: Byte 8
table.description: Raw value of coding byte 8 (stock 0x0F = 15). See 'Byte 8 - OBD / EWS (new)'.

table.name: CH - Duration - Idle Speed Target Increase
CH - Idle Speed Target Offset (new)
table.description: Fixed addition to the target idle speed during catalyst heating. Stock value: 20 rpm.

table.name: Closed Loop - Minimum Coolant Temperature - Idle
Closed Loop - Minimum Coolant Temperature - Above Idle
Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Deactivation Duration
Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Session Duration
Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Timer Initial Value
Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Initial Session Denominator
Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Reduction Gradient (Low ECT)
Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Reduction Gradient (Normal ECT)
Fuel Cut - RPM Hysteresis (below ECT Threshold)
Fuel Cut - Hysteresis Delay Counter (below ECT Threshold)
Fuel Enleanment - Decreasing TPS - Session Duration
Fuel Enleanment - Decreasing TPS - Deactivation Factor
Ignition Retard - Decreasing TPS - Step Size (ECT Compensation)
Ignition Retard - Decreasing TPS - Step Size
Detection - Fast Decreasing TPS - Min. Throttle Gradient
Detection - Fast Decreasing TPS - Min. RPM
Detection - Fast Decreasing TPS - Min. RPM Gradient
Detection - Fast Decreasing TPS - Min. Load
Detection - Fast Decreasing TPS - Min. Load Difference
Detection - Fast Decreasing TPS - Min. ECT
Ignition Timing - Base - ECT/IAT Compensation - Multiplicative
Ignition Timing - Base - ECT/IAT Compensation - Nominal
Nominal Idle Speed (A/T in Drive and A/C on)
table.description: Target idle speed (as a function of coolant temperature), automatic transmission in gear and A/C engaged (IdleSpeed_Target_Candidate_Drive_AC), computed in ECT_Dependent_Params_Update.

table.name: IACV - ECT (M/T or A/T in Neutral)
IACV - ECT (M/T or A/T in Neutral and AC on)
IACV - ECT (A/T in Drive and AC on)
ISR - Derivative - Engine Speed Gradient Threshold
ISR - Minimum Integral Limit (Vehicle Moving w/ AC on)
ISR - Maximum Integral Limit (Vehicle Moving w/ AC on)
ISR - Minimum Integral Limit (above Idle w/ AC on)
ISR - Maximum Integral Limit (above Idle w/ AC on)
Rapid Engine Speed Drop - Integral Additive
Minimum Mass Air Threshold for MAF Error
Maximum Mass Air Threshold for MAF Error
Knock Detection Threshold - Multiplicative Factor - Cylinder 6
Knock Detection Threshold - Multiplicative Factor - Cylinder 2
Knock Detection Threshold - Multiplicative Factor - Cylinder 4
Knock Detection Threshold - Multiplicative Factor - Cylinder 1
Knock Detection Threshold - Multiplicative Factor - Cylinder 5
Knock Detection Threshold - Multiplicative Factor - Cylinder 3
Engine Speed Limiter - IACV Fault (vs TPS) (new)
table.description: Maximum engine speed when an idle air actuator fault is detected, as a function of throttle angle. Stock: 1504 / 3488 / 6016 rpm at 1.4 / 5.2 / 30 deg throttle.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Max. Load (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Maximum air mass per stroke (as a function of engine speed) at which the idle air adaptation can learn. Learning also requires the idle valve opening to be between 'Idle Air Adaptation - Min. IACV Opening (new)' and 'Idle Air Adaptation - Max. IACV Opening (new)'.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Min. IACV Opening (new)
table.description: Minimum idle valve opening for the idle air adaptation to learn.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Max. IACV Opening (new)
table.description: Maximum idle valve opening for the idle air adaptation to learn.

table.name: TPS Substitute - Throttle Airflow vs RPM (TPS Fault) (new)
table.description: Substitute throttle angle when the throttle sensor is faulty, as a function of the air flow through the throttle (measured flow minus the idle valve share) and of engine speed. If the air flow meter is faulty too: 'TPS Substitute - Fixed Value (new)'.

table.name: Engine Roughness - ECT Factor (new)
table.description: Misfire detection from crankshaft speed irregularity: factor (1.0 = 128) applied to 'Engine Roughness - Reference (vs RPM/Load) (new)' as a function of coolant temperature.

table.name: Torque Model - Air Mass for Zero Torque (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Air mass per stroke corresponding to zero engine torque, as a function of engine speed; sent on the CAN bus in byte 5 of message DME1 (0x316) for the automatic transmission and ASC torque model. Above 'Torque Model - Max. Air Mass (new)', the byte is forced to 255.

table.name: Engine Roughness - Reference (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.description: Misfire detection: reference value used to normalise, cylinder by cylinder, the measured speed irregularity, as a function of engine speed and load. Multiplied by 'Engine Roughness - ECT Factor (new)'.

table.name: ECT Substitute - Temperature Rise Step (vs Airflow) (new)
table.description: Coolant temperature substitute model (coolant sensor fault): temperature increment added at each step, as a function of air flow; the substitute value is capped by 'ECT Substitute - Upper Limit (new)'.

table.name: CAN DME4 - Coolant Temperature Level (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Coolant temperature level (0 to 7) sent to the instrument cluster in CAN message DME4, as a function of coolant temperature. Read without interpolation. Overheating is signalled separately (see 'CAN DME4 - Overheat ECT Threshold (new)').

table.name: Ignition Feedback Diagnosis - Min. Spark Duration (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.description: Ignition coil diagnosis (DTC 1, 2, 3, 29, 30, 31): minimum spark burn duration expected from the ignition feedback signal of each cylinder, as a function of engine speed and load. Shorter = fault. Evaluated with a warm engine (above 'Ignition Feedback Diagnosis - Min. ECT (new)') and below 'Ignition Feedback Diagnosis - Max. RPM (new)'. Read without interpolation.

table.name: Multi-Spark - Dwell Time (vs Battery Voltage) (new)
table.description: Multiple sparks (cold start): coil recharge time between two sparks, as a function of battery voltage. Active below 'Multi-Spark - Max. ECT (new)' and below 'System - Max. Battery Voltage (Multi-Spark / O2 Heater) (new)'.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Dwell Time (new)
table.description: Ignition coil charge (dwell) time as a function of battery voltage; then corrected per cylinder from the ignition feedback (see 'Ignition Dwell - Target Ignition Current (vs RPM/Load) (new)').

table.name: Canister Purge Valve - Duty (vs Purge Level) (new)
table.description: Canister purge valve duty cycle as a function of the purge level requested by the control. Active only if purge is coded (Byte 7 bit 3).

table.name: Canister Purge Valve - Battery Voltage Correction (new)
table.description: Signed correction (128 = 0) added to the purge valve duty cycle as a function of battery voltage (engine running, valve commanded).

table.name: Ignition Dwell - Target Ignition Current (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.description: Target ignition current per cylinder (engine speed x load): when the measured current exceeds it, the dwell time of that cylinder is reduced by 'Ignition Dwell - Reduction Step (new)' (floor 'Ignition Dwell - Minimum Factor (new)'). Constant in this file.

table.name: Injection Timing - Angle (vs RPM/Injection Time) (new)
table.description: Start-of-injection angle (position of the injection event) as a function of engine speed and injection time (injection time + dead time), outside cranking. Internally 1 unit = 1 tooth = 6 crank degrees; the value is shown as the angle relative to the firing TDC (0 = 180 deg before).

table.name: Injection Timing - Angle (Cranking) (new)
table.description: Start-of-injection angle during cranking, as a function of engine speed and injection time. Internally 1 unit = 1 tooth = 6 crank degrees; the value is shown as the angle relative to the firing TDC (0 = 180 deg before).

table.name: Injection Timing - VANOS Correction (new)
table.description: Start-of-injection angle correction with VANOS active, multiplied by the VANOS position (full value with the cam fully advanced), as a function of engine speed and injection time (128 = 0).

table.name: Injection Timing - End Angle (Transient) (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: End-of-injection angle in transient operation at low engine speed, used below 'Injection Timing - End Angle Max. RPM (new)'; the value is clamped to 0..19 teeth, i.e. 330 to 444 crank degrees after TDC.

table.name: Torque Model - Torque Reduction (vs Normalized Retard) (new)
table.description: Torque model for the CAN bus: converts the applied ignition retard into a torque reduction factor, sent to the automatic transmission / ASC in message DME1. Inverse curve of 'Torque Model - Normalized Retard (vs Torque Reduction) (new)'.

table.name: Torque Model - Normalized Retard (vs Torque Reduction) (new)
table.description: Torque model: converts the torque reduction request of the automatic transmission (message EGS1) into an ignition retard factor. Inverse curve of 'Torque Model - Torque Reduction (vs Normalized Retard) (new)'.

table.name: Torque Model - Max. Reduction Factor (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.description: Torque model: maximum torque reduction factor obtainable by ignition retard, as a function of engine speed and load.

table.name: Torque Model - Latest Ignition Angle (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.description: Torque model: latest (most retarded) correction ignition angle allowed during a torque reduction, as a function of engine speed and load (128 = 0).

table.name: CH - IACV Adder at Idle (ECT vs Time) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating: opening added (or removed if negative) to the idle valve at idle, as a function of coolant temperature and time since the end of cranking; adds to 'CH - IACV - TPS (new)'.

table.name: CH - IACV - TPS (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating: idle valve base map (throttle angle x engine speed) used instead of 'IACV - TPS' while catalyst heating is active, with a progressive transition. Same internal scaling as 'IACV - TPS': 0.3906 % per step with a -20 % offset.

table.name: IACV - TPS (MSR Mode 1) (new)
table.description: Idle valve pre-control used when ABS/ASC requests MSR mode 1 (code 2): idle air is increased to limit engine braking (drive wheel slip). The program adds 0x1999 (20 %) to the shifted value, which cancels the -20 % offset of the normal map: 0.3906 % per step. Requires Byte 7 bits 0-2 = 001.

table.name: IACV - TPS (MSR Mode 2) (new)
table.description: Like 'IACV - TPS (MSR Mode 1) (new)', for MSR mode 2 (code 6).

table.name: IACV - Raised Idle Target Correction (vs RPM/Target Difference) (new)
table.description: Idle valve opening added when the target idle speed is raised, as a function of engine speed and of the difference between the raised target and the base target.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Enleanment Weight (No Lambda) (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Coolant temperature weighting of 'Fuel Injection - Enleanment (No Lambda) (new)' during warm-up.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Enleanment (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Enleanment (engine speed x load) removed from the fuel factor of each bank on the variant without catalyst / lambda control, weighted by 'Fuel Injection - Enleanment Weight (No Lambda) (vs ECT) (new)'. Not applied during full-load enrichment.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Anti-Jerk (new)
table.description: Anti-jerk function: ignition retard applied when a driveline oscillation is detected, as a function of engine speed and load. Multiplied by 'Anti-Jerk - Retard Factor (2nd Oscillation) (new)' on the 2nd oscillation then by 'Anti-Jerk - Retard Factor (Next Oscillations) (new)', and limited by 'Anti-Jerk - Retard Limit (vs RPM) (new)'.

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Retard Limit (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Maximum retard step applied by the anti-jerk function, as a function of engine speed (read without interpolation).

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Recovery Ramp Rate (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Speed at which the advance returns to the target after an anti-jerk intervention (degrees returned at each ignition), as a function of engine speed.

table.name: CH 2 - Ignition Weight (ECT vs Time) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: weighting of 'CH 2 - Ignition Timing (vs RPM/TPS) (new)', as a function of coolant temperature and of the time since the end of cranking.

table.name: CH 2 - Ignition Timing (vs RPM/TPS) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: ignition correction as a function of engine speed and throttle angle, weighted by 'CH 2 - Ignition Weight (ECT vs Time) (new)'.

table.name: CH - Ignition Timing (Idle) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating: ignition correction at idle, as a function of engine speed, weighted by 'CH - Ignition Weight (Idle) (ECT vs Time) (new)'.

table.name: CH - Ignition Weight (Idle) (ECT vs Time) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating: weighting of 'CH - Ignition Timing (Idle) (new)' as a function of coolant temperature and of the time since the end of cranking.

table.name: CH - Ignition Timing (Part Load) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating: ignition correction above idle (engine speed x load), weighted by 'CH - Ignition Weight (Part Load) (AT) (new)' or '(MT)'. Vehicles with lambda control.

table.name: CH - Ignition Timing (Part Load) (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Like 'CH - Ignition Timing (Part Load) (new)', for vehicles without lambda control.

table.name: CH - Ignition Weight (Part Load) (AT) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating: weighting of the above-idle ignition correction, as a function of coolant temperature and time since start; automatic transmission.

table.name: CH - Ignition Weight (Part Load) (MT) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating: weighting of the above-idle ignition correction, as a function of coolant temperature and time since start; manual gearbox.

table.name: Spark Plug Cleaning - Ignition Timing (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.description: Spark plug cleaning: ignition angle correction (engine speed x load) applied at part load when coolant temperature is between 'Spark Plug Cleaning - Min. ECT (new)' and 'Spark Plug Cleaning - Max. ECT (new)', during 'Spark Plug Cleaning - Duration (new)'. Constant (+3 deg) in this file.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Base - ECT/IAT Compensation - Nominal (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Like 'Ignition Timing - Base - ECT/IAT Compensation - Nominal', for vehicles without lambda control; weighted by 'Ignition Timing - Base - ECT/IAT Compensation - Multiplicative'.

table.name: CH - Duration - Idle Speed Target Increase (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Like 'CH - Duration - Idle Speed Target Increase', for vehicles without lambda control. Zero in this file.

table.name: CH - Duration - Ignition Retard (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Like 'CH - Duration - Ignition Retard', for vehicles without lambda control.

table.name: Injection Timing - ECT Correction (new)
table.description: Start-of-injection angle correction as a function of coolant temperature.

table.name: Air Mass - Initial Value at Start (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Air mass per stroke used as the initial value at start, as a function of coolant temperature.

table.name: Load Filter - Coefficient (vs RPM/Air Mass) (new)
table.description: Filter coefficient of the measured load while driving, as a function of engine speed and air mass: ~1 = no filtering, smaller = smoother but slower load.

table.name: Load Filter - Coefficient (Deceleration) (vs RPM/Air Mass) (new)
table.description: Like 'Load Filter - Coefficient (vs RPM/Air Mass) (new)', during a deceleration (overrun reduction).

table.name: Load Filter - Coefficient (Idle/Overrun) (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Filter coefficient of the load at idle and in overrun, as a function of engine speed (no filtering during cranking).

table.name: Ignition Timing - Re-entry Rate Limit (Idle) (vs RPM Gradient) (new)
table.description: Ignition rate limit on re-entry into idle after a fuel cut, as a function of the engine speed gradient.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Re-entry Rate Limit (Part Load) (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Ignition rate limit on re-entry into part load after a fuel cut, as a function of engine speed. Read without interpolation.

table.name: Detection - Tip-in for Knock Control (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Throttle opening speed threshold (as a function of engine speed) above which a fast opening is reported to the knock control, which then adapts its detection during 'Knock Control - Tip-in Duration (vs RPM) (new)'. Read without interpolation between engine speed points.

table.name: Knock Control - Tip-in Duration (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Duration during which the knock control treats the engine as transient after a fast throttle opening (see 'Detection - Tip-in for Knock Control (vs RPM) (new)'), as a function of engine speed. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment.

table.name: Detection - Fast Increasing TPS (new)
table.description: Throttle opening speed threshold (as a function of engine speed) above which the retard 'Ignition Retard - Fast Increasing TPS (new)' is applied.

table.name: Ignition Retard - Fast Increasing TPS (new)
table.description: Ignition correction applied on a fast throttle opening (negative value = retard), as a function of engine speed and load. Weighted by 'Ignition Retard - Fast Increasing TPS (IAT Compensation) (new)', applied during 'Ignition Retard - Fast Increasing TPS - Duration (new)' and limited by 'Ignition Timing - Re-entry Correction (Part Load) (vs RPM/ECT) (new)'. Read without interpolation.

table.name: Ignition Retard - Fast Increasing TPS (IAT Compensation) (new)
table.description: Weighting of the fast throttle opening retard according to intake air temperature: 1.0 = full retard, 0 = no retard.

table.name: Ignition Retard - Fast Increasing TPS - Duration (new)
table.description: Duration of the fast throttle opening retard, as a function of engine speed. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Re-entry Correction (Part Load) (vs RPM/ECT) (new)
table.description: Ignition correction on re-entry into part load after a fuel cut, as a function of engine speed and coolant temperature; also limits the advance during its progressive return to the target. Read without interpolation.

table.name: VANOS - Min. Load Hysteresis (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: VANOS switch-off hysteresis: load difference removed from the activation threshold, as a function of engine speed. Read without interpolation.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Overrun Exit Correction A (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Injection time added when injection resumes after an overrun fuel cut (intercept), as a function of coolant temperature; then progressively reduced to 0 (see 'Fuel - Overrun Exit Correction Step (new)'). Read without interpolation.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Overrun Exit Correction B (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Injection time added when injection resumes after a fuel cut caused by a throttle opening (re-entry, acceleration), as a function of coolant temperature; then progressively reduced to 0.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Overrun Exit Correction C (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Injection time added when injection resumes after a fuel cut, into part load, as a function of coolant temperature; then progressively reduced to 0.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Overrun Exit Correction D (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Injection time added when injection resumes after a fuel cut into idle/overrun (default variant), as a function of coolant temperature; then progressively reduced to 0.

table.name: CH - Duration - Fuel Enrichment (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Like 'CH - Duration - Fuel Enrichment', for vehicles without lambda control. Zero in this file.

table.name: VANOS - Lock ECT Threshold (vs IAT at Start) (new)
table.description: Coolant temperature below which VANOS stays locked, frozen at start as a function of intake air temperature. Read without interpolation.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Enable Delay (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Idle time before the idle air adaptation is enabled, as a function of engine speed.

table.name: ISR - Integral - Initial Value at Start (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Initial value of the idle speed control integral term at start, as a function of coolant temperature (0 = neutral).

table.name: Fuel Injection - After-Start Enrichment Decay (ECT at Start vs Cycles) (new)
table.description: Decay factor of the after-start enrichment, as a function of coolant temperature at start and of the number of cycles since start. At 0, the after-start enrichment is finished.

table.name: Fuel Injection - After-Start Enrichment (ECT vs IAT) (new)
table.description: Cold after-start enrichment factor (1.0 = 64), frozen at start according to coolant and intake air temperatures; then multiplied by 'Fuel Injection - After-Start Enrichment Decay (ECT at Start vs Cycles) (new)' and added to the fuel.

table.name: Fuel Injection - After-Start Enrichment - Hot Start Factor (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Factor applied to the after-start enrichment on a hot restart (see 'Fuel Injection - Hot Restart ECT Margin (new)').

table.name: Fuel Injection - Cranking - Hot Start Factor (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Factor applied to the quantities injected during cranking on a hot restart (see 'Fuel Injection - Hot Restart ECT Margin (new)'); factor 1 otherwise.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Cranking - Decay (vs ECT/Cranking Cycles) (new)
table.description: Factor applied to the injection time during cranking, as a function of coolant temperature and of the number of cycles since the start of cranking: progressively reduces injection if the engine is slow to start.

table.name: Ignition Timing - After-Start Overshoot Limit (vs RPM Error) (new)
table.description: Ignition limitation against engine speed overshoot after start, as a function of the speed error. Used in one of the two idle control modes; the other mode uses 'Ignition Timing - Idle - ISR Correction 2 (vs RPM Error) (new)'.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Cranking - ECT Correction (new)
table.description: Ignition correction added during cranking, as a function of coolant temperature (adds to 'Ignition Timing - Cranking').

table.name: Cranking - End RPM (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Engine speed above which the engine is considered started (end of the cranking state), as a function of coolant temperature.

table.name: CH 2 - Idle Speed Target Increase (M/T or Neutral) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: target idle speed increase, as a function of coolant temperature at start (manual gearbox or automatic not in gear); then reduced by 'CH 2 - Idle Speed Target Increase Decay (vs ECT) (new)'.

table.name: CH 2 - Idle Speed Target Increase (A/T in Drive) (new)
table.description: Like 'CH 2 - Idle Speed Target Increase (M/T or Neutral) (new)', automatic transmission in gear.

table.name: CH 2 - Idle Speed Target Increase Decay (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: decrease rate of the idle speed increase (removed at each calculation), as a function of coolant temperature.

table.name: Idle Speed Target - Tester Offset Weight (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Weighting, according to coolant temperature, of the idle offset set with the tester (K-line) added to the target.

table.name: Idle Speed Target - Floor (A/T in Drive) (new)
table.description: Minimum target idle speed applied when the vehicle is moving outside the idle state, automatic transmission in gear, as a function of the filtered battery voltage. Read without interpolation.

table.name: Idle Speed Target - Floor (M/T or Neutral) (new)
table.description: Minimum target idle speed applied when the vehicle is moving outside the idle state, manual gearbox or automatic not in gear, as a function of the filtered battery voltage. Read without interpolation.

table.name: IACV - Drive Engage Ramp Down (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Ramp-down limit of the idle valve opening when the automatic transmission is shifted into or out of drive, as a function of coolant temperature.

table.name: IACV - Drive Engage Ramp Up (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Ramp-up limit of the idle valve opening when the automatic transmission is shifted into or out of drive, as a function of coolant temperature.

table.name: IACV - Throttle Leakage Pre-control (vs IAT) (new)
table.description: Idle valve pre-control compensating the throttle leakage air, as a function of intake air temperature (128 = 0).

table.name: IACV / Air Mass - IAT Density Factor (new)
table.description: Intake air temperature (density) factor applied to the idle valve opening calculation and to the air mass plausibility check.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Start Value (vs IAT) (new)
table.description: Start value of the idle air adaptation as a function of intake air temperature. Constant (1.0) in this file.

table.name: IACV - AC Compressor Pre-control (vs AC Pressure/IAT) (new)
table.description: Extra idle valve opening when the A/C compressor is requested, as a function of the A/C circuit pressure level and of intake air temperature. Applied progressively (see 'IACV - AC Compressor Ramp-in Rate (vs RPM) (new)') and multiplied by 'IACV - AC Compressor Pre-control Scale (vs RPM/Load) (new)'. Vehicles with lambda control.

table.name: IACV - AC Compressor Pre-control (vs AC Pressure/IAT) (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Like 'IACV - AC Compressor Pre-control (vs AC Pressure/IAT) (new)', for vehicles without lambda control.

table.name: IACV - AC Compressor Pre-control Scale (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.description: Factor multiplying the idle valve opening added for the A/C, as a function of load and engine speed. Vehicles with lambda control.

table.name: IACV - AC Compressor Pre-control Scale (vs RPM/Load) (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Like 'IACV - AC Compressor Pre-control Scale (vs RPM/Load) (new)', for vehicles without lambda control.

table.name: IACV - AC Compressor Ramp-in Rate (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Rate at which the extra idle valve opening is applied when the A/C compressor engages (step added at each calculation), as a function of engine speed. Larger = faster opening. Ramp start: 'IACV - AC Ramp Initial Value (new)'.

table.name: IACV - AC Transient Adder (new)
table.description: Opening (or closing if negative) added briefly to the idle valve when the A/C compressor switches on or off, then progressively reduced to 0. As a function of engine speed. Applied as soon as A/C is requested, before the compressor engages (+2.3 to +6.6 % opening in the ID41).

table.name: AC Compressor - On Delay (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Delay between the A/C request and the compressor engagement, as a function of engine speed (gives the idle valve time to open). In the ID41: 360 ms at 800 rpm, 50 ms at 3600 rpm. When it expires, the relay cut order (bit 5 of 0xF141, message 0x104 to the satellite) is cleared and the compressor enable is signalled on CAN (DME1 byte 0 bit 6).

table.name: AC Compressor - Off Delay (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Delay between the end of the A/C request and the compressor switch-off, as a function of engine speed.

table.name: IACV - Tester Offset Pre-control (new)
table.description: Idle valve opening corresponding to the idle offset set with the tester, weighted by 'IACV - Tester Offset ECT Weight (new)'.

table.name: IACV - Tester Offset ECT Weight (new)
table.description: Weighting, according to coolant temperature, of 'IACV - Tester Offset Pre-control (new)'.

table.name: CH 2 - IACV for Speed Increase (M/T or Neutral) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: idle valve opening corresponding to the remaining idle speed increase ('CH 2 - Idle Speed Target Increase (M/T or Neutral) (new)'), as a function of coolant temperature; manual gearbox or automatic not in gear.

table.name: CH 2 - IACV for Speed Increase (A/T in Drive) (new)
table.description: Like 'CH 2 - IACV for Speed Increase (M/T or Neutral) (new)', automatic transmission in gear.

table.name: CH 2 - IACV for Ignition Retard (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: extra idle valve opening compensating the torque loss of the heating ignition retard, as a function of coolant temperature and of the ignition correction.

table.name: CH 2 - IACV for VANOS (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: idle valve opening added in proportion to the VANOS position; the displayed value is the contribution with the cam fully advanced.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Idle - ISR Correction (vs RPM Error) (new)
table.description: Idle fuel correction factor according to the speed error, in the second idle control mode (128 = no correction).

table.name: Ignition Timing - Idle - ISR Correction 2 (vs RPM Error) (new)
table.description: Idle ignition correction according to the speed error, in the second idle control mode; weighted by 'Ignition Timing - Idle - ISR Correction Weight (vs ECT) (new)'.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Idle - ISR Correction Weight (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Weighting of 'Ignition Timing - Idle - ISR Correction 2 (vs RPM Error) (new)' according to coolant temperature.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Intercept Advance (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Absolute ignition angle used on intercept (resumption of injection after an overrun fuel cut), as a function of coolant temperature. Same scale as the base ignition maps.

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Exit Threshold (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: End of the anti-jerk intervention: it stops when the crankshaft speed variation rises above this threshold. Value = relative change of the rotation period between two measurements (negative = engine accelerating), as a function of engine speed.

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Detection Threshold (First Oscillation) (new)
table.description: Detection of the first oscillation: anti-jerk acts when the relative change of the crankshaft rotation period falls below this threshold (negative = engine accelerating), as a function of load and engine speed. The closer to 0, the more sensitive the detection.

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Detection Threshold (Next Oscillations) (new)
table.description: Like 'Anti-Jerk - Detection Threshold (First Oscillation) (new)', for the following oscillations (see 'Anti-Jerk - Max. Detections (new)').

table.name: STFT - Neg I (new)
table.description: Lambda control: integral slope, lean -> rich direction, as a function of engine speed and load. Correction added every 20 ms: map value x 'Lambda PI - I Multiplier Bank 1 (new)' / 'Lambda PI - I Multiplier Bank 2 (new)' (both x/256), then x 'STFT - Overrun Slowdown Factor (vs ECT) (new)'.

table.name: STFT - Neg P (new)
table.description: Lambda control: proportional jump, lean -> rich direction, as a function of engine speed and load. Jump applied at each sensor switch: map value x 'Lambda PI - P Multiplier (new)' (both x/256), then x 'STFT - Overrun Slowdown Factor (vs ECT) (new)'.

table.name: STFT - Pos I (new)
table.description: Lambda control: integral slope, rich -> lean direction, as a function of engine speed and load. Correction added every 20 ms: map value x 'Lambda PI - I Multiplier Bank 1 (new)' / 'Lambda PI - I Multiplier Bank 2 (new)' (both x/256), then x 'STFT - Overrun Slowdown Factor (vs ECT) (new)'.

table.name: STFT - Pos P (new)
table.description: Lambda control: proportional jump, rich -> lean direction, as a function of engine speed and load. Jump applied at each sensor switch: map value x 'Lambda PI - P Multiplier (new)' (both x/256), then x 'STFT - Overrun Slowdown Factor (vs ECT) (new)'.

table.name: STFT - Overrun Slowdown Factor (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Factor slowing the lambda control in overrun, as a function of coolant temperature; maximum value (1.0) = no slowing.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Condensation Phase (vs ECT at Start) (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: duration of the condensation phase (reduced heating while there may be water in the exhaust), as a function of coolant temperature at start. Budget counted down by 'O2 Sensor Heater - Condensation Phase Decrement (vs Air Flow) (new)'; 0 = no condensation phase. Only with lambda control coded.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Condensation Phase Decrement (vs Air Flow) (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: amount removed every second from the condensation phase budget, as a function of air flow (more flow = exhaust dries faster). Budget used up: full power during 'O2 Sensor Heater - Full Power Time (new)'.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Base Duty (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: base duty cycle, as a function of engine speed and load, then multiplied by the heater adaptation factor.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Base Duty Ramp Up (vs Air Flow) (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: rate of increase of the duty cycle towards 'O2 Sensor Heater - Base Duty (vs RPM/Load) (new)', as a function of air flow.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Base Duty Ramp Down (vs Air Flow) (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: rate of decrease of the duty cycle towards 'O2 Sensor Heater - Base Duty (vs RPM/Load) (new)', as a function of air flow.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Overrun Duty (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: duty cycle targeted during overrun fuel cut, as a function of engine speed, reached in steps of 'O2 Sensor Heater - Overrun Duty Step (new)'.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Adaptation Step Bank 1 (vs Signal Center) (new)
table.description: Bank 1 O2 sensor heating: correction of the heating factor as a function of the deviation of the sensor signal centre from 'O2 Sensor Heater - Signal Center Reference (new)' (positive deviation = more heating, negative = less).

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Adaptation Step Bank 2 (vs Signal Center) (new)
table.description: Like 'O2 Sensor Heater - Adaptation Step Bank 1 (vs Signal Center) (new)', for the bank 2 sensor.

table.name: Max. Knock Retard (Lambda) (new)
table.description: Limp-home ignition angle of the knock control (engine speed x load), vehicles with lambda control; 'Max. Knock Retard' is only read without lambda control.

table.name: Knock Detection - Reference Level Initial (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Initial noise reference level of each cylinder when the knock control is reset, as a function of engine speed; also used to normalise the noise level.

table.name: Knock Sensor - Satellite Gain Factor (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Knock sensor signal gain factor, as a function of engine speed (multiplied by the adapted gain, capped at 255). The gain is sent to the satellite in message ASC1 0x101 at each TDC; the measured level is read back 48 deg later (message 0x102).

table.name: Knock Detection - Reference Offset (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Offset (knock addend) added to the noise reference level of each cylinder before comparison (0 = no offset). Read without interpolation.

table.name: Knock Detection - Dynamic Mode RPM Gradient (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Engine speed change above which knock detection switches to transient mode (faster filtering of the reference level), as a function of engine speed.

table.name: Knock Detection - Dynamic Mode Duration (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Duration of the transient mode of knock detection, as a function of engine speed. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment.

table.name: Knock Adaptation - Min. Load (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Minimum load for learning the per-cylinder knock retard, as a function of engine speed (outside transients and faults). Read without interpolation.

table.name: Canister Purge - HC Adaptation Step (vs Air Flow) (new)
table.description: Learning rate of the canister fuel vapour load (mixture correction due to purge), as a function of air flow (rate limit of the lambda controller preset value). Larger = faster learning.

table.name: Canister Purge - Purge Level Step Down (vs Air Flow) (new)
table.description: Rate of decrease of the purge level (share of the target removed every 100 ms), as a function of air flow.

table.name: Canister Purge - Purge Level Step Up (vs Air Flow) (new)
table.description: Rate of increase of the purge level (share of the target added every 100 ms), as a function of air flow.

table.name: Canister Purge - Flow Limit (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.description: Limit of the purge level according to engine speed and load (lambda controller preset value).

table.name: Canister Purge - Min. Load for Adaptation (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Minimum load for the purge adjustment, as a function of engine speed. Zero in this file.

table.name: Canister Purge - Max. Duty (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.description: Maximum purge valve pre-control duty cycle according to engine speed and load (100 % = valve fully open), reached progressively (see 'Canister Purge - Purge Level Step Up (vs Air Flow) (new)' and 'Canister Purge - Purge Level Step Down (vs Air Flow) (new)').

table.name: Canister Purge - Min. Duty (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.description: Minimum purge valve pre-control duty cycle according to engine speed and load (vehicles with lambda control).

table.name: Canister Purge - Min. Duty (vs RPM/Load) (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Minimum purge valve pre-control duty cycle according to engine speed and load (vehicles without lambda control).

table.name: TPS Substitute - Fixed Value (new)
table.description: Throttle angle imposed when both the throttle sensor and the air flow meter are faulty.

table.name: IACV - Max. Air Flow (new)
table.description: Maximum air flow of the idle air actuator: converts the idle valve opening into an air flow, removed from the measured flow to compute the substitute throttle angle.

table.name: Multi-Spark - Spark Off Time (new)
table.description: Multiple sparks: time between the end of a spark and the next coil recharge.

table.name: Multi-Spark - Max. ECT (new)
table.description: Multiple sparks are only active below this coolant temperature (also used as a limit of the start mode).

table.name: System - Max. Battery Voltage (Multi-Spark / O2 Heater) (new)
table.description: Battery over-voltage threshold: above it, multiple sparks are disabled and the O2 sensor heating goes to minimum.

table.name: Ignition Dwell - Reduction Step (new)
table.description: Decrease of the dwell factor of a cylinder when its ignition current feedback exceeds the threshold. 0 in this file: reduction inactive.

table.name: Ignition Dwell - Minimum Factor (new)
table.description: Minimum per-cylinder dwell factor (1.0 = nominal dwell time).

table.name: Torque Model - Max. Air Mass (new)
table.description: Maximum air mass of the torque model: above this value, byte 5 of message DME1 is forced to 255.

table.name: ECT Substitute - Upper Limit (new)
table.description: Upper limit of the substitute coolant temperature used when the coolant sensor is faulty.

table.name: Ignition Feedback Diagnosis - Min. ECT (new)
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature for evaluating the ignition coil diagnosis.

table.name: Ignition Feedback Diagnosis - Max. RPM (new)
table.description: The ignition coil diagnosis is only evaluated below this engine speed.

table.name: CAN DME4 - Overheat ECT Threshold (new)
table.description: Coolant temperature from which CAN message DME4 signals overheating to the instrument cluster.

table.name: IACV - Substitute Duty (Sensor Fault) (new)
table.description: Idle valve opening imposed on a sensor fault.

table.name: Injection Timing - End Angle Max. RPM (new)
table.description: Below this engine speed, the transient end-of-injection angle 'Injection Timing - End Angle (Transient) (vs RPM) (new)' is applied.

table.name: Additive Fuel Learning - Maximum RPM (new)
table.description: Maximum engine speed for learning the additive adaptation (idle / low load zone). Complements 'Additive Fuel Learning - Maximum Load'.

table.name: DTC 52 - Debounce Step (new)
table.description: Fault 52: exhaust flap output stage. Value added to the fault counter at each check where the anomaly is present (the counter decreases by 1 when it disappears). The fault is stored when the counter reaches 'DTC 52 - Confirmation Threshold (new)'. Larger = fault detected faster.

table.name: DTC 52 - Confirmation Threshold (new)
table.description: Fault 52: exhaust flap output stage. Value the fault counter must reach (increased by 'DTC 52 - Debounce Step (new)' at each check with the anomaly, decreased by 1 otherwise) for the fault to be stored. Larger = fault takes longer to appear (and to disappear).

table.name: DTC 215 - Debounce Step (new)
table.description: Fault 215: invalid code (4 or 7) received on the three ABS/ASC intervention wires (Byte 7 bits 0-2 = 001). Value added to the fault counter at each check where the anomaly is present (the counter decreases by 1 when it disappears). The fault is stored when the counter reaches 'DTC 215 - Confirmation Threshold (new)'. Larger = fault detected faster.

table.name: DTC 215 - Confirmation Threshold (new)
table.description: Fault 215: invalid code (4 or 7) received on the three ABS/ASC intervention wires (Byte 7 bits 0-2 = 001). Value the fault counter must reach (increased by 'DTC 215 - Debounce Step (new)' at each check with the anomaly, decreased by 1 otherwise) for the fault to be stored. Larger = fault takes longer to appear (and to disappear).

table.name: DTC 219 - Debounce Step (new)
table.description: Fault 219: CAN controller in bus-off. Value added to the fault counter at each check where the anomaly is present (the counter decreases by 1 when it disappears). The fault is stored when the counter reaches 'DTC 219 - Confirmation Threshold (new)'. Larger = fault detected faster. 0 in the ID41: the counter never increases and code 219 is not stored.

table.name: DTC 219 - Confirmation Threshold (new)
table.description: Fault 219: CAN controller in bus-off. Value the fault counter must reach (increased by 'DTC 219 - Debounce Step (new)' at each check with the anomaly, decreased by 1 otherwise) for the fault to be stored. Larger = fault takes longer to appear (and to disappear).
