table.description: Tank pressure gradient limit for the large leak (P0455); Mode 06 limit. Read by EVAP_LeakDiag_Step, OBD2_Mode06_FuelSystem_Results. IDA name: CAL_0072_EVAP_Leak_Test_Large_Leak_Limit_Mode_06. Tank pressure scale deduced from the sensor linearisation table 'EVAP P0451 Tank Pressure vs F5A8': 0.5 Pa per unit, 5000 = ambient (sensor range +/-3.75 kPa over 0.5-4.5 V).

table.name: EVAP Leak Test - Max Pressure Gradient (new)
table.description: Clamp of the tank pressure gradient. Read by EVAP_Test_Step_SmallLeak_P0442. IDA name: CAL_0074_EVAP_Leak_Test_Max_Pressure_Gradient. Tank pressure scale deduced from the sensor linearisation table 'EVAP P0451 Tank Pressure vs F5A8': 0.5 Pa per unit, 5000 = ambient (sensor range +/-3.75 kPa over 0.5-4.5 V).

table.name: EVAP Leak Test - Leak Limit (Mode 06) (new)
table.description: Tank pressure limit of the leak test; Mode 06 limit. Read by EVAP_LeakDiag_Step, OBD2_Mode06_FuelSystem_Results. IDA name: CAL_0076_EVAP_Leak_Test_Leak_Limit_Mode_06. Tank pressure scale deduced from the sensor linearisation table 'EVAP P0451 Tank Pressure vs F5A8': 0.5 Pa per unit, 5000 = ambient (sensor range +/-3.75 kPa over 0.5-4.5 V).

table.name: EVAP Valve Stuck Open (P0440) - Limit (Mode 06) (new)
table.description: Pressure change with valves closed above which the vent/purge valve is stuck open; Mode 06 limit. Read by EVAP_ValveStuckOpen_P0440_A, OBD2_Mode06_FuelSystem_Results. IDA name: CAL_0078_EVAP_Valve_Stuck_Open_P0440_Limit_Mode_06. Tank pressure scale deduced from the sensor linearisation table 'EVAP P0451 Tank Pressure vs F5A8': 0.5 Pa per unit, 5000 = ambient (sensor range +/-3.75 kPa over 0.5-4.5 V).

table.name: EVAP Leak Test - Max Min/Max Deviation (new)
table.description: Maximum spread of the tank pressure during the stabilisation phase. Read by EVAP_Test_Step_MinMaxTrack. IDA name: CAL_007A_EVAP_Leak_Test_Max_Min_Max_Deviation. Tank pressure scale deduced from the sensor linearisation table 'EVAP P0451 Tank Pressure vs F5A8': 0.5 Pa per unit, 5000 = ambient (sensor range +/-3.75 kPa over 0.5-4.5 V).

table.name: EVAP Leak Test - Deviation Limit A (new)
table.description: Deviation limit of the pressure trace, step A. Read by EVAP_Test_Step_A, EVAP_ValveStuckOpen_P0440_A, EVAP_ValveStuckOpen_P0440_B. IDA name: CAL_007C_EVAP_Leak_Test_Deviation_Limit_A. Tank pressure scale deduced from the sensor linearisation table 'EVAP P0451 Tank Pressure vs F5A8': 0.5 Pa per unit, 5000 = ambient (sensor range +/-3.75 kPa over 0.5-4.5 V).

table.name: EVAP Leak Test - Deviation Limit B (new)
table.description: Deviation limit of the pressure trace, leak step. Read by EVAP_LeakDiag_Step, EVAP_Test_Step_B, EVAP_Test_Step_C, EVAP_Test_Step_SmallLeak_P0442. IDA name: CAL_007E_EVAP_Leak_Test_Deviation_Limit_B. Tank pressure scale deduced from the sensor linearisation table 'EVAP P0451 Tank Pressure vs F5A8': 0.5 Pa per unit, 5000 = ambient (sensor range +/-3.75 kPa over 0.5-4.5 V).

table.name: EVAP Leak Test - Deviation Limit C (new)
table.description: Deviation limit of the pressure trace, step C. Read by EVAP_Test_Step_C, EVAP_Test_Step_SmallLeak_P0442. IDA name: CAL_0080_EVAP_Leak_Test_Deviation_Limit_C. Tank pressure scale deduced from the sensor linearisation table 'EVAP P0451 Tank Pressure vs F5A8': 0.5 Pa per unit, 5000 = ambient (sensor range +/-3.75 kPa over 0.5-4.5 V).

table.name: EVAP Shutoff Valve (P0446) - Pressure High Limit (new)
table.description: Upper limit of the tank pressure for the stuck-shut check. Read by EVAP_ShutoffValveStuckShut_P0446. IDA name: CAL_0082_EVAP_Shutoff_Valve_P0446_Pressure_High_Limit. Tank pressure scale deduced from the sensor linearisation table 'EVAP P0451 Tank Pressure vs F5A8': 0.5 Pa per unit, 5000 = ambient (sensor range +/-3.75 kPa over 0.5-4.5 V).

table.name: EVAP Shutoff Valve (P0446) - Pressure Low Limit (new)
table.description: Lower limit of the tank pressure for the stuck-shut check. Read by EVAP_ShutoffValveStuckShut_P0446. IDA name: CAL_0084_EVAP_Shutoff_Valve_P0446_Pressure_Low_Limit. Tank pressure scale deduced from the sensor linearisation table 'EVAP P0451 Tank Pressure vs F5A8': 0.5 Pa per unit, 5000 = ambient (sensor range +/-3.75 kPa over 0.5-4.5 V).

table.name: EVAP Leak Test - Small Leak Limit P0442 (Mode 06) (new)
table.description: Tank pressure gradient limit for the small leak (P0442); Mode 06 limit. Read by EVAP_Test_Step_SmallLeak_P0442, OBD2_Mode06_FuelSystem_Results. IDA name: CAL_0086_EVAP_Leak_Test_Small_Leak_Limit_P0442_Mode_06. Tank pressure scale deduced from the sensor linearisation table 'EVAP P0451 Tank Pressure vs F5A8': 0.5 Pa per unit, 5000 = ambient (sensor range +/-3.75 kPa over 0.5-4.5 V).

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Stability Window High (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Upper hysteresis value of the per-bank stability counter (FD10.1 cleared above). Read by O2Cat_Monitor_PerBank_Main. IDA name: CAL_0088_Catalyst_Monitor_Stability_Window_High.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Stability Window Low (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Lower hysteresis value of the per-bank stability counter (FD10.1 set below). Read by O2Cat_Monitor_PerBank_Main. IDA name: CAL_008A_Catalyst_Monitor_Stability_Window_Low.

table.name: Misfire - Inhibit Time after TPS Transient (new)
table.description: Misfire detection suspended for this time when the throttle gradient exceeds TPS Gradient Threshold vs TPS (10 ms timer). Read by Threshold_Crossing_Debounced_E8D0. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_008C_Misfire_Inhibit_Time_after_TPS_Transient.

table.name: Misfire - Segment Time Adaptation Max Deviation (new)
table.description: Maximum |segment time - adapted segment time| (crank timer units) accepted to update the crank segment adaptation (wheel tolerance learning). Read by Misfire_SegmentTime_Evaluate. IDA name: CAL_0090_Misfire_Segment_Time_Adaptation_Max_Deviation.

table.name: MAF/TPS Plausibility - Max Ratio (new)
table.description: Ratio measured air mass / throttle-model air mass above which the sample is implausible. Read by MAF_TPS_Plausibility_OBD. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_0092_MAF_TPS_Plausibility_Max_Ratio.

table.name: MAF/TPS Plausibility - Min Ratio (new)
table.description: Ratio below which the sample is implausible. Read by MAF_TPS_Plausibility_OBD. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_0094_MAF_TPS_Plausibility_Min_Ratio.

table.name: Misfire - Roughness Gain (new)
table.description: Gain applied to the positive roughness value (segment time difference) before filtering. Read by Misfire_SegmentTime_Evaluate. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_0096_Misfire_Roughness_Gain.

table.name: Misfire - Roughness Gain (Cylinder Masked) (new)
table.description: Gain applied to the roughness value when one or more cylinders are excluded from detection (Misfire_InhibitCylMask). Read by Misfire_SegmentTime_Evaluate. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_0098_Misfire_Roughness_Gain_Cylinder_Masked.

table.name: Fuel System Monitor - Max Adaptation Value (new)
table.description: Adaptation value must stay below this value (and the neutral value below the next one) to set FD10.2. Read by FuelSystem_Monitor_PerBank. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_009C_Fuel_System_Monitor_Max_Adaptation_Value.

table.name: Secondary Air - Bank 2 Monitor Enable (new)
table.description: 0 = secondary air monitored on bank 1 only; other value = per bank when 2 O2 sensors are coded. Read by SecondaryAir_Start_Init. IDA name: CAL_00A0_Secondary_Air_Bank_2_Monitor_Enable.

table.name: Fuel System Monitor - Lean Limit (new)
table.description: Mixture correction (lambda controller + adaptation) above which the bank is counted as lean. Read by FuelSystem_Monitor_PerBank. Unit: %. IDA name: CAL_00A2_Fuel_System_Monitor_Lean_Limit.

table.name: Fuel System Monitor - Rich Limit (new)
table.description: Mixture correction below which the bank is counted as rich. Read by FuelSystem_Monitor_PerBank. Unit: %. IDA name: CAL_00A4_Fuel_System_Monitor_Rich_Limit.

table.name: Misfire - Segment Adaptation Initial Value (new)
table.description: Initial / reset value of the crank segment adaptation (x24 internally). Also the clamp of the adapted value (x64). Loaded at boot, after K-line clear adaptations and at cycle end. Read by KLine_Cmd43_ClearAdaptations, Misfire_Monitor_CycleEnd_Reset, Misfire_SegAdapt_RestoreOnBoot, Misfire_SegmentTime_Evaluate. IDA name: CAL_00A8_Misfire_Segment_Adaptation_Initial_Value.

table.name: Purge Adaptation - Neutral Value Limit (new)
table.description: Limit of the neutral adaptation value selecting the learning rate. Read by AdaptiveCorrection_Learn. Unit: % (offset binary, 32768 = 0 %). IDA name: CAL_00AC_Purge_Adaptation_Neutral_Value_Limit.

table.name: Purge Adaptation - Max Deviation (Mode 06) (new)
table.description: Maximum |neutral adaptation value|; Mode 06 limit. Read by AdaptiveCorrection_Learn, OBD2_Mode06_FuelSystem_Results. Unit: %. IDA name: CAL_00AE_Purge_Adaptation_Max_Deviation_Mode_06.

table.name: Fuel System Monitor - Max Neutral Value (new)
table.description: Limit of the neutral adaptation value for the fuel system check. Read by FuelSystem_Monitor_PerBank. Unit: % (offset binary, 32768 = 0 %). IDA name: CAL_00B2_Fuel_System_Monitor_Max_Neutral_Value.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Max Lambda Integrator Deviation (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Maximum deviation of the lambda controller value from its filtered value for stable conditions. Read by O2Cat_Monitor_PerBank_Main. IDA name: CAL_00B4_Catalyst_Monitor_Max_Lambda_Integrator_Deviation. Maximum difference between the lambda correction (Lambda_B1_Correction_Mean / Lambda_B2_Correction_Mean) and its filtered value, same scale as 'Lambda Integrator - Minimum/Maximum Limit'.

table.name: Secondary Air Monitor - Max Lambda Controller Value (new)
table.description: Lambda controller value must stay below this value during air injection (lean shift expected). Read by SecondaryAir_Monitor_PerBank. Unit: % (offset binary, 32768 = 0 %). IDA name: CAL_00B8_Secondary_Air_Monitor_Max_Lambda_Controller_Value.

table.name: Secondary Air Monitor - Max Lambda Shift (new)
table.description: Maximum difference between the reference and the lambda controller value; above = fault detected. Read by SecondaryAir_Monitor_PerBank. Unit: %. IDA name: CAL_00BA_Secondary_Air_Monitor_Max_Lambda_Shift.

table.name: EVAP Leak Test - Pressure Build-up Limit (new)
table.description: Pressure rise above which the leak step is ended. Read by EVAP_LeakDiag_Step. IDA name: CAL_00C8_EVAP_Leak_Test_Pressure_Build_up_Limit. Compared with a difference of two purge adaptation cell values, not with the tank pressure.

table.name: Misfire - Inhibit Time after Load Transient (new)
table.description: Misfire detection suspended for this time when the load change exceeds Load Delta Threshold vs Load (10 ms timer). Read by RPM_Load_ModeSelect_Calc_A. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_00D2_Misfire_Inhibit_Time_after_Load_Transient.

table.name: Purge Test - Load Margin (new)
table.description: Test runs while the load stays above (snapshot - this value); Mode 06 limit. Read by EVAP_TankVentValveFunction_B, OBD2_Mode06_FuelSystem_Results. Unit: mg/stroke. IDA name: CAL_00D4_Purge_Test_Load_Margin.

table.name: Secondary Air Pump - Max Air Flow (new)
table.description: Pump is switched on only below this air flow. Read by SecondaryAir_Pump_Control. Unit: kg/h. IDA name: CAL_00D6_Secondary_Air_Pump_Max_Air_Flow.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Ratio Limit (Mode 06) (new)
table.description: Catalyst monitor result limit (rear/front O2 activity ratio). Fault when the result exceeds this value; also reported as Mode 06 limit. Read by Catalyst_Monitor_SwitchStateMachine, OBD2_Mode06_TestResult_A. IDA name: CAL_00E0_Catalyst_Monitor_Ratio_Limit_Mode_06.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - TPS Filter Constant (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Filter constant of the throttle position used for the steady-state check. Read by O2Cat_Monitor_PerBank_Main. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_00E2_Catalyst_Monitor_TPS_Filter_Constant.

table.name: Exhaust Temp. Model - Offset with Secondary Air (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Exhaust / Catalyst Temperature Model (new)
table.description: Offset added to the model rate while secondary air is active (0 = none). Read by O2Cat_Monitor_LoadThreshold. IDA name: CAL_00E4_Exhaust_Temp_Model_Offset_with_Secondary_Air. Filter rate (fraction per pass, 65536 = 1) used while secondary air is active.

table.name: Exhaust Temp. Model - Offset with Purge (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Exhaust / Catalyst Temperature Model (new)
table.description: Offset added to the model rate while canister purge is active (0 = none). Read by O2Cat_Monitor_LoadThreshold. IDA name: CAL_00E6_Exhaust_Temp_Model_Offset_with_Purge. Filter rate (fraction per pass, 65536 = 1) used while purging.

table.name: Misfire - Roughness Filter Constant (new)
table.description: First-order filter constant of the roughness value (higher = faster). Read by Misfire_SegmentTime_Evaluate. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_00E8_Misfire_Roughness_Filter_Constant.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Lambda Filter Constant (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Filter constant of the lambda controller value used for the steady-state check. Read by O2Cat_Monitor_PerBank_Main. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_00EA_Catalyst_Monitor_Lambda_Filter_Constant.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - RPM Filter Constant (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Filter constant of the engine speed used for the steady-state check. Read by O2Cat_Monitor_PerBank_Main. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_00EC_Catalyst_Monitor_RPM_Filter_Constant.

table.name: IACV - Duty Filter Constant (new)
table.description: Filter constant of the filtered IACV duty. Read by IACV_Duty_Sum_Output. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_00EE_IACV_Duty_Filter_Constant.

table.name: Idle Control - IACV Deviation Filter Constant (new)
table.description: Filter constant used by the IACV deviation check. Read by IdleControl_IACV_FilterDeviation. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_00F0_Idle_Control_IACV_Deviation_Filter_Constant.

table.name: Catalyst Temp. Model - Filter Constant (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Exhaust / Catalyst Temperature Model (new)
table.description: Filter constant of the catalyst temperature model towards Catalyst Temp. Model Target vs RPM/Load. Read by CatalystTemp_Model_Update. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_00F2_Catalyst_Temp_Model_Filter_Constant.

table.name: EVAP Tank Vent Test - Max RPM Drop (new)
table.description: Test aborted when the engine speed drops more than this value. Read by EVAP_TankVentValveFunction_A. Unit: rpm. IDA name: CAL_00F6_EVAP_Tank_Vent_Test_Max_RPM_Drop.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Max RPM Deviation (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Maximum |engine speed - filtered engine speed| for steady state. Read by O2Cat_Monitor_PerBank_Main. Unit: rpm. IDA name: CAL_0100_Catalyst_Monitor_Max_RPM_Deviation.

table.name: EVAP Tank Vent Test - Min RPM Rise (new)
table.description: Engine speed rise above which a test count is recorded. Read by EVAP_TankVentValveFunction_A. Unit: rpm. IDA name: CAL_0102_EVAP_Tank_Vent_Test_Min_RPM_Rise.

table.name: Speed Band 1 (below 60 km/h) - Factor (new)
table.description: Filter constant loaded into word_F568 (used as the fraction of Interpolate_ByFraction16 in Misfire_RingBuffer_Variance_Check) when the vehicle speed is in band 1 (bands switch at 60 and 120 km/h). Read by RevLimiter_VSS_StateMachine, SystemReinit_FullEngineSubsystems. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_010C_Speed_Band_1_below_60_km_h_Factor.

table.name: Speed Band 2 (60-120 km/h) - Factor (new)
table.description: Filter constant loaded into word_F568 in speed band 2. Read by RevLimiter_VSS_StateMachine. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_010E_Speed_Band_2_60_120_km_h_Factor.

table.name: Speed Band 3 (above 120 km/h) - Factor (new)
table.description: Filter constant loaded into word_F568 in speed band 3. Read by RevLimiter_VSS_StateMachine. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_0110_Speed_Band_3_above_120_km_h_Factor.

table.name: Misfire - Window Sum Threshold (Cylinder Cut) (new)
table.description: Sum of the weighted counts of the 6 cylinders above which the worst cylinder is cut (catalyst protection). Read by Misfire_Monitor_CountAndCylCut. IDA name: CAL_0112_Misfire_Window_Sum_Threshold_Cylinder_Cut.

table.name: Misfire - Total Events Threshold (Cylinder Cut) (new)
table.description: Total misfire events above which the worst cylinder is searched for injection cut-off. Read by Misfire_Monitor_CountAndCylCut. IDA name: CAL_0114_Misfire_Total_Events_Threshold_Cylinder_Cut.

table.name: Exhaust Temp. Model - Target during Fuel Cut (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Exhaust / Catalyst Temperature Model (new)
table.description: Target of the exhaust temperature model while cylinders are cut or the rev limiter is active. Read by O2Cat_Monitor_LoadThreshold. IDA name: CAL_013C_Exhaust_Temp_Model_Target_during_Fuel_Cut.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Exhaust Temp. Window High (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Upper limit of the exhaust temperature model for the catalyst monitor period window (0 = disabled). Read by O2Cat_Monitor_PeriodWindow. IDA name: CAL_013E_Catalyst_Monitor_Exhaust_Temp_Window_High. Compared with the 16-bit model value word_F58E (high byte = model value of the other 'Exhaust Temp. Model' items).

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Exhaust Temp. Window Low (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Lower limit of the exhaust temperature model for the catalyst monitor period window. Read by O2Cat_Monitor_PeriodWindow. IDA name: CAL_0140_Catalyst_Monitor_Exhaust_Temp_Window_Low. Compared with the 16-bit model value word_F58E (high byte = model value of the other 'Exhaust Temp. Model' items).

table.name: Pre-Cat Efficiency - Limit Bank 1 (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Fault limit of the pre-catalyst efficiency result, bank 1 (0 = disabled). Read by PreCat_Efficiency_Monitor_248_249. IDA name: CAL_0142_Pre_Cat_Efficiency_Limit_Bank_1.

table.name: Pre-Cat Efficiency - Limit Bank 2 (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Fault limit of the pre-catalyst efficiency result, bank 2 (0 = disabled). Read by PreCat_Efficiency_Monitor_248_249. IDA name: CAL_0144_Pre_Cat_Efficiency_Limit_Bank_2.

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Additive Factor (Secondary Air Inactive) (new)
table.description: Additive enrichment added to the fuel enrichment sum when the secondary air variant flag (GPIO_Variant_FlagByte bit 1) is not set; the sum + 1.0 (4096) is the fuel multiplication factor applied to the injection time (MulU16_Div4096). Read by Fuel_InjectionTime_Calc. Unit: factor (4096 = 1.0). IDA name: CAL_0150_Fuel_Enrichment_Additive_Factor_Secondary_Air_Inactive.

table.name: Misfire - Segment Adaptation Filter Constant (new)
table.description: Filter constant of the crank segment adaptation (wheel tolerance learning). Read by Misfire_Monitor_CycleEnd_Reset, Misfire_SegmentTime_Evaluate. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_015A_Misfire_Segment_Adaptation_Filter_Constant.

table.name: Misfire - Inhibit Time after Fuel Cut Exit (new)
Inhibit Time after Fuel Cut Exit
table.data: Inhibit Time after Fuel Cut Exit

table.description: Misfire detection suspended for this time at the end of a fuel cut / overrun phase (10 ms timer). Read by SoftTimerA_Cb10. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_015C_Misfire_Inhibit_Time_after_Fuel_Cut_Exit.

table.name: Speed Band 1 (below 60 km/h) - Count (new)
table.description: Value loaded into word_F56C when entering speed band 1. Read by RevLimiter_VSS_StateMachine, SystemReinit_FullEngineSubsystems. IDA name: CAL_015E_Speed_Band_1_below_60_km_h_Count.

table.name: Speed Band 2 (60-120 km/h) - Count (new)
table.description: Value loaded into word_F56C when entering speed band 2. Read by RevLimiter_VSS_StateMachine. IDA name: CAL_0160_Speed_Band_2_60_120_km_h_Count.

table.name: Speed Band 3 (above 120 km/h) - Count (new)
table.description: Value loaded into word_F56C when entering speed band 3. Read by RevLimiter_VSS_StateMachine. IDA name: CAL_0162_Speed_Band_3_above_120_km_h_Count.

table.name: Misfire - Inhibit Time after Engine Start (new)
table.description: Misfire detection suspended for this time after the engine reaches the running state (10 ms timer). Read by EngineState_Machine. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_0164_Misfire_Inhibit_Time_after_Engine_Start.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Max Period Counter (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Upper limit of the per-bank period counter (0 = no limit). Read by O2Cat_Monitor_PerBank_Main. IDA name: CAL_0168_Catalyst_Monitor_Max_Period_Counter.

table.name: Secondary Air Pump - Max Run Count (new)
table.description: Maximum value of the pump run counter. Read by SecondaryAir_Pump_Control. IDA name: CAL_02E6_Secondary_Air_Pump_Max_Run_Count.

table.name: Secondary Air - Min Number of Sequences (new)
table.description: Number of sequences / monitor samples required. Read by SecondaryAir_Monitor_PerBank, SoftTimerB_ID42_Cb13_SecondaryAir_SeqB. IDA name: CAL_02E9_Secondary_Air_Min_Number_of_Sequences.

table.name: Secondary Air Monitor - Fail Count Limit (new)
table.description: Number of failed checks for the fault evaluation. Read by SecondaryAir_Monitor_PerBank. IDA name: CAL_02EA_Secondary_Air_Monitor_Fail_Count_Limit.

table.name: IACV - Max Filtered Duty Deviation (new)
table.description: Clamp of IACV duty around its filtered value. Read by IACV_Duty_Sum_Output. Unit: %. IDA name: CAL_02F2_IACV_Max_Filtered_Duty_Deviation.

table.name: Idle Control - Max IACV Deviation (new)
table.description: Maximum |filtered duty - duty| for stable idle. Read by IdleControl_IACV_FilterDeviation. Unit: %. IDA name: CAL_02F3_Idle_Control_Max_IACV_Deviation.

table.name: IACV Target - Rate Limit Offset (new)
table.description: Offset (shifted by the rate limiter shift) subtracted from the target error. Read by IACV_Target_Calc. IDA name: CAL_02F8_IACV_Target_Rate_Limit_Offset.

table.name: Rear O2 Heater - Duty Step Up (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Duty increase step of the rear O2 heater ramp. Read by O2Heater_PostCat_Control_Diag. IDA name: CAL_02F9_Rear_O2_Heater_Duty_Step_Up.

table.name: Rear O2 Heater - Duty Step Down (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Duty decrease step of the rear O2 heater ramp. Read by O2Heater_PostCat_Control_Diag. IDA name: CAL_02FA_Rear_O2_Heater_Duty_Step_Down.

table.name: EVAP Diag - Purge Duty Ramp Down Step (new)
table.description: Purge duty ramp-down step during the diagnosis (x1/8). Read by EVAP_Diag_Sequencer. IDA name: CAL_030A_EVAP_Diag_Purge_Duty_Ramp_Down_Step. Step per pass of the purge level during the EVAP test (8 steps = 1 unit of the 0-255 purge level).

table.name: EVAP Leak Test - Purge Duty Step (new)
table.description: Purge duty increase per step of the leak test, added to the purge duty in 1/8 resolution (EVAP_Var_F5D0 = duty*8, limited to 7F8h); the first step only tests duty + step against EVAP Leak Test - Max Purge Duty in full byte units. Read by EVAP_LeakDiag_Step. Unit: %. IDA name: CAL_030B_EVAP_Leak_Test_Purge_Duty_Step.

table.name: EVAP Leak Test - Max Purge Duty (new)
table.description: Maximum purge duty during the leak test. Read by EVAP_LeakDiag_Step. Unit: %. IDA name: CAL_030C_EVAP_Leak_Test_Max_Purge_Duty.

table.name: EVAP Tank Vent Test A - Purge Duty Offset (new)
table.description: Added to the RPM/load purge duty during test A. Read by EVAP_TankVentValveFunction_A. Unit: %. IDA name: CAL_030D_EVAP_Tank_Vent_Test_A_Purge_Duty_Offset.

table.name: EVAP Tank Vent Test B - Purge Duty Offset (new)
table.description: Added to the RPM/load purge duty during test B. Read by EVAP_TankVentValveFunction_B. Unit: %. IDA name: CAL_030E_EVAP_Tank_Vent_Test_B_Purge_Duty_Offset.

table.name: Idle Control (P0505) - Max Purge Duty (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Idle Control Monitor P0505 (new)
table.description: Check active below this purge duty. Read by IdleControl_Monitor_P0505. Unit: %. IDA name: CAL_0310_Idle_Control_P0505_Max_Purge_Duty.

table.name: Exhaust Temp. Model - Init Value (Cold) (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Exhaust / Catalyst Temperature Model (new)
table.description: Initial value of the model at start when the start condition is not met. Read by LoadSnapshot_And_SecondaryTargets. IDA name: CAL_0311_Exhaust_Temp_Model_Init_Value_Cold.

table.name: Exhaust Temp. Model - Init Value (Warm) (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Exhaust / Catalyst Temperature Model (new)
table.description: Initial value of the model at start when FD12.5 is set (warm restart). Read by LoadSnapshot_And_SecondaryTargets. IDA name: CAL_0312_Exhaust_Temp_Model_Init_Value_Warm.

table.name: Exhaust Temp. Model - Hysteresis (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Exhaust / Catalyst Temperature Model (new)
table.description: Hysteresis of the Lambda Fld3F.4 threshold. Read by O2Cat_Monitor_LoadThreshold. IDA name: CAL_0313_Exhaust_Temp_Model_Hysteresis.

table.name: Exhaust Temp. Model - Threshold A High (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Exhaust / Catalyst Temperature Model (new)
table.description: Upper limit of window A (clears LambdaB*_Fld3F.4). Read by O2Cat_Monitor_LoadThreshold. IDA name: CAL_0314_Exhaust_Temp_Model_Threshold_A_High.

table.name: Exhaust Temp. Model - Threshold B High (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Exhaust / Catalyst Temperature Model (new)
table.description: Upper limit of window B (sets LambdaB*_Fld4E.2). Read by O2Cat_Monitor_LoadThreshold. IDA name: CAL_0315_Exhaust_Temp_Model_Threshold_B_High.

table.name: Exhaust Temp. Model - Threshold A Low (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Exhaust / Catalyst Temperature Model (new)
table.description: Lower limit of window A. Read by O2Cat_Monitor_LoadThreshold. IDA name: CAL_0316_Exhaust_Temp_Model_Threshold_A_Low.

table.name: Rear O2 Heater - Dew Point Exhaust Temp. (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Exhaust temperature model value above which the rear heater goes to full power (end of condensation phase). Read by O2Heater_PostCat_Control_Diag. IDA name: CAL_0317_Rear_O2_Heater_Dew_Point_Exhaust_Temp.

table.name: Exhaust Temp. Model - Threshold B Low (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Exhaust / Catalyst Temperature Model (new)
table.description: Lower limit of window B. Read by O2Cat_Monitor_LoadThreshold. IDA name: CAL_0318_Exhaust_Temp_Model_Threshold_B_Low.

table.name: ECT at Stop - Max Cooling for Restore (new)
table.description: If the coolant cooled less than this since engine stop, the stored values are restored (hot restart). Read by ECT_AtStop_RestoreAndCompare. Unit: °C. IDA name: CAL_032F_ECT_at_Stop_Max_Cooling_for_Restore.

table.name: Secondary Air - Max Coolant Temperature (new)
table.description: Secondary air is enabled below this coolant temperature. Read by ECT_Dependent_Params_Update. Unit: °C. IDA name: CAL_0335_Secondary_Air_Max_Coolant_Temperature.

table.name: Secondary Air - Min Coolant Temperature (new)
table.description: Secondary air is enabled above this coolant temperature. Read by ECT_Dependent_Params_Update. Unit: °C. IDA name: CAL_033A_Secondary_Air_Min_Coolant_Temperature.

table.name: EVAP / Purge Adaptation - Min Coolant Temperature (new)
table.description: Purge adaptation and EVAP purge tests run only above this coolant temperature. Read by AdaptiveCorrection_Learn, EVAP_PurgeFlow_EnableConditions. Unit: °C. IDA name: CAL_033B_EVAP_Purge_Adaptation_Min_Coolant_Temperature.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Min Coolant Temperature (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature for the catalyst monitor period window (also clears LambdaB*_Fld3F.6 above). Read by ECT_Dependent_Params_Update, O2Cat_Monitor_PeriodWindow. Unit: °C. IDA name: CAL_033C_Catalyst_Monitor_Min_Coolant_Temperature.

table.name: EVAP Leak Test - Step Time (new)
table.description: 100 ms timer. Read by EVAP_LeakDiag_Step. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_034A_EVAP_Leak_Test_Step_Time.

table.name: Speed Window - Max Vehicle Speed (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Upper limit of the vehicle speed window; inside the window LambdaB*_Fld3F.5 is cleared (monitor enable). Read by RevLimiter_VSS_StateMachine. Unit: km/h. IDA name: CAL_034D_Speed_Window_Max_Vehicle_Speed.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Max Vehicle Speed (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Maximum vehicle speed for the catalyst monitor period window (0 = condition never met). Read by O2Cat_Monitor_PeriodWindow. Unit: km/h. IDA name: CAL_0352_Catalyst_Monitor_Max_Vehicle_Speed.

table.name: Speed Window - Min Vehicle Speed (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Lower limit of the vehicle speed window. Read by RevLimiter_VSS_StateMachine. Unit: km/h. IDA name: CAL_0354_Speed_Window_Min_Vehicle_Speed.

table.name: Speed Band - Time Base Divisor (new)
table.description: Divisor of the vehicle speed time base (word_F564). Read by RevLimiter_VSS_StateMachine. IDA name: CAL_0355_Speed_Band_Time_Base_Divisor.

table.name: EVAP Valve Stuck Open (P0440) - Test Time (new)
table.description: 100 ms timer; also divisor of the small leak gradient. Read by EVAP_Test_Step_SmallLeak_P0442, EVAP_ValveStuckOpen_P0440_A. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_0359_EVAP_Valve_Stuck_Open_P0440_Test_Time.

table.name: EVAP Leak Test - Step B Time (new)
table.description: 100 ms timer; also multiplier of the small leak gradient. Read by EVAP_Test_Step_B, EVAP_Test_Step_SmallLeak_P0442. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_035A_EVAP_Leak_Test_Step_B_Time.

table.name: EVAP Leak Test - Stabilisation Time (new)
table.description: 100 ms timer. Read by EVAP_Test_Step_MinMaxTrack. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_035B_EVAP_Leak_Test_Stabilisation_Time.

table.name: EVAP Diag - K-line Forced Test Time (new)
table.description: Duration of the test started by K-line command 0x22 (100 ms timer). Read by KLine_Cmd22_Misc. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_0362_EVAP_Diag_K_line_Forced_Test_Time.

table.name: Engine State - Lambda Fld74 Window Low (new)
table.description: Lower limit (0 = disabled). Read by EngineState_Machine. IDA name: CAL_0367_Engine_State_Lambda_Fld74_Window_Low.

table.name: EVAP Leak Test - Pressure Build-up Time (new)
table.description: 100 ms timer. Read by EVAP_LeakDiag_Step. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_0368_EVAP_Leak_Test_Pressure_Build_up_Time.

table.name: Engine State - Lambda Fld74 Window High (new)
table.description: Upper limit (0 = disabled). Read by EngineState_Machine. IDA name: CAL_036E_Engine_State_Lambda_Fld74_Window_High.

table.name: Catalyst Temp. Model - Max ECT at Start for Init (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Exhaust / Catalyst Temperature Model (new)

table.name: Max ECT at Start for Init
table.data: Max ECT at Start for Init

table.description: Below this coolant temperature at start, the catalyst temperature model is initialised from the coolant temperature at start; otherwise it is initialised with this value. Read by LoadSnapshot_And_SecondaryTargets. Unit: °C. IDA name: CAL_0371_Catalyst_Temp_Model_Max_ECT_at_Start_for_Init.

table.name: EVAP Tank Vent Test - Init Value F5C6 (new)
table.description: Initial value of EVAP_Var_F5C6. Read by EVAP_TankVentValveFunction_A. IDA name: CAL_0372_EVAP_Tank_Vent_Test_Init_Value_F5C6.

table.name: EVAP Tank Vent Test B - Time (new)
table.description: 100 ms timer. Read by EVAP_TankVentValveFunction_B. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_0373_EVAP_Tank_Vent_Test_B_Time.

table.name: EVAP Tank Vent Test A - Time (new)
table.description: 100 ms timer. Read by EVAP_TankVentValveFunction_A. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_0374_EVAP_Tank_Vent_Test_A_Time.

table.name: ECT Plausibility - Sample Count (new)
table.description: Number of samples before the plausibility decision. Read by CoolantTemp_ECT_PlausibilityCheck. IDA name: CAL_0375_ECT_Plausibility_Sample_Count.

table.name: ECT Plausibility - Enable (new)
table.description: 0 = plausibility flag not set by this check. Read by CoolantTemp_ECT_PlausibilityCheck. IDA name: CAL_0376_ECT_Plausibility_Enable.

table.name: ECT Plausibility - Confirmation Count (new)
table.description: Number of confirmations before the result is final. Read by CoolantTemp_ECT_PlausibilityCheck. IDA name: CAL_0377_ECT_Plausibility_Confirmation_Count.

table.name: EVAP Diag - Pause Time between Steps (new)
table.description: 100 ms timer. Read by AdaptiveCorrection_Learn, EVAP_TankVentValveFunction_A, EVAP_TankVentValveFunction_B. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_0379_EVAP_Diag_Pause_Time_between_Steps.

table.name: O2 Sensor - Ready Delay (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Countdown loaded at start / reset before the O2 sensor is considered ready. Read by BackgroundTask_Scheduler, LoadSnapshot_And_SecondaryTargets, MasterSystemState_Reset, O2Cat_Monitor_EnableConditions. IDA name: CAL_037B_O2_Sensor_Ready_Delay.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Rear O2 Rich Threshold (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Rear O2 sensor signal below which the sensor is considered rich (switch counter); the O2 signal is inverted by the input stage (rich = low value). Read by Catalyst_Monitor_SwitchStateMachine and O2Cat_Monitor_PerBank_Main. Unit: V at the CPU input (x*5/256). IDA name: CAL_0383_Catalyst_Monitor_Rear_O2_Rich_Threshold.

table.name: O2 Sensor Switching (P1178/P1179) - Hysteresis (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Voltage hysteresis added to the switching threshold. Read by O2Sensor_Switching_PreCat_P1178_P1179. Unit: V. IDA name: CAL_0385_O2_Sensor_Switching_P1178_P1179_Hysteresis.

table.name: Rear O2 Sensor Circuit - High Voltage Limit (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Rear O2 sensor voltage above which the circuit high fault is detected. Read by O2Sensor_PostCat_Circuit_Diag. Unit: V. IDA name: CAL_0389_Rear_O2_Sensor_Circuit_High_Voltage_Limit.

table.name: Rear O2 Sensor Circuit - Low Voltage Limit (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Rear O2 sensor voltage below which the circuit low test is done. Read by O2Sensor_PostCat_Circuit_Diag. Unit: V. IDA name: CAL_038A_Rear_O2_Sensor_Circuit_Low_Voltage_Limit.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Rear O2 Lean Threshold (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Rear O2 sensor signal above which the sensor is considered lean (switch counter); the O2 signal is inverted by the input stage (lean = high value). Read by Catalyst_Monitor_SwitchStateMachine and O2Cat_Monitor_PerBank_Main. IDA name: CAL_038B_Catalyst_Monitor_Rear_O2_Lean_Threshold.

table.name: Rear O2 Heater - Voltage Reference (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Reference voltage; (reference - sensor voltage)/2 is the input of O2 Heater Post-Cat Duty vs Delta. Read by O2Heater_PostCat_Control_Diag. Unit: V. IDA name: CAL_0391_Rear_O2_Heater_Voltage_Reference.

table.name: Rear O2 Heater Monitor - Max Sensor Voltage (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Sensor voltage must be below this value to run the heater check. Read by O2Cat_Monitor_EnableConditions. Unit: V. IDA name: CAL_0392_Rear_O2_Heater_Monitor_Max_Sensor_Voltage.

table.name: Rear O2 Heater Monitor - Min Sensor Voltage (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Sensor voltage must be above this value to run the heater check. Read by O2Cat_Monitor_EnableConditions. Unit: V. IDA name: CAL_0393_Rear_O2_Heater_Monitor_Min_Sensor_Voltage.

table.name: Catalyst Efficiency (225/226) - Index High Limit (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Catalyst efficiency index above which fault 225 is reported (0 = disabled). Read by CatalystEfficiency_Diag_225_226. IDA name: CAL_0395_Catalyst_Efficiency_225_226_Index_High_Limit.

table.name: Catalyst Efficiency (225/226) - Index Low Limit (new)
table.category: ID42 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Catalyst efficiency index below which fault 226 is reported (0 = disabled). Read by CatalystEfficiency_Diag_225_226. IDA name: CAL_0396_Catalyst_Efficiency_225_226_Index_Low_Limit.

table.name: Ignition Timing Ramp - Rate (new)
table.description: Ignition timing decrease threshold: when the previous ramped timing (IgnTiming_Ramped) exceeds the new idle-corrected timing by more than this value, the misfire inhibit counter byte_F4DE is raised to Ignition Timing Ramp Misfire Inhibit Count (CAL_03CD). Read by IgnTiming_Ramp_And_TorqueModel. Unit: °CRK. IDA name: CAL_03A1_Ignition_Timing_Ramp_Rate.

table.name: Ignition Timing Ramp - Misfire Inhibit Count (new)
table.description: Minimum value loaded into the misfire inhibit counter when the timing jump is large. Read by IgnTiming_Ramp_And_TorqueModel. IDA name: CAL_03AC_Ignition_Timing_Ramp_Misfire_Inhibit_Count.

table.name: Byte 4
table.description: Raw value of coding byte 4 (stock 0x26 = 38). See 'Byte 4 - A/C and VANOS (new)'.

table.name: Byte 5
table.description: Raw value of coding byte 5 (stock 0xEC = 236). See 'Byte 5 - Transmission (new)'.

table.name: Byte 6 - O2 Feedback
table.description: Lambda configuration (bits 2-4 of coding byte 6). Lambda control is always active, there are no '(No Lambda)' maps and no auto-detection. 0x0C (stock): O2Sensor_Count = 1; 0x14 or any other value: O2Sensor_Count = 2. Bit 5 set: CAN monitoring forced on (see 'Byte 6 - CAN Monitoring / EWS Input (new)').

table.name: Byte 7
table.description: Raw value of coding byte 7 (stock 0x09 = 9). See 'Byte 7 - ABS/ASC / Purge / CRC (new)'.

table.name: Byte 8
table.description: Raw value of coding byte 8 (stock 0x1E = 30). See 'Byte 8 - OBD / EWS (new)'.

table.name: CH - Duration - Idle Speed Target Increase
table.description: Catalyst heating (CH): function active after a cold start. Time after start, as a function of coolant temperature at start, during which the target idle speed is raised (LoadSnapshot_And_SecondaryTargets).

table.name: CH - Idle Speed Target Offset (new)
table.description: Fixed addition to the target idle speed during catalyst heating. Stock value: 20 rpm.

table.name: CH - Duration - Ignition Retard
table.description: Catalyst heating (CH): function active after a cold start. Time after start of the heating ignition retard. Setting it to zero also removes the heating enrichment (LoadSnapshot_And_SecondaryTargets).

table.name: CH - Duration - Fuel Enrichment
table.description: Catalyst heating (CH): function active after a cold start. Time after start of the heating enrichment (LoadSnapshot_And_SecondaryTargets).

table.name: CH - Fuel Enrichment - Multiplicative (Idle)
table.description: Catalyst heating (CH): function active after a cold start. Factor (1.0 = 128) applied to 'CH - Fuel Enrichment - Nominal' at idle; the result, plus 'CH - Fuel Enrichment - Additive', gives the heating enrichment factor.

table.name: CH - Fuel Enrichment - Multiplicative (above Idle)
table.description: Catalyst heating (CH): function active after a cold start. Factor (1.0 = 128) applied to 'CH - Fuel Enrichment - Nominal' above idle; the result, plus 'CH - Fuel Enrichment - Additive', gives the heating enrichment factor.

table.name: CH - Fuel Enrichment - Nominal
table.description: Catalyst heating (CH): function active after a cold start. Base injection time correction factor (engine speed x load, RPM_Load_ScaledCorrection_Calc), multiplied by one of the 'Multiplicative' tables then increased by 'Additive'.

table.name: CH - Fuel Enrichment - Additive
table.description: Catalyst heating (CH): function active after a cold start. Catalyst heating base factor (0.5 to 1.5) combined with the multiplied nominal enrichment, as a function of coolant temperature and time after start.

table.name: COP - Fuel Enrichment - Nominal
table.description: Catalyst overheating protection (COP): high-load enrichment when ignition advance is reduced. Base correction factor (engine speed x load), added to 'COP - Fuel Enrichment - Additive'. The result cannot be negative: all zeros removes the protection (only without a catalyst).

table.name: COP - Fuel Enrichment - Additive
table.description: Catalyst overheating protection (COP): high-load enrichment when ignition advance is reduced. Signed factor (128 = 0) added to the nominal enrichment, as a function of the ignition correction. Cannot make the total negative.

table.name: COP - Fuel Enrichment - Step Size
table.description: Catalyst overheating protection (COP): high-load enrichment when ignition advance is reduced. Maximum change of the COP enrichment per calculation, up or down, to avoid mixture steps.

table.name: COP - Minimum Load
table.description: Catalyst overheating protection (COP): high-load enrichment when ignition advance is reduced. Minimum load (as a function of engine speed and ignition correction) to activate the protection. At maximum: protection disabled.

table.name: COP - Minimum Load Hystersis
table.description: Catalyst overheating protection (COP): high-load enrichment when ignition advance is reduced. Hysteresis of the minimum load threshold.

table.name: COP - Minimum Ignition Correction
table.description: Catalyst overheating protection (COP): high-load enrichment when ignition advance is reduced. The protection is only active when the ignition correction (knock and ECT/IAT compensations) is below this value.

table.name: Lambda Integrator - Minimum Limit
table.description: Lower limit of the per-bank lambda controller factor (Lambda_PerBank_ComputeBounds / Lambda_PerBank_SwitchTracker); also used as the limit of the tester CO adjustment (K-line 0x41 sub-command 1, vehicle without lambda) and for the reset of both banks (Lambda_DualInstance_Reset).

table.name: Lambda Integrator - Maximum Limit
table.description: Upper limit of the per-bank lambda controller factor (Lambda_PerBank_ComputeBounds / Lambda_PerBank_SwitchTracker); also used as the limit of the tester CO adjustment (K-line 0x41/1) and for the reset (Lambda_DualInstance_Reset).

table.name: Adaptation Multiplicative - Minimum Limit
table.description: Lower limit of the multiplicative adaptation of each bank (Lambda_ScaledAdjust_Bounded) and of the value read back from EEPROM (Lambda_RestoreOnBoot).

table.name: Adaptation Multiplicative - Maximum Limit
table.description: Upper limit of the multiplicative adaptation of each bank (Lambda_ScaledAdjust_Bounded) and of the value read back from EEPROM (Lambda_RestoreOnBoot).

table.name: Adaptation Additive - Minimum Limit
table.description: Lower limit of the additive adaptation of each bank (Lambda_PerBank_RateCalc_Clamped, Lambda_ScaledAdjust_RPM) and of the value read back from EEPROM (Lambda_RestoreOnBoot).

table.name: Adaptation Additive - Maximum Limit
table.description: Upper limit of the additive adaptation of each bank (Lambda_PerBank_RateCalc_Clamped, Lambda_ScaledAdjust_RPM). Also applied to the value read back from EEPROM at start-up (Lambda_RestoreOnBoot).

table.name: Adaptation Multiplicative - Warm-up Compensation
table.description: Weighting factor (as a function of the multiplicative adaptation and of temperature) applied to the learned multiplicative adaptation to reduce its effect while coolant temperature is below 'Adaptive Fuel Learning - Minimum ECT' (Lambda_CombineControllerAndAdaptation, computed by ECT_Dependent_Params_Update).

table.name: Adaptation Additive - Warm-up Compensation
table.description: Weighting factor applied to the learned additive adaptation to reduce its effect while coolant temperature is below 'Adaptive Fuel Learning - Minimum ECT' (Lambda_CombineControllerAndAdaptation).

table.name: Adaptive Fuel Learning - Minimum ECT
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature for learning the lambda adaptations; below it, the learned adaptations are weighted by the 'Warm-up Compensation' tables (Lambda_CombineControllerAndAdaptation).

table.name: Adaptive Fuel Learning - Maximum IAT
table.description: Maximum intake air temperature for learning the lambda adaptations (Lambda_Adaptation_Update). Above it, neither additive nor multiplicative adaptation is learned.

table.name: Adaptive Fuel Learning - Maximum MAF
table.description: Maximum air flow for learning the lambda adaptations (Lambda_Adaptation_Update).

table.name: Additive Fuel Learning - Maximum Load
table.description: Maximum load of the additive adaptation learning zone (low load / idle), Lambda_Adaptation_Update.

table.name: Multiplicative Fuel Learning - Minimum RPM
table.description: Minimum engine speed for learning the multiplicative adaptation (part load), Lambda_Adaptation_Update.

table.name: Multiplicative Fuel Learning - Minimum Load
table.description: Minimum load of the multiplicative adaptation learning zone (part load), Lambda_Adaptation_Update.

table.name: Closed Loop - Minimum RPM
table.description: Minimum engine speed for closed-loop lambda control (Lambda_PerBank_SwitchTracker). Name in the BMW software: C_LAM_N_MIN.

table.name: Closed Loop - Minimum Coolant Temperature - Idle
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature for closed-loop lambda control at idle (read without interpolation).

table.name: Closed Loop - Minimum Coolant Temperature - Above Idle
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature for closed-loop lambda control above idle (read without interpolation).

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS
table.description: Throttle tip-in enrichment (TPS_AccelEnrichment_Initiate / _DecayCalc). Factor (1.0 = 128) as a function of coolant temperature and throttle gradient. On the first trigger the value is multiplied by 'Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Initial'; on following triggers of the same session, by the stored value. The result, shifted into the enrichment sum (1.0 = 4096), is added like the full-load enrichment.

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Initial
table.description: Factor (x/256) applied to the initial enrichment computed by 'Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS', as a function of load, read without interpolation (Table_LookupValue_NoInterp) by TPS_AccelEnrichment_Initiate.

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Deactivation Duration
table.description: Throttle tip-in enrichment (TPS_AccelEnrichment_Initiate / _DecayCalc). On the first trigger the value is multiplied by 'Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Initial'; on following triggers of the same session, by the stored value. Duration of the progressive decay of the enrichment. Larger = smoother decay (useful with narrower-spray injectors, less wall wetting). Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment (engine task run at each ignition).

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Session Duration
table.description: Throttle tip-in enrichment (TPS_AccelEnrichment_Initiate / _DecayCalc). On the first trigger the value is multiplied by 'Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Initial'; on following triggers of the same session, by the stored value. Set on the first trigger then decremented by 1 per cycle; while it is not 0, a new trigger is handled as 'following', afterwards as 'first'. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment (engine task run at each ignition).

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Timer Initial Value
table.description: Throttle tip-in enrichment (TPS_AccelEnrichment_Initiate / _DecayCalc). On the first trigger the value is multiplied by 'Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Initial'; on following triggers of the same session, by the stored value. Start value of the counter armed at each trigger, decremented at each cycle. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment (engine task run at each ignition).

table.name: Detection - Increasing TPS
table.description: Throttle opening gradient threshold (as a function of engine speed and throttle angle): if the throttle opens faster than this threshold + 'Detection - Increasing TPS (ECT Compensation)', the acceleration enrichments are applied (Threshold_Crossing_Debounced_E8D0).

table.name: Detection - Increasing TPS (ECT Compensation)
table.description: Signed term added, depending on coolant temperature, to the 'Detection - Increasing TPS' threshold.

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Initial
table.description: Load increase enrichment (PerInstance_RPM_Load_Init / _Calc_C). Initial enrichment on the first trigger. If the MAF curve represents the real load well, these tables normally do not need changes on a naturally aspirated engine with the stock manifold. Name in the BMW software: IP_TI_FAC_AE(_AT)__N_32__MAF.

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Nominal
table.description: Load increase enrichment (PerInstance_RPM_Load_Init / _Calc_C). Factor applied to the initial enrichment (and, on re-trigger, to one of the 'Reduction Gradient' tables), as a function of the ratio load at trigger / current load. Name in the BMW software: IP_TI_FAC_TRA_AE(_AT)__MAF_RATIO_AE__TCO.

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Initial Session Denominator
table.description: Load increase enrichment (PerInstance_RPM_Load_Init / _Calc_C). Session denominator, set on the first trigger; a counter starts at 0 and advances at each cycle. While 1 - counter/denominator stays below the re-trigger duration, a new first trigger is possible if load increases. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment (engine task run at each ignition). Name in the BMW software: IP_TI_CYCNR_AE(_AT)__N_32__TCO.

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Reduction Gradient (Low ECT)
table.description: Load increase enrichment (PerInstance_RPM_Load_Init / _Calc_C). Reduction slope used when coolant temperature is below the threshold 'Fuel - Correction Table ECT Threshold (new)' (0x346). Axis: remaining fraction of the session (255 - elapsed time x 256 / total time), x/256. Name in the BMW software: IP_TI_FAC_1_AE_RST(_AT)__CYC.

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Reduction Gradient (Normal ECT)
table.description: Load increase enrichment (PerInstance_RPM_Load_Init / _Calc_C). Reduction slope used when coolant temperature is at or above the threshold 'Fuel - Correction Table ECT Threshold (new)' (0x346). Axis: remaining fraction of the session (255 - elapsed time x 256 / total time), x/256. Name in the BMW software: IP_TI_FAC_2_AE_RST(_AT)__CYC.

table.name: Fuel Restore - RPM
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Engine speed (as a function of coolant temperature) below which injection is always active. Raising it removes the closed-throttle overrun fuel cut.

table.name: Fuel Restore - RPM (AC on)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Engine speed (as a function of coolant temperature) below which injection is always active, A/C compressor engaged.

table.name: Fuel Cut - RPM Hysteresis (Maximum)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Above 'Fuel Restore - RPM' + this hysteresis, injection is cut with the throttle closed (immediately if a fast closing is detected, otherwise after a progressive ignition retard). Hysteresis used just after a fuel cut.

table.name: Fuel Cut - RPM Hysteresis (Minimum)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Hysteresis used once the 'Fuel Cut - Hysteresis Delay Counter' has elapsed.

table.name: Fuel Cut - Hysteresis Delay Counter
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Number of segments outside fuel cut after which the hysteresis changes from the maximum to the minimum value. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment (engine task run at each ignition). Counted only outside fuel cut.

table.name: Fuel Cut - RPM Hysteresis (below ECT Threshold)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Cut-off hysteresis used instead of 'Fuel Cut - RPM Hysteresis (Maximum)' when coolant temperature at start was below 'Fuel Cut - Hysteresis - ECT Threshold'.

table.name: Fuel Cut - Hysteresis Delay Counter (below ECT Threshold)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Counter used instead of 'Fuel Cut - Hysteresis Delay Counter' when coolant temperature at start was below 'Fuel Cut - Hysteresis - ECT Threshold'. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment (engine task run at each ignition). Counted only outside fuel cut.

table.name: Fuel Cut - Hysteresis - ECT Threshold
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Coolant temperature at start below which the '(below ECT Threshold)' tables are used.

table.name: Fuel Enleanment - Decreasing TPS
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Enleanment factor on throttle closing (engine speed x air flow), multiplied by 'Fuel Enleanment - Decreasing TPS - Multiplicative'. On following triggers of the session, the value of the first trigger is reused.

table.name: Fuel Enleanment - Decreasing TPS - Multiplicative
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Factor of the closing enleanment, as a function of the ratio current load / load at trigger and of coolant temperature (Deceleration_Enleanment_SessionTimer).

table.name: Fuel Enleanment - Decreasing TPS - Session Duration
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Duration of an enleanment session, in ignitions (the counter advances by 1 at each ignition, every 120 crank degrees), as a function of engine speed and coolant temperature. Duration in seconds = value x 20 / engine speed (e.g. 250 at 3000 rpm = 1.7 s). Main table of the rev-hang effect after lifting off. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment (engine task run at each ignition).

table.name: Fuel Enleanment - Decreasing TPS - Deactivation Factor
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Decay factor of the enleanment during the session, as a function of the session counter; the first value (counter 0) must stay 0. Axis: remaining fraction of the session (255 - elapsed time x 256 / total time), x/256.

table.name: Ignition Retard - Decreasing TPS
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Ignition retard applied progressively when the throttle closes, or with closed throttle below 'Fuel Restore - RPM' + hysteresis (IgnTiming_Accumulate_Corrections).

table.name: Ignition Retard - Decreasing TPS (Closed)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Retard applied progressively with closed throttle above 'Fuel Restore - RPM' + hysteresis; once reached, injection can be cut.

table.name: Ignition Retard - Decreasing TPS (Closed) (AC on)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Retard applied progressively with closed throttle above 'Fuel Restore - RPM' + hysteresis, A/C compressor engaged; once reached, injection can be cut.

table.name: Ignition Retard - Decreasing TPS - Step Size (ECT Compensation)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Term (coolant temperature) added to the step 'Ignition Retard - Decreasing TPS - Step Size'.

table.name: Ignition Retard - Decreasing TPS - Step Size
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Ignition rate-limit step on slow throttle closing (engine speed x load), added to the ECT compensation term (RPM_Load_Correction_WithDecay).

table.name: Ignition Retard - Fast Decreasing TPS (Closed)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Retard applied immediately (without ramp) on fast throttle closing above 'Fuel Restore - RPM' + hysteresis; only if the fast closing is detected.

table.name: Detection - Decreasing TPS
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Throttle closing gradient threshold (as a function of engine speed and throttle angle), as a positive magnitude; beyond this threshold + ECT compensation, the deceleration tables are applied (Threshold_Crossing_Debounced_E8D0).

table.name: Detection - Decreasing TPS (ECT Compensation)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Signed term added, depending on coolant temperature, to the 'Detection - Decreasing TPS' threshold.

table.name: Detection - Fast Decreasing TPS - Min. Throttle Gradient
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Throttle closing gradient (positive magnitude) beyond which the fast closing can be detected (all 'Fast Decreasing TPS' conditions must be met).

table.name: Detection - Fast Decreasing TPS - Min. RPM
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Fast closing condition: engine speed above this value, or engine speed gradient above 'Min. RPM Gradient'.

table.name: Detection - Fast Decreasing TPS - Min. RPM Gradient
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Fast closing condition: engine speed gradient above this value, or engine speed above 'Min. RPM'.

table.name: Detection - Fast Decreasing TPS - Min. Load
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Minimum load (as a function of engine speed) for fast closing detection.

table.name: Detection - Fast Decreasing TPS - Min. Load Difference
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Minimum load drop for fast closing detection.

table.name: Detection - Fast Decreasing TPS - Min. ECT
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Minimum coolant temperature for fast throttle closing detection.

table.name: AlphaN - TPS
table.description: Alpha-N load (throttle angle x engine speed), read by AlphaN_FuelCalc_TPS_IACV / RPM_Load_ModeSelect_Calc_A. Alpha-N load = [AlphaN - IACV x AlphaN - IACV (TPS Compensation) + AlphaN - TPS] / AlphaN - IAT Compensation; with a throttle fault (code 12) 'AlphaN - TPS (DTC 12)' replaces this table. Used as substitute load when the air flow meter cannot be used.

table.name: AlphaN - IAT Compensation
table.description: Intake air temperature dependent factor (AlphaN_IAT_Factor, 1.0 = 128) computed by ECT_Dependent_Params_Update and used by the alpha-N load calculation (throttle + idle valve). The alpha-N load is divided by this factor: 1.0 = neutral, larger = load reduced (warmer, less dense air).

table.name: AlphaN - TPS (DTC 12)
table.description: Alpha-N load as a function of throttle angle and engine speed, read by RPM_Load_ModeSelect_Calc_A; used as substitute load when the air flow meter cannot be used.

table.name: AlphaN - IACV
table.description: Contribution of the idle valve (bypass air) to the alpha-N load (AlphaN_FuelCalc_TPS_IACV / RPM_Load_ModeSelect_Calc_A).

table.name: AlphaN - IACV (TPS Compensation)
table.description: Weighting, as a function of throttle angle, of the idle valve contribution to the alpha-N load (AlphaN_FuelCalc_TPS_IACV).

table.name: Fuel Injection - Base
table.description: Base injection time (engine speed x load) for a stoichiometric mixture, read by BaseMaps_PerEngineState_Calc (0x0B22) outside cranking. Starting point with other injectors: correct it by the flow ratio.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Open Loop Enrichment
table.description: Full-load (open loop) enrichment factor, read by BaseMaps_PerEngineState_Calc when word_FD12.10 is set (see 'Detection - Open Loop Enrichment'); result FullLoad_Enrichment (value x 16, 1.0 = 4096 in the enrichment sum).

table.name: Detection - Open Loop Enrichment
table.description: Throttle angle (as a function of engine speed) above which the full-load enrichment is activated (word_FD12.10, Threshold_Crossing_Debounced_E8D0).

table.name: Fuel Injection - Base - VANOS Correction
table.description: Injection time deviation with VANOS active (engine speed x load, words centred on 0x8000 = 0 ms), multiplied by the VANOS state (VANOS_CamAdvance_Ratio) and added to the base injection time (BaseMaps_PerEngineState_Calc).

table.name: Fuel Injection - Warmup Enrichment
table.description: Cold engine enrichment factor (engine speed x load), multiplied by 'Fuel Injection - Warmup Enrichment (ECT Compensation)' (RPM_Load_ScaledCorrection_Calc_Alt).

table.name: Fuel Injection - Warmup Enrichment (ECT Compensation)
table.description: Coolant temperature dependent factor (1.0 = 128) applied to 'Fuel Injection - Warmup Enrichment'.

table.name: Fuel Injector - Dead Time / Latency
table.description: Injector dead time as a function of battery voltage, added to each pulse (Fuel_InjectionTime_Calc, Injector_PulseWidth_Base). Adapt it to the injectors used.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Cranking - Initial
table.description: First injection during cranking (word, as a function of coolant temperature), multiplied by 'Fuel Injection - Cranking - Hot Start Factor (vs ECT) (new)' on a hot restart then by the final gain; the dead time is added (Fuel_Cranking_InitialPulse_Calc).

table.name: Fuel Injection - Cranking
table.description: Base quantity during cranking (engine state 1), as a function of engine speed and coolant temperature (word grid); result Crank_FuelBase, then multiplied by 'Fuel Injection - Cranking - Decay (vs ECT/Cranking Cycles) (new)' and the hot restart factor in Fuel_InjectionTime_Calc. Read by the per-engine-state base calculation routine (0x3C6E6).

table.name: Fuel Economy Gauge - Scaling Factor
table.description: Factor (1.0 = 128; used x256 by MulU16_HighWord) applied to the sum of fuel flows (FuelConsumption_Rate) before division by 3 for the fuel consumption gauge. See also 'Scaling Factor 2'.

table.name: Fuel Economy Gauge - Scaling Factor 2
table.description: Factor (16-bit word, 1.0 = 8192) applied by MulU16_HighWord to the accumulated fuel flow (FuelConsumption_Accumulator_ED42) before it is sent to the fuel consumption gauge. Read as a word at 0x72 (0x73 is only its high byte).

table.name: Ignition Timing - Base
table.description: Base ignition advance map (engine speed x load) at part load / full load (engine states other than cranking and idle). The weighted VANOS correction (map 0x12F2, RPM_Load_ModeSelectB_E97C, 128 = 0) is added; result IgnTiming_BaseValue (routine 0x3C6E6).

table.name: Ignition Timing - Base 2
table.description: Map in the calibration with the layout of 'Ignition Timing - Base' (same axes); it is not read by the program of this ECU, so editing it has no effect.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Base - VANOS Correction
table.description: Ignition correction (engine speed x load, 128 = 0) multiplied by the VANOS state and added to the base advance (BaseMaps_PerEngineState_Calc, RPM_Load_ModeSelectB_E97C).

table.name: Ignition Timing - Base - ECT/IAT Compensation - Multiplicative
table.description: Weighting factor (intake air temperature x coolant temperature) multiplied by 'Ignition Timing - Base - ECT/IAT Compensation - Nominal' to obtain the temperature ignition correction (IgnTiming_Accumulate_Corrections).

table.name: Ignition Timing - Base - ECT/IAT Compensation - Nominal
table.description: Ignition correction (engine speed x load, 128 = 0) multiplied by the 'ECT/IAT Compensation - Multiplicative' factor; the weighted result (minus 128) is added to the ignition correction sum.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Cranking
table.description: Ignition advance during cranking (engine state 1), as a function of engine speed (BaseMaps_PerEngineState_Calc).

table.name: Ignition Timing - Idle - Base
table.description: Idle ignition advance (engine state 2), engine speed x load (BaseMaps_PerEngineState_Calc).

table.name: Ignition Timing - Idle - ECT Compensation
table.description: Advance added at idle when coolant temperature is low (IgnTiming_Accumulate_Corrections).

table.name: X Axis - Load
table.description: Load axis shared by the main fuel and ignition maps. After changing it, reload the file immediately.

table.name: Y Axis - Engine Speed
table.description: Engine speed axis shared by the main fuel and ignition maps. After changing it, reload the file immediately.

table.name: DTC 212 - Minimum RPM
table.description: Below this engine speed, check 212 (VANOS / minimum speed, DTC212_Check) is not evaluated.

table.name: CH - On/Off - VANOS
table.description: Catalyst heating (CH): function active after a cold start. 1: VANOS is engaged during the cold start to increase air flow and help heating; 0: disabled (can smooth a rough cold start).

table.name: Detection - Light/Heavy Throttle
table.description: Throttle angle (as a function of engine speed): below it, VANOS follows the 'Light Throttle' tables, above it the 'Heavy Throttle' tables.

table.name: VANOS - Min. Load (Light Throttle) (AT)
table.description: Light throttle: load above which VANOS is engaged (automatic transmission).

table.name: VANOS - Min. Load (Light Throttle) (MT)
table.description: Light throttle: load (as a function of engine speed and coolant temperature) above which VANOS is engaged (manual transmission).

table.name: VANOS - On/Off (Heavy Throttle) (MS41.1/MS41.0)
table.description: Heavy throttle: 1 = VANOS active at this engine speed, 0 = inactive. Use this table only to change the engine speed axis.

table.name: Nominal Idle Speed
table.description: Target idle speed as a function of coolant temperature, manual gearbox or automatic in neutral (computed in ECT_Dependent_Params_Update).

table.name: Nominal Idle Speed (A/C on)
table.description: Target idle speed as a function of coolant temperature, manual gearbox or automatic in neutral, A/C engaged.

table.name: Nominal Idle Speed (A/T in Drive)
table.description: Target idle speed as a function of coolant temperature, automatic transmission in gear.

table.name: Nominal Idle Speed (A/T in Drive and A/C on)
table.description: Target idle speed (as a function of coolant temperature), automatic transmission in gear and A/C engaged (IdleSpeed_Target_Candidate_Drive_AC), computed in ECT_Dependent_Params_Update.

table.name: IACV - TPS
table.description: Idle valve opening as a function of engine speed and throttle angle (support on throttle closing); the tracked value E8F4 rises by at most 'IACV - Map Rise Step (new)' and falls by at most 'IACV - Map Fall Step (new)' per calculation (routine 0x2D258). Internally the byte is shifted by 7 bits into a word where 100 % = 32768, and IACV_Duty_Sum_Output subtracts 0x1999 (20 %) before doubling it into the final duty: hence 0.3906 % per step with a -20 % offset.

table.name: IACV - ECT (M/T or A/T in Neutral)
table.description: Base idle valve opening as a function of coolant temperature, manual gearbox or automatic in neutral (computed with the temperature dependent parameters).

table.name: IACV - ECT (M/T or A/T in Neutral and AC on)
table.description: Base idle valve opening as a function of coolant temperature, manual gearbox or automatic in neutral, A/C engaged.

table.name: IACV - ECT (A/T in Drive)
table.description: Base idle valve opening as a function of coolant temperature, automatic transmission in gear (A/T in Drive).

table.name: IACV - ECT (A/T in Drive and AC on)
table.description: Base idle valve opening as a function of coolant temperature, automatic transmission in gear and A/C engaged.

table.name: IACV - PWM
table.description: Conversion of the computed opening into the final idle valve control duty cycle (IACV_PWM_Output_Calc).

table.name: IACV - Latency
table.description: Battery voltage compensation: factor (1.0 = 128) applied to the final idle valve duty cycle (IACV_PWM_Output_Calc).

table.name: IACV - Cranking
table.description: Idle valve opening factor during cranking (word_FD14.1), as a function of engine speed and coolant temperature, multiplied by the temperature factor E8FF (1.0 = 128) then by the computed opening (IACV_Duty_E902); the product is shifted by 3 bits (routine 0x2D520), so this factor is 1.0 = 64.

table.name: ISR - Proportional
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): proportional term as a function of the corrected speed error (128 = 0). Positive values when speed must be raised, negative to lower it.

table.name: ISR - Integral - Converging
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): integral term when the speed error decreases (converging to the target).

table.name: ISR - Integral - Diverging
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): integral term when the speed error increases.

table.name: ISR - Derivative
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): derivative term (128 = 0), as a function of the engine speed gradient: prevents the speed from dropping below the target on a fast drop; applies at idle and above.

table.name: ISR - Derivative - Decay Limitation
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): maximum decrease of the derivative term applied every 40 ms; no limit on its first application.

table.name: ISR - Derivative - Engine Speed Gradient Threshold
table.description: Engine speed gradient (RPM_Gradient_S8, signed) below 'Intercept - RPM' under which the speed drop is detected: word_FD26.2/3 set and the 'ISR - Derivative - Min. Time (new)' delay armed (routine 0x2DC10). See 'ISR - Derivative'.

table.name: ISR - Aggression - ECT Compensation
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): PID gain factor (1.0 = 128) as a function of coolant temperature; above 1 more aggressive control, below softer.

table.name: ISR - Minimum Integral Limit (Vehicle Stopped)
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): lower limit of the integral term at idle, vehicle stopped.

table.name: ISR - Maximum Integral Limit (Vehicle Stopped)
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): upper limit of the integral term at idle, vehicle stopped.

table.name: ISR - Minimum Integral Limit (Vehicle Moving)
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): lower limit of the integral term at idle, vehicle moving.

table.name: ISR - Maximum Integral Limit (Vehicle Moving)
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): upper limit of the integral term at idle, vehicle moving.

table.name: ISR - Minimum Integral Limit (Vehicle Moving w/ AC on)
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): lower limit of the integral term at idle, vehicle moving, A/C engaged.

table.name: ISR - Maximum Integral Limit (Vehicle Moving w/ AC on)
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): upper limit of the integral term at idle, vehicle moving, A/C engaged.

table.name: ISR - Minimum Integral Limit (above Idle)
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): lower limit of the integral term above idle.

table.name: ISR - Maximum Integral Limit (above Idle)
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): upper limit of the integral term above idle.

table.name: ISR - Minimum Integral Limit (above Idle w/ AC on)
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): lower limit of the integral term above idle, A/C engaged.

table.name: ISR - Maximum Integral Limit (above Idle w/ AC on)
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): upper limit of the integral term above idle, A/C engaged.

table.name: Detection - Closed Throttle
table.description: Throttle angle below which the throttle is considered closed (closed-throttle mode).

table.name: Intercept - RPM
table.description: Engine speed below which 'Intercept' mode is allowed: smooth transition from deceleration to idle (ignition, fuel, idle control, speed drop).

table.name: Rapid Engine Speed Drop - Integral Additive
table.description: On a rapid engine speed drop, value added immediately to the integral term of the idle speed control, ignoring its limits, to avoid dropping below the target.

table.name: Detection - Rapid Engine Speed Drop
table.description: Closed throttle, engine speed below 'Intercept - RPM' and speed gradient below this value: rapid engine speed drop detected.

table.name: Dashpot - Nominal
table.description: Closing damper (dashpot): extra idle valve opening when the throttle closes (engine speed x throttle angle) to soften the torque drop. Reduce it with a large-diameter throttle. The byte is shifted by 7 bits into the idle valve word (100 % = 32768): 0.3906 % per step.

table.name: Dashpot - Decay Limitation
table.description: Idle valve closing speed after a throttle lift (as a function of engine speed): smaller = more progressive closing. Step removed at each calculation (every 40 ms): the byte is shifted by 5 bits into the idle valve word (100 % = 32768), i.e. 0.0977 % per step.

table.name: Ignition Retard - ASC
table.description: Ignition retard requested by ASC (IgnTiming_Accumulate_Corrections, active if word_FD42.5 or .6). Rows = engine speed, columns = load.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit
table.description: Vehicle speed above which the speed limiter acts; 255 disables it.

table.name: Engine Speed Limiter (Hysteresis A)
table.description: Rev limiter hysteresis (RevLimit_ModeSelect_Debounced): injection resumes below the limit minus this value. Reduce it for a harder limiter.

table.name: Engine Speed Limiter (Hysteresis B)
table.description: Second rev limiter hysteresis (RevLimit_ModeSelect_Debounced).

table.name: Engine Speed Limiter (Hard Limiter)
table.description: Normal engine speed limit (RevLimit_TargetRPM) selected by RevLimit_ModeSelect_Debounced outside limp mode.

table.name: Engine Speed Limiter (Immediate)
table.description: Engine speed for immediate injection cut; set it above 'Engine Speed Limiter (Hard Limiter)' (RevLimit_ModeSelect_Debounced).

table.name: Engine Speed Limiter (VSS Error)
table.description: Engine speed limit when the vehicle speed sensor is faulty (code 214).

table.name: Engine Speed Limiter (Resume Delay)
table.description: Delay before injection resumes after the rev limiter has acted (RevLimiter_VSS_StateMachine); smaller = harder limiter. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment (engine task run at each ignition). Counted down by RevLimit_ModeSelect_Debounced (task 6).

table.name: Muffler Flap Solenoid
table.description: Throttle angle threshold of the exhaust flap (ExhaustFlap_Control), as a function of engine speed and coolant temperature: when the throttle angle exceeds this value, the flap is commanded open; it closes again when the angle falls below the value minus 'Exhaust Flap - TPS Hysteresis (new)'. Below 'Exhaust Flap - Minimum Vehicle Speed (new)' the flap is closed; just after start it is open. All zeros: flap always open above the minimum speed. Active if Byte 8 bit 3.

table.name: MAF (1024 kg/hr Mode) (256x1)
table.description: Air flow meter linearisation (256 voltage points, words) in the stock 1024 kg/h mode; read by the sampling interrupt (Timer3_Interrupt_Handler, pointer MAF_Table_Ptr). The kg/h scaling comes from the program.

table.name: MAF
table.description: Same table as 'MAF (1024 kg/hr Mode) (256x1)' shown as 16x16 for editing. If a MAF table in 2048 kg/h mode is displayed (256 KB files), only the last modified table is saved.

table.name: ECT Sensor Scaling
table.description: Linearisation of the coolant temperature sensor (ADC slot 9, AN0) into CoolantTemp_Lin (CoolantTemp_ECT_PlausibilityCheck); the result is checked against 'ECT Sensor - Upper Plausibility Limit (new)' / 'ECT Sensor - Lower Plausibility Limit (new)' (code 10). Axis: sensor voltage on the 10-bit ADC (5 V reference).

table.name: IAT Sensor Scaling
table.description: Linearisation of the intake air temperature sensor (IAT_Lin) by IAT_Linearize_PlausibilityCheck; the result is then checked against 'IAT Sensor - Upper Plausibility Limit (new)' / 'IAT Sensor - Lower Plausibility Limit (new)' (code 14). Axis: sensor voltage (8-bit, 5 V reference).

table.name: Minimum Mass Air Threshold for MAF Error
table.description: Low air mass threshold of the air flow meter diagnosis (short to ground, code 8); below it, switch to the alpha-N substitute mode. With another air flow meter, avoid zero values in the MAF table.

table.name: Maximum Mass Air Threshold for MAF Error
table.description: High air mass threshold of the air flow meter diagnosis (short to supply, code 8); can be raised up to 1389 with forced induction.

table.name: Knock Detection - Min. Load
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x2A30A). Minimum load (engine speed x coolant temperature) to allow knock detection.

table.name: Max. Knock Retard
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x2A30A). Limp-home ignition angle of the knock control (engine speed x load). This table is only read without lambda control (ConfigFlags_FD4C.15 = 0); with lambda control it is 'Max. Knock Retard (Lambda) (new)' (0x252C). Not read by the program of this ECU (lambda control is always active).

table.name: Max. Knock Retard (ECT)
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x2A30A). Coolant temperature dependent weighting factor applied to the limp-home ignition angle.

table.name: No Knock Advance - Step Size
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x2A30A). Advance-back step when no knock is detected.

table.name: Knock Retard - Step Size (Regular Intensity)
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x2A30A). Retard step applied for a knock of normal intensity (intensity 1).

table.name: Knock Retard - Step Size (Higher Intensity)
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x2A30A). Retard step applied for a knock of high intensity (intensity 2).

table.name: Knock Detection Threshold - Multiplicative Factor - Cylinder 6
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x2A30A). Knock detection threshold factor of cylinder 6 (engine speed x load), applied to the reference level of the cylinder. For a value k of CylIndex_Latched (firing position 0-5), the program reads the factor table of firing position k+3 (jump table 0x2CAA).

table.name: Knock Detection Threshold - Multiplicative Factor - Cylinder 2
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x2A30A). Knock detection threshold factor of cylinder 2 (engine speed x load), applied to the reference level of the cylinder. For a value k of CylIndex_Latched (firing position 0-5), the program reads the factor table of firing position k+3 (jump table 0x2CAA).

table.name: Knock Detection Threshold - Multiplicative Factor - Cylinder 4
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x2A30A). Knock detection threshold factor of cylinder 4 (engine speed x load), applied to the reference level of the cylinder. For a value k of CylIndex_Latched (firing position 0-5), the program reads the factor table of firing position k+3 (jump table 0x2CAA).

table.name: Knock Detection Threshold - Multiplicative Factor - Cylinder 1
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x2A30A). Knock detection threshold factor of cylinder 1 (engine speed x load), applied to the reference level of the cylinder. For a value k of CylIndex_Latched (firing position 0-5), the program reads the factor table of firing position k+3 (jump table 0x2CAA).

table.name: Knock Detection Threshold - Multiplicative Factor - Cylinder 5
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x2A30A). Knock detection threshold factor of cylinder 5 (engine speed x load), applied to the reference level of the cylinder.
