table.description: Catalyst heating: idle valve base map (throttle angle x engine speed) used instead of 'IACV - TPS' while catalyst heating is active, with a progressive transition. Same internal scaling as 'IACV - TPS': 0.3906 % per step with a -20 % offset.

table.name: IACV - TPS (MSR Mode 1) (new)
table.description: Idle valve pre-control used when ABS/ASC requests MSR mode 1 (code 2): idle air is increased to limit engine braking (drive wheel slip). The program adds 0x1999 (20 %) to the shifted value, which cancels the -20 % offset of the normal map: 0.3906 % per step. Requires Byte 7 bits 0-2 = 001.

table.name: IACV - TPS (MSR Mode 2) (new)
table.description: Like 'IACV - TPS (MSR Mode 1) (new)', for MSR mode 2 (code 6).

table.name: IACV - Raised Idle Target Correction (vs RPM/Target Difference) (new)
table.description: Idle valve opening added when the target idle speed is raised, as a function of engine speed and of the difference between the raised target and the base target.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Enleanment Weight (No Lambda) (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Coolant temperature weighting of 'Fuel Injection - Enleanment (No Lambda) (new)' during warm-up. Not read by the program of this ECU (lambda control is always active).

table.name: Fuel Injection - Enleanment (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Enleanment (engine speed x load) removed from the fuel factor of each bank on the variant without catalyst / lambda control, weighted by 'Fuel Injection - Enleanment Weight (No Lambda) (vs ECT) (new)'. Not applied during full-load enrichment. Not read by the program of this ECU (lambda control is always active).

table.name: Ignition Timing - Anti-Jerk (new)
table.description: Anti-jerk function: ignition retard applied when a driveline oscillation is detected, as a function of engine speed and load. Multiplied by 'Anti-Jerk - Retard Factor (2nd Oscillation) (new)' on the 2nd oscillation then by 'Anti-Jerk - Retard Factor (Next Oscillations) (new)', and limited by 'Anti-Jerk - Retard Limit (vs RPM) (new)'.

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Retard Limit (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Maximum retard step applied by the anti-jerk function, as a function of engine speed (read without interpolation).

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Recovery Ramp Rate (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Speed at which the advance returns to the target after an anti-jerk intervention (degrees returned at each ignition), as a function of engine speed.

table.name: CH 2 - Ignition Weight (ECT vs Time) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: weighting of 'CH 2 - Ignition Timing (vs RPM/TPS) (new)', as a function of coolant temperature and of the time since the end of cranking.

table.name: CH 2 - Ignition Timing (vs RPM/TPS) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: ignition correction as a function of engine speed and throttle angle, weighted by 'CH 2 - Ignition Weight (ECT vs Time) (new)'.

table.name: CH - Ignition Timing (Idle) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating: ignition correction at idle, as a function of engine speed, weighted by 'CH - Ignition Weight (Idle) (ECT vs Time) (new)'.

table.name: CH - Ignition Weight (Idle) (ECT vs Time) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating: weighting of 'CH - Ignition Timing (Idle) (new)' as a function of coolant temperature and of the time since the end of cranking.

table.name: CH - Ignition Timing (Part Load) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating: ignition correction above idle (engine speed x load), weighted by 'CH - Ignition Weight (Part Load) (AT) (new)' or '(MT)'. Vehicles with lambda control.

table.name: CH - Ignition Timing (Part Load) (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Like 'CH - Ignition Timing (Part Load) (new)', for vehicles without lambda control. Not read by the program of this ECU (lambda control is always active).

table.name: CH - Ignition Weight (Part Load) (AT) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating: weighting of the above-idle ignition correction, as a function of coolant temperature and time since start; automatic transmission.

table.name: CH - Ignition Weight (Part Load) (MT) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating: weighting of the above-idle ignition correction, as a function of coolant temperature and time since start; manual gearbox.

table.name: Spark Plug Cleaning - Ignition Timing (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.description: Spark plug cleaning: ignition angle correction (engine speed x load) applied at part load when coolant temperature is between 'Spark Plug Cleaning - Min. ECT (new)' and 'Spark Plug Cleaning - Max. ECT (new)', during 'Spark Plug Cleaning - Duration (new)'. Constant (+3 deg) in this file.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Base - ECT/IAT Compensation - Nominal (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Like 'Ignition Timing - Base - ECT/IAT Compensation - Nominal', for vehicles without lambda control; weighted by 'Ignition Timing - Base - ECT/IAT Compensation - Multiplicative'. Not read by the program of this ECU (lambda control is always active).

table.name: CH - Duration - Idle Speed Target Increase (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Like 'CH - Duration - Idle Speed Target Increase', for vehicles without lambda control. Zero in this file. Not read by the program of this ECU (lambda control is always active).

table.name: CH - Duration - Ignition Retard (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Like 'CH - Duration - Ignition Retard', for vehicles without lambda control. Not read by the program of this ECU (lambda control is always active).

table.name: Injection Timing - ECT Correction (new)
table.description: Start-of-injection angle correction as a function of coolant temperature.

table.name: Air Mass - Initial Value at Start (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Air mass per stroke used as the initial value at start, as a function of coolant temperature.

table.name: Load Filter - Coefficient (vs RPM/Air Mass) (new)
table.description: Filter coefficient of the measured load while driving, as a function of engine speed and air mass: ~1 = no filtering, smaller = smoother but slower load.

table.name: Load Filter - Coefficient (Deceleration) (vs RPM/Air Mass) (new)
table.description: Like 'Load Filter - Coefficient (vs RPM/Air Mass) (new)', during a deceleration (overrun reduction).

table.name: Load Filter - Coefficient (Idle/Overrun) (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Filter coefficient of the load at idle and in overrun, as a function of engine speed (no filtering during cranking).

table.name: Ignition Timing - Re-entry Rate Limit (Idle) (vs RPM Gradient) (new)
table.description: Ignition rate limit on re-entry into idle after a fuel cut, as a function of the engine speed gradient.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Re-entry Rate Limit (Part Load) (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Ignition rate limit on re-entry into part load after a fuel cut, as a function of engine speed. Read without interpolation.

table.name: Detection - Tip-in for Knock Control (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Throttle opening speed threshold (as a function of engine speed) above which a fast opening is reported to the knock control, which then adapts its detection during 'Knock Control - Tip-in Duration (vs RPM) (new)'. Read without interpolation between engine speed points.

table.name: Knock Control - Tip-in Duration (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Duration during which the knock control treats the engine as transient after a fast throttle opening (see 'Detection - Tip-in for Knock Control (vs RPM) (new)'), as a function of engine speed. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment.

table.name: Detection - Fast Increasing TPS (new)
table.description: Throttle opening speed threshold (as a function of engine speed) above which the retard 'Ignition Retard - Fast Increasing TPS (new)' is applied.

table.name: Ignition Retard - Fast Increasing TPS (new)
table.description: Ignition correction applied on a fast throttle opening (negative value = retard), as a function of engine speed and load. Weighted by 'Ignition Retard - Fast Increasing TPS (IAT Compensation) (new)', applied during 'Ignition Retard - Fast Increasing TPS - Duration (new)' and limited by 'Ignition Timing - Re-entry Correction (Part Load) (vs RPM/ECT) (new)'. Read without interpolation.

table.name: Ignition Retard - Fast Increasing TPS (IAT Compensation) (new)
table.description: Weighting of the fast throttle opening retard according to intake air temperature: 1.0 = full retard, 0 = no retard.

table.name: Ignition Retard - Fast Increasing TPS - Duration (new)
table.description: Duration of the fast throttle opening retard, as a function of engine speed. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Re-entry Correction (Part Load) (vs RPM/ECT) (new)
table.description: Ignition correction on re-entry into part load after a fuel cut, as a function of engine speed and coolant temperature; also limits the advance during its progressive return to the target. Read without interpolation.

table.name: VANOS - Min. Load Hysteresis (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: VANOS switch-off hysteresis: load difference removed from the activation threshold, as a function of engine speed. Read without interpolation.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Overrun Exit Correction A (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Injection time added when injection resumes after an overrun fuel cut (intercept), as a function of coolant temperature; then progressively reduced to 0 (see 'Fuel - Overrun Exit Correction Step (new)'). Read without interpolation.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Overrun Exit Correction B (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Injection time added when injection resumes after a fuel cut caused by a throttle opening (re-entry, acceleration), as a function of coolant temperature; then progressively reduced to 0.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Overrun Exit Correction C (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Injection time added when injection resumes after a fuel cut, into part load, as a function of coolant temperature; then progressively reduced to 0.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Overrun Exit Correction D (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Injection time added when injection resumes after a fuel cut into idle/overrun (default variant), as a function of coolant temperature; then progressively reduced to 0.

table.name: CH - Duration - Fuel Enrichment (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Like 'CH - Duration - Fuel Enrichment', for vehicles without lambda control. Zero in this file. Not read by the program of this ECU (lambda control is always active).

table.name: VANOS - Lock ECT Threshold (vs IAT at Start) (new)
table.description: Coolant temperature below which VANOS stays locked, frozen at start as a function of intake air temperature. Read without interpolation.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Enable Delay (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Idle time before the idle air adaptation is enabled, as a function of engine speed.

table.name: ISR - Integral - Initial Value at Start (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Initial value of the idle speed control integral term at start, as a function of coolant temperature (0 = neutral).

table.name: Fuel Injection - After-Start Enrichment Decay (ECT at Start vs Cycles) (new)
table.description: Decay factor of the after-start enrichment, as a function of coolant temperature at start and of the number of cycles since start. At 0, the after-start enrichment is finished.

table.name: Fuel Injection - After-Start Enrichment (ECT vs IAT) (new)
table.description: Cold after-start enrichment factor (1.0 = 64), frozen at start according to coolant and intake air temperatures; then multiplied by 'Fuel Injection - After-Start Enrichment Decay (ECT at Start vs Cycles) (new)' and added to the fuel.

table.name: Fuel Injection - After-Start Enrichment - Hot Start Factor (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Factor applied to the after-start enrichment on a hot restart (see 'Fuel Injection - Hot Restart ECT Margin (new)').

table.name: Fuel Injection - Cranking - Hot Start Factor (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Factor applied to the quantities injected during cranking on a hot restart (see 'Fuel Injection - Hot Restart ECT Margin (new)'); factor 1 otherwise.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Cranking - Decay (vs ECT/Cranking Cycles) (new)
table.description: Factor applied to the injection time during cranking, as a function of coolant temperature and of the number of cycles since the start of cranking: progressively reduces injection if the engine is slow to start.

table.name: Ignition Timing - After-Start Overshoot Limit (vs RPM Error) (new)
table.description: Ignition limitation against engine speed overshoot after start, as a function of the speed error. Used in one of the two idle control modes; the other mode uses 'Ignition Timing - Idle - ISR Correction 2 (vs RPM Error) (new)'.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Cranking - ECT Correction (new)
table.description: Ignition correction added during cranking, as a function of coolant temperature (adds to 'Ignition Timing - Cranking').

table.name: Cranking - End RPM (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Engine speed above which the engine is considered started (end of the cranking state), as a function of coolant temperature.

table.name: CH 2 - Idle Speed Target Increase (M/T or Neutral) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: target idle speed increase, as a function of coolant temperature at start (manual gearbox or automatic not in gear); then reduced by 'CH 2 - Idle Speed Target Increase Decay (vs ECT) (new)'.

table.name: CH 2 - Idle Speed Target Increase (A/T in Drive) (new)
table.description: Like 'CH 2 - Idle Speed Target Increase (M/T or Neutral) (new)', automatic transmission in gear.

table.name: CH 2 - Idle Speed Target Increase Decay (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: decrease rate of the idle speed increase (removed at each calculation), as a function of coolant temperature.

table.name: Idle Speed Target - Tester Offset Weight (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Weighting, according to coolant temperature, of the idle offset set with the tester (K-line) added to the target.

table.name: Idle Speed Target - Floor (A/T in Drive) (new)
table.description: Minimum target idle speed applied when the vehicle is moving outside the idle state, automatic transmission in gear, as a function of the filtered battery voltage. Read without interpolation.

table.name: Idle Speed Target - Floor (M/T or Neutral) (new)
table.description: Minimum target idle speed applied when the vehicle is moving outside the idle state, manual gearbox or automatic not in gear, as a function of the filtered battery voltage. Read without interpolation.

table.name: IACV - Drive Engage Ramp Down (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Ramp-down limit of the idle valve opening when the automatic transmission is shifted into or out of drive, as a function of coolant temperature.

table.name: IACV - Drive Engage Ramp Up (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Ramp-up limit of the idle valve opening when the automatic transmission is shifted into or out of drive, as a function of coolant temperature.

table.name: IACV - Throttle Leakage Pre-control (vs IAT) (new)
table.description: Idle valve pre-control compensating the throttle leakage air, as a function of intake air temperature (128 = 0).

table.name: IACV / Air Mass - IAT Density Factor (new)
table.description: Intake air temperature (density) factor applied to the idle valve opening calculation and to the air mass plausibility check.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Start Value (vs IAT) (new)
table.description: Start value of the idle air adaptation as a function of intake air temperature. Constant (1.0) in this file.

table.name: IACV - AC Compressor Pre-control (vs AC Pressure/IAT) (new)
table.description: Extra idle valve opening when the A/C compressor is requested, as a function of the A/C circuit pressure level and of intake air temperature. Applied progressively (see 'IACV - AC Compressor Ramp-in Rate (vs RPM) (new)') and multiplied by 'IACV - AC Compressor Pre-control Scale (vs RPM/Load) (new)'. Vehicles with lambda control.

table.name: IACV - AC Compressor Pre-control (vs AC Pressure/IAT) (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Like 'IACV - AC Compressor Pre-control (vs AC Pressure/IAT) (new)', for vehicles without lambda control. Not read by the program of this ECU (lambda control is always active).

table.name: IACV - AC Compressor Pre-control Scale (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.description: Factor multiplying the idle valve opening added for the A/C, as a function of load and engine speed. Vehicles with lambda control.

table.name: IACV - AC Compressor Pre-control Scale (vs RPM/Load) (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Like 'IACV - AC Compressor Pre-control Scale (vs RPM/Load) (new)', for vehicles without lambda control. Not read by the program of this ECU (lambda control is always active).

table.name: IACV - AC Compressor Ramp-in Rate (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Rate at which the extra idle valve opening is applied when the A/C compressor engages (step added at each calculation), as a function of engine speed. Larger = faster opening. Ramp start: 'IACV - AC Ramp Initial Value (new)'.

table.name: IACV - AC Transient Adder (new)
table.description: Opening (or closing if negative) added briefly to the idle valve when the A/C compressor switches on or off, then progressively reduced to 0. As a function of engine speed. Applied as soon as A/C is requested, before the compressor engages (+3.1 to +6.6 % opening in this software).

table.name: AC Compressor - On Delay (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Delay between the A/C request and the compressor engagement, as a function of engine speed (gives the idle valve time to open). In this file: 360 ms at 800 rpm, 50 ms at 3600 rpm. When it expires, the relay cut order (bit 5 of 0xF6E5, message 0x104 to the satellite) is cleared and the compressor enable is signalled on CAN (DME1 byte 0 bit 6).

table.name: AC Compressor - Off Delay (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Delay between the end of the A/C request and the compressor switch-off, as a function of engine speed.

table.name: IACV - Tester Offset Pre-control (new)
table.description: Idle valve opening corresponding to the idle offset set with the tester, weighted by 'IACV - Tester Offset ECT Weight (new)'.

table.name: IACV - Tester Offset ECT Weight (new)
table.description: Weighting, according to coolant temperature, of 'IACV - Tester Offset Pre-control (new)'.

table.name: CH 2 - IACV for Speed Increase (M/T or Neutral) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: idle valve opening corresponding to the remaining idle speed increase ('CH 2 - Idle Speed Target Increase (M/T or Neutral) (new)'), as a function of coolant temperature; manual gearbox or automatic not in gear.

table.name: CH 2 - IACV for Speed Increase (A/T in Drive) (new)
table.description: Like 'CH 2 - IACV for Speed Increase (M/T or Neutral) (new)', automatic transmission in gear.

table.name: CH 2 - IACV for Ignition Retard (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: extra idle valve opening compensating the torque loss of the heating ignition retard, as a function of coolant temperature and of the ignition correction.

table.name: CH 2 - IACV for VANOS (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: idle valve opening added in proportion to the VANOS position; the displayed value is the contribution with the cam fully advanced.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Idle - ISR Correction (vs RPM Error) (new)
table.description: Idle fuel correction factor according to the speed error, in the second idle control mode (128 = no correction).

table.name: Ignition Timing - Idle - ISR Correction 2 (vs RPM Error) (new)
table.description: Idle ignition correction according to the speed error, in the second idle control mode; weighted by 'Ignition Timing - Idle - ISR Correction Weight (vs ECT) (new)'.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Idle - ISR Correction Weight (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Weighting of 'Ignition Timing - Idle - ISR Correction 2 (vs RPM Error) (new)' according to coolant temperature.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Intercept Advance (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Absolute ignition angle used on intercept (resumption of injection after an overrun fuel cut), as a function of coolant temperature. Same scale as the base ignition maps.

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Exit Threshold (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: End of the anti-jerk intervention: it stops when the crankshaft speed variation rises above this threshold. Value = relative change of the rotation period between two measurements (negative = engine accelerating), as a function of engine speed.

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Detection Threshold (First Oscillation) (new)
table.description: Detection of the first oscillation: anti-jerk acts when the relative change of the crankshaft rotation period falls below this threshold (negative = engine accelerating), as a function of load and engine speed. The closer to 0, the more sensitive the detection.

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Detection Threshold (Next Oscillations) (new)
table.description: Like 'Anti-Jerk - Detection Threshold (First Oscillation) (new)', for the following oscillations (see 'Anti-Jerk - Max. Detections (new)').

table.name: STFT - Neg I (new)
table.description: Lambda control: integral slope, lean -> rich direction, as a function of engine speed and load. Correction added every 20 ms: map value x 'Lambda PI - I Multiplier Bank 1 (new)' / 'Lambda PI - I Multiplier Bank 2 (new)' (both x/256), then x 'STFT - Overrun Slowdown Factor (vs ECT) (new)'.

table.name: STFT - Neg P (new)
table.description: Lambda control: proportional jump, lean -> rich direction, as a function of engine speed and load. Jump applied at each sensor switch: map value x 'Lambda PI - P Multiplier (new)' (both x/256), then x 'STFT - Overrun Slowdown Factor (vs ECT) (new)'.

table.name: STFT - Pos I (new)
table.description: Lambda control: integral slope, rich -> lean direction, as a function of engine speed and load. Correction added every 20 ms: map value x 'Lambda PI - I Multiplier Bank 1 (new)' / 'Lambda PI - I Multiplier Bank 2 (new)' (both x/256), then x 'STFT - Overrun Slowdown Factor (vs ECT) (new)'.

table.name: STFT - Pos P (new)
table.description: Lambda control: proportional jump, rich -> lean direction, as a function of engine speed and load. Jump applied at each sensor switch: map value x 'Lambda PI - P Multiplier (new)' (both x/256), then x 'STFT - Overrun Slowdown Factor (vs ECT) (new)'.

table.name: STFT - Overrun Slowdown Factor (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Factor slowing the lambda control in overrun, as a function of coolant temperature; maximum value (1.0) = no slowing.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Condensation Phase (vs ECT at Start) (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: duration of the condensation phase (reduced heating while there may be water in the exhaust), as a function of coolant temperature at start. Budget counted down by 'O2 Sensor Heater - Condensation Phase Decrement (vs Air Flow) (new)'; 0 = no condensation phase. Only with lambda control coded.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Condensation Phase Decrement (vs Air Flow) (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: amount removed every second from the condensation phase budget, as a function of air flow (more flow = exhaust dries faster). Budget used up: full power during 'O2 Sensor Heater - Full Power Time (new)'.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Base Duty (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: base duty cycle, as a function of engine speed and load, then multiplied by the heater adaptation factor.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Base Duty Ramp Up (vs Air Flow) (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: rate of increase of the duty cycle towards 'O2 Sensor Heater - Base Duty (vs RPM/Load) (new)', as a function of air flow.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Base Duty Ramp Down (vs Air Flow) (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: rate of decrease of the duty cycle towards 'O2 Sensor Heater - Base Duty (vs RPM/Load) (new)', as a function of air flow.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Overrun Duty (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: duty cycle targeted during overrun fuel cut, as a function of engine speed, reached in steps of 'O2 Sensor Heater - Overrun Duty Step (new)'.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Adaptation Step Bank 1 (vs Signal Center) (new)
table.description: Bank 1 O2 sensor heating: correction of the heating factor as a function of the deviation of the sensor signal centre from 'O2 Sensor Heater - Signal Center Reference (new)' (positive deviation = more heating, negative = less).

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Adaptation Step Bank 2 (vs Signal Center) (new)
table.description: Like 'O2 Sensor Heater - Adaptation Step Bank 1 (vs Signal Center) (new)', for the bank 2 sensor.

table.name: Max. Knock Retard (Lambda) (new)
table.description: Limp-home ignition angle of the knock control (engine speed x load), vehicles with lambda control; 'Max. Knock Retard' is only read without lambda control.

table.name: Knock Detection - Reference Level Initial (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Initial noise reference level of each cylinder when the knock control is reset, as a function of engine speed; also used to normalise the noise level.

table.name: Knock Sensor - Satellite Gain Factor (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Knock sensor signal gain factor, as a function of engine speed (multiplied by the adapted gain, capped at 255). The gain is sent to the satellite in message ASC1 0x101 at each TDC; the measured level is read back 48 deg later (message 0x102).

table.name: Knock Detection - Reference Offset (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Offset (knock addend) added to the noise reference level of each cylinder before comparison (0 = no offset). Read without interpolation.

table.name: Knock Detection - Dynamic Mode RPM Gradient (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Engine speed change above which knock detection switches to transient mode (faster filtering of the reference level), as a function of engine speed.

table.name: Knock Detection - Dynamic Mode Duration (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Duration of the transient mode of knock detection, as a function of engine speed. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment.

table.name: Knock Adaptation - Min. Load (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Minimum load for learning the per-cylinder knock retard, as a function of engine speed (outside transients and faults). Read without interpolation.

table.name: Canister Purge - HC Adaptation Step (vs Air Flow) (new)
table.description: Learning rate of the canister fuel vapour load (mixture correction due to purge), as a function of air flow (rate limit of the lambda controller preset value). Larger = faster learning.

table.name: Canister Purge - Purge Level Step Down (vs Air Flow) (new)
table.description: Rate of decrease of the purge level (share of the target removed every 100 ms), as a function of air flow.

table.name: Canister Purge - Purge Level Step Up (vs Air Flow) (new)
table.description: Rate of increase of the purge level (share of the target added every 100 ms), as a function of air flow.

table.name: Canister Purge - Flow Limit (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.description: Limit of the purge level according to engine speed and load (lambda controller preset value).

table.name: Canister Purge - Min. Load for Adaptation (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Minimum load for the purge adjustment, as a function of engine speed. Zero in this file.

table.name: Canister Purge - Max. Duty (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.description: Maximum purge valve pre-control duty cycle according to engine speed and load (100 % = valve fully open), reached progressively (see 'Canister Purge - Purge Level Step Up (vs Air Flow) (new)' and 'Canister Purge - Purge Level Step Down (vs Air Flow) (new)').

table.name: Canister Purge - Min. Duty (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.description: Minimum purge valve pre-control duty cycle according to engine speed and load (vehicles with lambda control).

table.name: Canister Purge - Min. Duty (vs RPM/Load) (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Minimum purge valve pre-control duty cycle according to engine speed and load (vehicles without lambda control). Not read by the program of this ECU (lambda control is always active).

table.name: TPS Substitute - Fixed Value (new)
table.description: Throttle angle imposed when both the throttle sensor and the air flow meter are faulty.

table.name: IACV - Max. Air Flow (new)
table.description: Maximum air flow of the idle air actuator: converts the idle valve opening into an air flow, removed from the measured flow to compute the substitute throttle angle.

table.name: Multi-Spark - Spark Off Time (new)
table.description: Multiple sparks: time between the end of a spark and the next coil recharge.

table.name: Multi-Spark - Max. ECT (new)
table.description: Multiple sparks are only active below this coolant temperature (also used as a limit of the start mode).

table.name: System - Max. Battery Voltage (Multi-Spark / O2 Heater) (new)
table.description: Battery over-voltage threshold: above it, multiple sparks are disabled and the O2 sensor heating goes to minimum.

table.name: Ignition Dwell - Reduction Step (new)
table.description: Decrease of the dwell factor of a cylinder when its ignition current feedback exceeds the threshold. 0 in this file: reduction inactive.

table.name: Ignition Dwell - Minimum Factor (new)
table.description: Minimum per-cylinder dwell factor (1.0 = nominal dwell time).

table.name: Torque Model - Max. Air Mass (new)
table.description: Maximum air mass of the torque model: above this value, byte 5 of message DME1 is forced to 255.

table.name: ECT Substitute - Upper Limit (new)
table.description: Upper limit of the substitute coolant temperature used when the coolant sensor is faulty.

table.name: Ignition Feedback Diagnosis - Min. ECT (new)
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature for evaluating the ignition coil diagnosis.

table.name: Ignition Feedback Diagnosis - Max. RPM (new)
table.description: The ignition coil diagnosis is only evaluated below this engine speed.

table.name: CAN DME4 - Overheat ECT Threshold (new)
table.description: Coolant temperature from which CAN message DME4 signals overheating to the instrument cluster.

table.name: IACV - Substitute Duty (Sensor Fault) (new)
table.description: Idle valve opening imposed on a sensor fault.

table.name: Injection Timing - End Angle Max. RPM (new)
table.description: Below this engine speed, the transient end-of-injection angle 'Injection Timing - End Angle (Transient) (vs RPM) (new)' is applied.

table.name: Additive Fuel Learning - Maximum RPM (new)
table.description: Maximum engine speed for learning the additive adaptation (idle / low load zone). Complements 'Additive Fuel Learning - Maximum Load'.

table.name: DTC 52 - Debounce Step (new)
table.description: Fault 52: exhaust flap output stage. Value added to the fault counter at each check where the anomaly is present (the counter decreases by 1 when it disappears). The fault is stored when the counter reaches 'DTC 52 - Confirmation Threshold (new)'. Larger = fault detected faster.

table.name: DTC 52 - Confirmation Threshold (new)
table.description: Fault 52: exhaust flap output stage. Value the fault counter must reach (increased by 'DTC 52 - Debounce Step (new)' at each check with the anomaly, decreased by 1 otherwise) for the fault to be stored. Larger = fault takes longer to appear (and to disappear).

table.name: DTC 215 - Debounce Step (new)
table.description: Fault 215: invalid code (4 or 7) received on the three ABS/ASC intervention wires (Byte 7 bits 0-2 = 001). Value added to the fault counter at each check where the anomaly is present (the counter decreases by 1 when it disappears). The fault is stored when the counter reaches 'DTC 215 - Confirmation Threshold (new)'. Larger = fault detected faster.

table.name: DTC 215 - Confirmation Threshold (new)
table.description: Fault 215: invalid code (4 or 7) received on the three ABS/ASC intervention wires (Byte 7 bits 0-2 = 001). Value the fault counter must reach (increased by 'DTC 215 - Debounce Step (new)' at each check with the anomaly, decreased by 1 otherwise) for the fault to be stored. Larger = fault takes longer to appear (and to disappear).

table.name: DTC 219 - Debounce Step (new)
table.description: Fault 219: CAN controller in bus-off. Value added to the fault counter at each check where the anomaly is present (the counter decreases by 1 when it disappears). The fault is stored when the counter reaches 'DTC 219 - Confirmation Threshold (new)'. Larger = fault detected faster. 0 in this software: the counter never increases and code 219 is not stored.

table.name: DTC 219 - Confirmation Threshold (new)
table.description: Fault 219: CAN controller in bus-off. Value the fault counter must reach (increased by 'DTC 219 - Debounce Step (new)' at each check with the anomaly, decreased by 1 otherwise) for the fault to be stored. Larger = fault takes longer to appear (and to disappear).

table.name: DTC 12 - Debounce Step (new)
table.description: Fault 12: throttle position sensor plausibility. Value added to the fault counter at each check where the anomaly is present (the counter decreases by 1 when it disappears). The fault is stored when the counter reaches 'DTC 12 - Confirmation Threshold (new)'. Larger = fault detected faster.

table.name: DTC 12 - Confirmation Threshold (new)
table.description: Fault 12: throttle position sensor plausibility. Value the fault counter must reach (increased by 'DTC 12 - Debounce Step (new)' at each check with the anomaly, decreased by 1 otherwise) for the fault to be stored. Larger = fault takes longer to appear (and to disappear).

table.name: DTC 5, 6, 22, 23, 24, 33 - Debounce Step (new)
table.description: Fault 5, 6, 22, 23, 24, 33: injector output stages, cylinders 2, 1, 3, 6, 4, 5 (the 6 codes share this setting). Value added to the fault counter at each check where the anomaly is present (the counter decreases by 1 when it disappears). The fault is stored when the counter reaches 'DTC 5, 6, 22, 23, 24, 33 - Confirmation Threshold (new)'. Larger = fault detected faster.

table.name: DTC 5, 6, 22, 23, 24, 33 - Confirmation Threshold (new)
table.description: Fault 5, 6, 22, 23, 24, 33: injector output stages, cylinders 2, 1, 3, 6, 4, 5 (the 6 codes share this setting). Value the fault counter must reach (increased by 'DTC 5, 6, 22, 23, 24, 33 - Debounce Step (new)' at each check with the anomaly, decreased by 1 otherwise) for the fault to be stored. Larger = fault takes longer to appear (and to disappear).

table.name: DTC 209 - Debounce Step (new)
table.description: Fault 209: EWS immobiliser, code received from the EWS unit differs from the expected code (ISN). Value added to the fault counter at each check where the anomaly is present (the counter decreases by 1 when it disappears). The fault is stored when the counter reaches 'DTC 209 - Confirmation Threshold (new)'. Larger = fault detected faster.

table.name: DTC 209 - Confirmation Threshold (new)
table.description: Fault 209: EWS immobiliser, code received from the EWS unit differs from the expected code (ISN). Value the fault counter must reach (increased by 'DTC 209 - Debounce Step (new)' at each check with the anomaly, decreased by 1 otherwise) for the fault to be stored. Larger = fault takes longer to appear (and to disappear).

table.name: DTC 18 - Debounce Step (new)
table.description: Fault 18: EWS immobiliser, no answer from the EWS (status 0xFF), wrong checksum of message 0x109, or no valid message before the end of 'System - Coding Check Timer (new)'. Value added to the fault counter at each check where the anomaly is present (the counter decreases by 1 when it disappears). The fault is stored when the counter reaches 'DTC 18 - Confirmation Threshold (new)'. Larger = fault detected faster.

table.name: DTC 18 - Confirmation Threshold (new)
table.description: Fault 18: EWS immobiliser, no answer from the EWS (status 0xFF), wrong checksum of message 0x109, or no valid message before the end of 'System - Coding Check Timer (new)'. Value the fault counter must reach (increased by 'DTC 18 - Debounce Step (new)' at each check with the anomaly, decreased by 1 otherwise) for the fault to be stored. Larger = fault takes longer to appear (and to disappear).

table.name: DTC 216 - Debounce Step (new)
table.description: Fault 216: invalid EGS1 message from the automatic transmission. Value added to the fault counter at each check where the anomaly is present (the counter decreases by 1 when it disappears). The fault is stored when the counter reaches 'DTC 216 - Confirmation Threshold (new)'. Larger = fault detected faster. 0 in this software: the counter never increases and code 216 is not stored (a gear code of 9 or more is not rejected).

table.name: DTC 216 - Confirmation Threshold (new)
table.description: Fault 216: invalid EGS1 message from the automatic transmission. Value the fault counter must reach (increased by 'DTC 216 - Debounce Step (new)' at each check with the anomaly, decreased by 1 otherwise) for the fault to be stored. Larger = fault takes longer to appear (and to disappear).

table.name: DTC 57, 59 - Debounce Step (new)
table.description: Fault 57, 59: knock sensors (all cylinders of one sensor reported), above 'Knock Sensor Diagnosis - Minimum RPM (new)'. Value added to the fault counter at each check where the anomaly is present (the counter decreases by 1 when it disappears). The fault is stored when the counter reaches 'DTC 57, 59 - Confirmation Threshold (new)'. Larger = fault detected faster.

table.name: DTC 57, 59 - Confirmation Threshold (new)
table.description: Fault 57, 59: knock sensors (all cylinders of one sensor reported), above 'Knock Sensor Diagnosis - Minimum RPM (new)'. Value the fault counter must reach (increased by 'DTC 57, 59 - Debounce Step (new)' at each check with the anomaly, decreased by 1 otherwise) for the fault to be stored. Larger = fault takes longer to appear (and to disappear).

table.name: DTC 16 - Debounce Step (new)
table.description: Fault 16: A/C pressure sensor plausibility (a substitute value is then used). Value added to the fault counter at each check where the anomaly is present (the counter decreases by 1 when it disappears). The fault is stored when the counter reaches 'DTC 16 - Confirmation Threshold (new)'. Larger = fault detected faster. 0 in this software: no progressive confirmation, the fault is only confirmed on a clear anomaly that forces the counter.

table.name: DTC 16 - Confirmation Threshold (new)
table.description: Fault 16: A/C pressure sensor plausibility (a substitute value is then used). Value the fault counter must reach (increased by 'DTC 16 - Debounce Step (new)' at each check with the anomaly, decreased by 1 otherwise) for the fault to be stored. Larger = fault takes longer to appear (and to disappear).

table.name: DTC 53 - Debounce Step (new)
table.description: Fault 53: idle valve, opening winding. Value added to the fault counter at each check where the anomaly is present (the counter decreases by 1 when it disappears). The fault is stored when the counter reaches 'DTC 53 - Confirmation Threshold (new)'. Larger = fault detected faster.

table.name: DTC 53 - Confirmation Threshold (new)
table.description: Fault 53: idle valve, opening winding. Value the fault counter must reach (increased by 'DTC 53 - Debounce Step (new)' at each check with the anomaly, decreased by 1 otherwise) for the fault to be stored. Larger = fault takes longer to appear (and to disappear).

table.name: DTC 27 - Debounce Step (new)

table.description: Fault 27: idle valve, closing winding. Value the fault counter must reach (increased by 'DTC 27 - Debounce Step (new)' at each check with the anomaly, decreased by 1 otherwise) for the fault to be stored. Larger = fault takes longer to appear (and to disappear).

table.name: DTC 8 - Debounce Step (new)
table.description: Fault 8: air flow meter (HFM) plausibility; on a clear fault, the threshold is also used as the step. Value added to the fault counter at each check where the anomaly is present (the counter decreases by 1 when it disappears). The fault is stored when the counter reaches 'DTC 8 - Confirmation Threshold (new)'. Larger = fault detected faster.

table.name: DTC 8 - Confirmation Threshold (new)
table.description: Fault 8: air flow meter (HFM) plausibility; on a clear fault, the threshold is also used as the step. Value the fault counter must reach (increased by 'DTC 8 - Debounce Step (new)' at each check with the anomaly, decreased by 1 otherwise) for the fault to be stored. Larger = fault takes longer to appear (and to disappear).

table.name: DTC 25, 55 - Debounce Step (new)
table.description: Fault 25, 55: O2 sensor heating, bank 1 / bank 2. Value added to the fault counter at each check where the anomaly is present (the counter decreases by 1 when it disappears). The fault is stored when the counter reaches 'DTC 25, 55 - Confirmation Threshold (new)'. Larger = fault detected faster.

table.name: DTC 25, 55 - Confirmation Threshold (new)
table.description: Fault 25, 55: O2 sensor heating, bank 1 / bank 2. Value the fault counter must reach (increased by 'DTC 25, 55 - Debounce Step (new)' at each check with the anomaly, decreased by 1 otherwise) for the fault to be stored. Larger = fault takes longer to appear (and to disappear).

table.name: DTC 74 - Debounce Step (new)
table.description: Fault 74: A/C compressor relay. Value added to the fault counter at each check where the anomaly is present (the counter decreases by 1 when it disappears). The fault is stored when the counter reaches 'DTC 74 - Confirmation Threshold (new)'. Larger = fault detected faster.

table.name: DTC 74 - Confirmation Threshold (new)
table.description: Fault 74: A/C compressor relay. Value the fault counter must reach (increased by 'DTC 74 - Debounce Step (new)' at each check with the anomaly, decreased by 1 otherwise) for the fault to be stored. Larger = fault takes longer to appear (and to disappear).

table.description: Fault 69: fuel pump relay. Value added to the fault counter at each check where the anomaly is present (the counter decreases by 1 when it disappears). The fault is stored when the counter reaches 'DTC 69 - Confirmation Threshold (new)'. Larger = fault detected faster.

table.description: Fault 69: fuel pump relay. Value the fault counter must reach (increased by 'DTC 69 - Debounce Step (new)' at each check with the anomaly, decreased by 1 otherwise) for the fault to be stored. Larger = fault takes longer to appear (and to disappear).

table.name: DTC 75, 76 - Debounce Step (new)
table.description: Fault 75, 76: O2 sensor voltage bank 1 / bank 2 out of range (see 'Lambda - Sensor Voltage Upper Limit (new)' and 'Lambda - Sensor Voltage Lower Limit (new)'). Value added to the fault counter at each check where the anomaly is present (the counter decreases by 1 when it disappears). The fault is stored when the counter reaches 'DTC 75, 76 - Confirmation Threshold (new)'. Larger = fault detected faster.

table.name: DTC 75, 76 - Confirmation Threshold (new)
table.description: Fault 75, 76: O2 sensor voltage bank 1 / bank 2 out of range (see 'Lambda - Sensor Voltage Upper Limit (new)' and 'Lambda - Sensor Voltage Lower Limit (new)'). Value the fault counter must reach (increased by 'DTC 75, 76 - Debounce Step (new)' at each check with the anomaly, decreased by 1 otherwise) for the fault to be stored. Larger = fault takes longer to appear (and to disappear).

table.name: DTC 21, 212 - Debounce Step (new)
table.description: Fault 21, 212: VANOS solenoid (21: electrical fault) and camshaft position inconsistent with the VANOS command (212). Value added to the fault counter at each check where the anomaly is present (the counter decreases by 1 when it disappears). The fault is stored when the counter reaches 'DTC 21, 212 - Confirmation Threshold (new)'. Larger = fault detected faster.

table.name: DTC 21, 212 - Confirmation Threshold (new)
table.description: Fault 21, 212: VANOS solenoid (21: electrical fault) and camshaft position inconsistent with the VANOS command (212). Value the fault counter must reach (increased by 'DTC 21, 212 - Debounce Step (new)' at each check with the anomaly, decreased by 1 otherwise) for the fault to be stored. Larger = fault takes longer to appear (and to disappear).

table.name: DTC 1, 2, 3, 29, 30, 31 - Debounce Step (new)
table.description: Fault 1, 2, 3, 29, 30, 31: ignition coils, cylinders 2, 4, 6, 1, 3, 5 (feedback signal compared with 'Ignition Feedback Diagnosis - Min. Spark Duration (vs RPM/Load) (new)'); a faulty coil cuts the injection of its cylinder. Value added to the fault counter at each check where the anomaly is present (the counter decreases by 1 when it disappears). The fault is stored when the counter reaches 'DTC 1, 2, 3, 29, 30, 31 - Confirmation Threshold (new)'. Larger = fault detected faster.

table.name: DTC 1, 2, 3, 29, 30, 31 - Confirmation Threshold (new)
table.description: Fault 1, 2, 3, 29, 30, 31: ignition coils, cylinders 2, 4, 6, 1, 3, 5 (feedback signal compared with 'Ignition Feedback Diagnosis - Min. Spark Duration (vs RPM/Load) (new)'); a faulty coil cuts the injection of its cylinder. Value the fault counter must reach (increased by 'DTC 1, 2, 3, 29, 30, 31 - Debounce Step (new)' at each check with the anomaly, decreased by 1 otherwise) for the fault to be stored. Larger = fault takes longer to appear (and to disappear).

table.name: DTC 56 - Debounce Step (new)
table.description: Fault 56: no ignition feedback on all 6 cylinders (feedback resistor open). Value added to the fault counter at each check where the anomaly is present (the counter decreases by 1 when it disappears). The fault is stored when the counter reaches 'DTC 56 - Confirmation Threshold (new)'. Larger = fault detected faster.

table.name: DTC 56 - Confirmation Threshold (new)
table.description: Fault 56: no ignition feedback on all 6 cylinders (feedback resistor open). Value the fault counter must reach (increased by 'DTC 56 - Debounce Step (new)' at each check with the anomaly, decreased by 1 otherwise) for the fault to be stored. Larger = fault takes longer to appear (and to disappear).

table.name: DTC 202, 203 - Debounce Step and Threshold (new)
table.description: Faults 202 / 203: lambda correction at its limit, bank 1 / bank 2. This setting is used both as the counter step and as the storage threshold; larger = fault takes longer to appear.

table.name: CAN EGS1 - Message Lost Confirmation Count (new)
table.description: Number of consecutive checks without an EGS1 message (automatic transmission) before the message is considered missing (DTC 217).

table.name: Satellite Sync - Error Step (new)
table.description: Step added to the error counter at each check where the satellite microcontroller returns an inconsistent cylinder; at the cap 'Satellite Sync - Error Limit (new)': DTC 100 and fallback of the functions depending on the satellite (knock control, EWS, A/C pressure).

table.name: Satellite Sync - Error Limit (new)
table.description: Cap of the satellite synchronisation error counter; when reached: DTC 100.

table.name: Crank/Cam Signal Check - Initial Counter (new)
table.description: Start value of the crankshaft / camshaft signal check counter (DTC 83 crankshaft, 65 camshaft).

table.name: Crank/Cam Signal Check - Compare Threshold (new)
table.description: Number of edges expected in the crankshaft / camshaft signal check (DTC 83 / 65).

table.name: TPS Plausibility - Max. Deviation from Default (new)
table.description: Maximum deviation allowed between the throttle sensor reading (10-bit) and the default zero ('TPS Auto-Zero - Default Value (new)'); beyond it, the check 'TPS Plausibility - Max. Auto-Zero Deviation (new)' applies. Unit: degrees of throttle.

table.name: TPS Plausibility - Max. Auto-Zero Deviation (new)
table.description: Maximum deviation allowed between the throttle sensor reading and the learned zero before an anomaly (DTC 12). Unit: degrees of throttle.

table.name: TPS Plausibility - ADC High Limit (new)
table.description: Maximum throttle sensor reading; above it: 'out of range high' anomaly (DTC 12).

table.name: TPS Plausibility - ADC Low Limit (new)
table.description: Minimum throttle sensor reading; below it: 'out of range low' anomaly (DTC 12). Also used as a limit of the zero learning.

table.name: TPS Auto-Zero - Default Value (new)
table.description: Default throttle zero, used at initialisation and after the adaptations are cleared.

table.name: TPS Auto-Zero - Upper Offset (new)
table.description: Margin added to the learned limit of the throttle zero.

table.name: TPS Auto-Zero - Learning Rate (new)
table.description: Learning rate of the throttle zero (throttle closed).

table.name: Alpha-N Mode - Minimum TPS (new)
table.description: Throttle angle above which (part load, no throttle fault) the alpha-N load calculation is taken into account in the choice of the load calculation mode.

table.name: Alpha-N Mode - Min. Load Correction (new)
table.description: Minimum load correction (air mass per stroke) for the alpha-N mode selection.

table.name: Alpha-N Mode - Filter Coefficient (new)
table.description: Filter coefficient of the correction between the alpha-N load and the measured load.

table.name: Air Mass Plausibility - Min. TPS (new)
table.description: Throttle angle above which part of the air flow meter plausibility check is evaluated.

table.name: Air Mass Plausibility - Min. RPM (new)
table.description: Minimum engine speed for the air flow meter plausibility check.

table.name: Air Mass Plausibility - Min. IACV Opening (new)
table.description: Idle valve opening below which the air flow meter plausibility check is ignored.

table.name: TPS Gradient - Debounce Step (new)
table.description: Step of the confirmation counter of the throttle speed threshold crossings.

table.name: Lambda - Overrun Slowdown Throttle Gradient (new)
table.description: Throttle opening speed above which the lambda control is slowed (overrun slowdown), held during 'Lambda - Overrun Slowdown Hold Time (new)'.

table.name: TPS Gradient - Threshold (A/T in Drive) (new)
table.description: Throttle opening speed above which a transient is signalled (held during 'TPS Gradient - Hold Time (new)'), automatic transmission in gear.

table.name: TPS Gradient - Threshold (new)
table.description: Throttle opening speed above which a transient is signalled (held during 'TPS Gradient - Hold Time (new)'); used by the anti-jerk function.

table.name: TPS Gradient - Decrease Threshold (new)
table.description: Throttle speed threshold below which a closing is signalled (used by the limit 'Ignition Timing - Re-entry Correction (Part Load) (vs RPM/ECT) (new)').

table.name: TPS Gradient - Hold Time (new)
table.description: Hold time of the throttle transient signal after the threshold is crossed.

table.name: Lambda - Overrun Slowdown Hold Time (new)
table.description: Hold time of the lambda control slowdown after a throttle gradient above 'Lambda - Overrun Slowdown Throttle Gradient (new)'.

table.name: Full Load Detection - Min. RPM (Lambda) (new)
table.description: Minimum engine speed for full-load detection (vehicles with lambda control); 0 = no condition.

table.name: Full Load Detection - Min. RPM (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Minimum engine speed for full-load detection (vehicles without lambda control). Not read by the program of this ECU (lambda control is always active).

table.name: Full Load Detection - O2 Sensor Hold Time (new)
table.description: Hold time of the O2 sensor state after full-load detection (activation of the full-load enrichment, see 'Detection - Open Loop Enrichment').

table.name: ECT Substitute - IAT Selection Threshold (new)
table.description: Intake air temperature choosing the initial substitute coolant temperature: below it 'ECT Substitute - Initial Value (Cold IAT) (new)', above it 'ECT Substitute - Initial Value (Warm IAT / Fault) (new)'.

table.name: ECT Substitute - Initial Value (Cold IAT) (new)
table.description: Initial substitute coolant temperature when the intake air is colder than 'ECT Substitute - IAT Selection Threshold (new)'.

table.name: ECT Substitute - Initial Value (Warm IAT / Fault) (new)
table.description: Initial substitute coolant temperature when the intake air is warmer than 'ECT Substitute - IAT Selection Threshold (new)', or when the intake air sensor is faulty.

table.name: IAT Sensor - Substitute Value (new)
table.description: Substitute intake air temperature on a sensor fault (DTC 14); also the initial value at reset.

table.name: IAT Sensor - Substitute Value (Cold Engine) (new)
table.description: Substitute intake air temperature used when coolant temperature is below 'IAT Sensor - Substitute Selection ECT (new)'.

table.name: IAT Sensor - Substitute Selection ECT (new)
table.description: Coolant temperature below which 'IAT Sensor - Substitute Value (Cold Engine) (new)' is used.

table.name: IAT Sensor - Max. Change per Step (new)
table.description: Maximum allowed change of intake air temperature between two checks; beyond it, a jump is signalled.

table.name: IAT Sensor - Upper Plausibility Limit (new)
table.description: Maximum plausible intake air temperature; above it: anomaly DTC 14.

table.name: IAT Sensor - Lower Plausibility Limit (new)
table.description: Minimum plausible intake air temperature; below it: anomaly DTC 14.

table.name: ECT Sensor - Max. Change per Step (new)
table.description: Maximum allowed change of coolant temperature between two checks.

table.name: ECT Sensor - Upper Plausibility Limit (new)
table.description: Maximum plausible coolant temperature; above it: anomaly DTC 10.

table.name: ECT Sensor - Lower Plausibility Limit (new)
table.description: Minimum plausible coolant temperature; below it (with intake air above 'ECT Sensor - IAT Cross-Check Threshold (new)'): anomaly DTC 10.

table.name: ECT Sensor - IAT Cross-Check Threshold (new)
table.description: Intake air temperature above which a coolant temperature below 'ECT Sensor - Lower Plausibility Limit (new)' is considered inconsistent.

table.name: Diagnostics - Minimum Battery Voltage (new)
table.description: Minimum battery voltage for evaluating the CAN (bus-off, EGS1) and A/C diagnoses; below it, they are suspended.

table.name: Canister Purge - Max. Scale Factor (Direct Learn) (new)
table.description: Internal purge learning setting: above this factor, learning is done in steps depending on engine speed instead of a direct approach.

table.name: Canister Purge - Correction Clamp Offset (new)
table.description: Internal limit of the purge correction before its neutral value is computed. 0 in this file.

table.name: Canister Purge - Stability Threshold 1 (new)
table.description: Maximum deviation of the filtered purge quantity for the control to be considered stable (learning condition).

table.name: Canister Purge - Stability Threshold 2 (new)
table.description: Second purge stability criterion: maximum deviation of the stability calculation result.

table.name: Canister Purge - Baseline Shift Threshold (new)
table.description: Base shift of the purge correction beyond which the adjustment is applied.

table.name: Canister Purge - Learning Deviation Threshold (new)
table.description: Maximum deviation allowed during purge learning; beyond it, learning is rejected.

table.name: Canister Purge - Minimum Correction for Stability (new)
table.description: Minimum purge correction for the stability calculation to be taken into account.

table.name: Canister Purge - Lambda Factor Threshold (new)
table.description: Threshold compared with the lambda correction of both banks in the purge stability calculation (0 % = neutral correction).

table.name: Canister Purge - Max. Airflow (new)
table.description: The purge stability calculation is only done if air flow is between 'Canister Purge - Min. Airflow (new)' and this value.

table.name: Canister Purge - Min. Airflow (new)
table.description: The purge stability calculation is only done if air flow is between this value and 'Canister Purge - Max. Airflow (new)'.

table.name: Canister Purge - Timer at Start (new)
table.description: Delay armed when entering normal operation (purge coded), before the first purge phase.

table.name: Canister Purge - Phase Timer A (Lambda) (new)
table.description: Duration of the first purge phase (vehicles with lambda control).

table.name: Canister Purge - Phase Timer A (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Duration of the first purge phase (vehicles without lambda control). Not read by the program of this ECU (lambda control is always active).

table.name: Lambda Adaptation - Phase Timer (Lambda) (new)
table.description: Lambda adaptation phase timer (vehicles with lambda control).

table.name: Lambda Adaptation - Phase Timer (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Lambda adaptation phase timer (vehicles without lambda control). Not read by the program of this ECU (lambda control is always active).

table.name: Canister Purge - Confirm Counter Limit (new)
table.description: Number of stable cycles required before the purge correction is validated.

table.name: Canister Purge - Lambda Bank Select (new)
table.description: Lambda bank used for purge learning: 0 = bank 1, other value = bank 2.

table.name: Canister Purge - Adaptation Step Factor after Abort (new)
table.description: Factor applied to the purge adaptation step ('Canister Purge - Purge Level Step Up (vs Air Flow) (new)') after the purge phase is interrupted (CanisterPurge_Control_Task, word_FD3C.1); 255 = full step, the value is set back to 255 when soft timer B8 expires.

table.name: Canister Purge - Stability Filter (new)
table.description: Filter coefficient of the purge stability value (1 = no filtering, smaller = smoother).

table.name: Canister Purge - Air Mass Addend at Idle (new)
table.description: Air mass addend of the canister purge at idle; beyond it, the purge phase is interrupted.

table.name: Canister Purge - Mode Flag Upper Limit (new)
table.description: Upper limit of the purge target for the validation step.

table.name: Canister Purge - Mode Flag Lower Limit (new)
table.description: Lower limit of the purge target for the validation step.

table.name: Canister Purge - RPM Adjustment Enable (new)
table.description: 0 = no adjustment of the purge correction as a function of engine speed; other value = adjustment factor.

table.name: Canister Purge - Min. Cell Learn Count (new)
table.description: Minimum number of learnings of an adaptation cell before its value is used.

table.name: Canister Purge - Minimum ECT (new)
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature to enable canister purge.

table.name: Canister Purge - Hold Time After Switch (new)
table.description: Delay armed after each purge phase change.

table.name: Lambda - Controller Reset Value (new)
table.description: Correction value written when the lambda control of a bank is reset (0 % = neutral).

table.name: Lambda - Min. Airflow for Heater Check (new)
table.description: Air flow above which the O2 sensors are evaluated even with a heater fault.

table.name: Lambda - Switch Monitor Timer (new)
table.description: Monitoring timer of the O2 sensor switches.

table.name: Lambda - Limit Reset Delay (new)
table.description: Number of lambda probe switching events the per-bank lambda correction may stay at its upper or lower limit before the controller is reset. When the correction first reaches a limit, a per-bank countdown is loaded with this value (and the grace counter with 'Lambda Bounds Grace Counter'). At each further probe switching event with the correction still at the limit, the countdown is decremented (only while the adaptation cell value is zero). When it reaches zero, the lambda controller is re-initialized with the seed value (warm or cold, selected by start coolant temperature), the reset counter is reloaded and the lambda control limit fault (DTC 202/203) is debounced. The countdown is restarted when the correction leaves the limit.

table.name: Lambda - Bounds Grace Counter (new)
table.description: Delay, with the lambda correction at its limit, before the 'lambda control limit reached' diagnosis (DTC 202/203). Unit: x 20 ms.

table.name: Lambda - Operating Point Stability Threshold (new)
table.description: Maximum engine speed deviation from the stored operating point for the point to be considered stable (condition of lambda control and adaptation).

table.name: Lambda - Operating Point Stability Load Band (new)
table.description: Maximum load deviation from the stored operating point for the point to be considered stable.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Adaptation Factor Max. (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: maximum adaptation factor (1.0 = neutral).

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Adaptation Factor Min. (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: minimum adaptation factor (1.0 = neutral).

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Signal Center Reference (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: reference of the sensor signal centre (mean of the rich and lean peaks). Centre above = more heating, below = less. Voltage read directly on the sensor input (AN6 bank 1, AN7 bank 2): titania sensors supplied with 5 V, about 4.6 V lean and 0.1 V rich.

table.name: Lambda - Stability Average Weight (new)
table.description: Averaging weight of an internal lambda stability quantity (used during canister purge).

table.name: Lambda - Adaptation Min. Switch Count (new)
table.description: Minimum number of sensor switches before the lambda adaptations are learned, outside idle.

table.name: Lambda - Adaptation Min. Switch Count (Idle) (new)
table.description: Minimum number of sensor switches before the lambda adaptations are learned, at idle.

table.name: Lambda - Adaptation Step (Part Load) (new)
table.description: Learning step of the lambda adaptations at part load.

table.name: Lambda - Adaptation Step (After Reset) (new)
table.description: Learning step applied once after the adaptations are reset. 0 in this file.

table.name: Lambda - Adaptation Step (Idle) (new)
table.description: Learning step of the lambda adaptations at idle.

table.name: Lambda - Adaptation Step (Purge Active) (new)
table.description: Learning step of the lambda adaptations when canister purge is active; 0 = no learning during purge.

table.name: Lambda - Reset Counter Init (new)
table.description: Internal initial value of the reset counters of both lambda banks.

table.name: Lambda PI - Idle Fixed-Value Switch Delay (new)
table.description: Number of lambda proportional jumps (probe switching events) made with the normal P/I maps after the engine enters the idle state, before the lambda controller switches to the fixed idle P/I values (CAL_02AD/02AE/02B0/02B1). The per-bank counter is loaded with this value on the first switching event in idle and decremented at each proportional jump; when it reaches zero, the fixed values are used for the rest of the idle phase. Leaving idle returns to the maps and re-arms the counter. 0 = fixed values are used immediately in idle.

table.name: Lambda - Sensor Ready Init (Bank 1) (new)
table.description: Number of sensor switches expected, after the end of heating, before the signal centre calculation is allowed (applies to both banks).

table.name: Lambda - Mode Init (Bank 1) (new)
table.description: Initial voltage offset of the sensor rich threshold, bank 1 (bank 2 uses the next byte). Voltage read directly on the sensor input (AN6 bank 1, AN7 bank 2): titania sensors supplied with 5 V, about 4.6 V lean and 0.1 V rich.

table.name: Lambda PI - I Multiplier Bank 1 (new)
table.description: Multiplier (1.0 = 256) of the integral slope of the bank 1 lambda control ('STFT - Neg I (new)' / 'STFT - Pos I (new)' or fixed values).

table.name: Lambda PI - I Multiplier Bank 2 (new)
table.description: Multiplier (1.0 = 256) of the integral slope of the bank 2 lambda control.

table.name: Lambda PI - P Multiplier (new)
table.description: Multiplier (1.0 = 256) of the proportional jump of the lambda control of both banks ('STFT - Neg P (new)' / 'STFT - Pos P (new)' or fixed values).

table.name: Lambda PI - Idle Fixed I (Neg) (new)
table.description: Fixed integral slope, Neg direction, used at idle instead of the corresponding lambda PI map ('STFT - Neg I (new)') once the number of switching events set by 'Lambda PI - Idle Fixed-Value Switch Delay' has elapsed in the idle state (immediately if that value is 0). Multiplied by the per-bank I multiplier (and by the coolant-temperature factor when active) before being applied to the lambda correction.

table.name: Lambda PI - Idle Fixed P (Neg) (new)
table.description: Fixed proportional jump, Neg direction, used at idle instead of the corresponding lambda PI map ('STFT - Neg P (new)') once the number of switching events set by 'Lambda PI - Idle Fixed-Value Switch Delay' has elapsed in the idle state (immediately if that value is 0). Multiplied by the P multiplier (and by the coolant-temperature factor when active) before being applied to the lambda correction.

table.name: Lambda PI - Idle Fixed I (Pos) (new)
table.description: Fixed integral slope, Pos direction, used at idle instead of the corresponding lambda PI map ('STFT - Pos I (new)') once the number of switching events set by 'Lambda PI - Idle Fixed-Value Switch Delay' has elapsed in the idle state (immediately if that value is 0). Multiplied by the per-bank I multiplier (and by the coolant-temperature factor when active) before being applied to the lambda correction.

table.name: Lambda PI - Idle Fixed P (Pos) (new)
table.description: Fixed proportional jump, Pos direction, used at idle instead of the corresponding lambda PI map ('STFT - Pos P (new)') once the number of switching events set by 'Lambda PI - Idle Fixed-Value Switch Delay' has elapsed in the idle state (immediately if that value is 0). Multiplied by the P multiplier (and by the coolant-temperature factor when active) before being applied to the lambda correction.

table.name: Lambda - Seed Selection ECT (new)
table.description: Coolant temperature choosing the initialisation value of the sensor lean threshold: below it 'Lambda - Seed Value (Cold) (new)', above it 'Lambda - Seed Value (Warm) (new)'.

table.name: Lambda - Seed Value (Warm) (new)
table.description: Initial value of the sensor lean threshold, warm engine. Voltage read directly on the sensor input (AN6 bank 1, AN7 bank 2): titania sensors supplied with 5 V, about 4.6 V lean and 0.1 V rich.

table.name: Lambda - Seed Value (Cold) (new)
table.description: Initial value of the sensor lean threshold, cold engine. Voltage read directly on the sensor input (AN6 bank 1, AN7 bank 2): titania sensors supplied with 5 V, about 4.6 V lean and 0.1 V rich.

table.name: Lambda Tracker - Decrement Step (new)
table.description: Decrease step of the sensor rich threshold offset. Voltage read directly on the sensor input (AN6 bank 1, AN7 bank 2): titania sensors supplied with 5 V, about 4.6 V lean and 0.1 V rich.

table.name: Lambda - Min. Detection Band Width (new)
table.description: Minimum width of the sensor detection band (difference between lean and rich thresholds). If the band stays narrower, a counter loaded with 254 counts down; at 0: sensor anomaly DTC 200 (bank 1) / 201 (bank 2). 51 = 1.0 V in this software. Voltage read directly on the sensor input (AN6 bank 1, AN7 bank 2): titania sensors supplied with 5 V, about 4.6 V lean and 0.1 V rich.

table.name: Lambda - Detection Band Factor Upper (new)
table.description: Factor of the upper limit of the sensor rich/lean detection band.

table.name: Lambda - Detection Band Factor Lower (new)
table.description: Factor of the lower limit of the sensor rich/lean detection band.

table.name: Lambda Tracker - Band Offset (new)
table.description: Difference between the signal peaks and the switching thresholds: lean threshold = lean peak + value, rich threshold = rich peak - value. Voltage read directly on the sensor input (AN6 bank 1, AN7 bank 2): titania sensors supplied with 5 V, about 4.6 V lean and 0.1 V rich.

table.name: Lambda - Band Reset Value (new)
table.description: Value reloaded into the detection band after a band width anomaly. Voltage read directly on the sensor input (AN6 bank 1, AN7 bank 2): titania sensors supplied with 5 V, about 4.6 V lean and 0.1 V rich.

table.name: Lambda - Sensor Voltage Upper Limit (new)
table.description: Sensor voltage above which the sample is abnormal (DTC 75/76). Voltage read directly on the sensor input (AN6 bank 1, AN7 bank 2): titania sensors supplied with 5 V, about 4.6 V lean and 0.1 V rich.

table.name: Lambda - Sensor Voltage Lower Limit (new)
table.description: Sensor voltage below which the sample is abnormal after heating (DTC 75/76). Voltage read directly on the sensor input (AN6 bank 1, AN7 bank 2): titania sensors supplied with 5 V, about 4.6 V lean and 0.1 V rich.

table.name: Lambda Tracker - Filter Coefficient (new)
table.description: Filter coefficient of the sensor threshold tracking.

table.name: Lambda Diagnosis - Min. Switch Count (new)
table.description: Sensor ageing diagnosis: minimum number of switches for the evaluation in deceleration.

table.name: Lambda Diagnosis - Max. Rich Peak Voltage (new)
table.description: Sensor ageing diagnosis: maximum rich peak for the evaluation. Voltage read directly on the sensor input (AN6 bank 1, AN7 bank 2): titania sensors supplied with 5 V, about 4.6 V lean and 0.1 V rich.

table.name: Lambda Diagnosis - Max. O2 Heater Duty (new)
table.description: Sensor ageing diagnosis: heater duty cycle below which an ageing sensor (low rich peak, many switches) activates the catalyst protection.

table.name: Catalyst Protection - Activation Delay (new)
table.description: Delay before catalyst protection mode is activated. When the catalyst-protection activation conditions are met (engine load above the activation map threshold with the lambda probes switching normally, or the coolant-temperature activation path), the catalyst-protection request bits are set. If this value is 0, the protection-active flag is set immediately; otherwise the value is loaded into a 1 s soft timer (only if it is not already running) and the flag is set when the timer expires. While the flag is set, closed-loop lambda control is suspended (controller state reset) and the catalyst-protection fuel factor is applied during rev/speed limiter cuts. The pending timer is cancelled if the conditions disappear. At expiry, the 'Lambda Diagnosis Hold Time' timer is also started when the load-based path is active.

table.name: Lambda Diagnosis - Hold Time (new)
table.description: Delay armed at the end of the sensor diagnosis evaluation.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Full Power Time (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: full-power heating time after the condensation phase, before the sensors are activated.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Initial State Timer (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: delay armed at the end of the condensation phase, before the initial control state.

table.name: O2 Heater - Duty Update Period (new)
table.description: Execution period of the O2 sensor heater duty update task. The value is loaded into a 1 s soft timer at start-up; at each expiry the timer callback posts the heater duty update task (task 2 of the background task table) to the low-priority queue and reloads the timer with this value. Smaller values update the heater duty more often.

table.name: Ignition Timing - ECT Weight (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Coolant temperature weighting factor of the ignition correction, vehicles without lambda control. Not read by the program of this ECU (lambda control is always active).

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Upper Limit (new)
table.description: Idle air adaptation, A/C off: upper limit of the learned value.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Upper Limit (A/C on) (new)
table.description: Idle air adaptation, A/C engaged: upper limit of the learned value.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Lower Limit (new)
table.description: Idle air adaptation, A/C off: lower limit of the learned value.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Lower Limit (A/C on) (new)
table.description: Idle air adaptation, A/C engaged: lower limit of the learned value.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Min. ECT (new)
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature for the idle air adaptation, A/C off.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Min. ECT (A/C on) (new)
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature for the idle air adaptation, A/C engaged.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Max. Deviation (new)
table.description: Maximum deviation between the filtered value and the idle speed control; beyond it, idle air learning is suspended.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Settle Threshold (new)
table.description: Engine speed stability threshold before idle air learning.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Settle Delay (new)
table.description: Number of stable checks required before the idle air learning is validated. Unit: x 40 ms.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Filter Coefficient (new)
table.description: Filter coefficient of the value used for idle air learning.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Gain (new)
table.description: Gain applied to the candidate value of the idle air learning.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Max. ECT (new)
table.description: Coolant temperature limit for idle air learning (vehicle stopped).

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - EEPROM Save Factor (new)
table.description: Factor applied to the 'A/C engaged' adaptation before it is saved to EEPROM.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Zone Offset (new)
table.description: Offset added to the zone result of the idle air adaptation.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation Diagnosis - Lower Margin (new)
table.description: Idle air adaptation diagnosis: lower margin. 0 in this file.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation Diagnosis - Upper Margin (new)
table.description: Idle air adaptation diagnosis: upper margin; 255 = check inactive.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation Diagnosis - Result Limit (new)
table.description: Idle air adaptation diagnosis: limit beyond which an anomaly is reported; 255 = never.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation Diagnosis - Filter Factor (new)
table.description: Idle air adaptation diagnosis: filter factor.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation Diagnosis - Load Offset (new)
table.description: Idle air adaptation diagnosis: air flow offset added to the corrected value.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Accumulator Step (new)
table.description: Rate at which the integral term of the idle speed control approaches the adapted value.

table.name: Idle Speed Control - Moving Integrator Limits Delay (new)
table.description: Delay after the vehicle starts moving before the idle speed controller switches its integrator limits from the 'vehicle stopped' set to the 'vehicle moving' set (or the 'vehicle moving with AC on' set when the compressor is engaged). Loaded into a 10 ms soft timer when vehicle speed becomes non-zero; when it expires, the moving-vehicle limits are used. If a bypass condition flag is set, the moving limits are used immediately. When vehicle speed returns to zero, the stopped limits are used again at once.

table.name: ISR - Derivative - Min. Time (new)
table.description: Minimum active time of the idle speed control derivative term after an engine speed drop below 'Intercept - RPM'.

table.name: Idle Speed - RPM Drop Threshold (new)
table.description: Engine speed drop, relative to the return-to-idle reference speed, beyond which 'Idle Speed - RPM Drop Hold Time (new)' is armed.

table.name: Idle Speed - RPM Rise Threshold (new)
table.description: Engine speed rise, relative to the return-to-idle reference speed, beyond which the second correction mode is activated. 0 in this file.

table.name: Idle Speed - RPM Drop Hold Time (new)
table.description: Delay armed after an engine speed drop larger than 'Idle Speed - RPM Drop Threshold (new)'.

table.name: Idle Speed - RPM Error Ramp Offset (new)
table.description: Offset added to the stored speed error to compute the idle exit threshold.

table.name: Idle Speed - RPM Error Integrator Min. (new)
table.description: Lower limit of the speed error integrator used on return to idle (0 = neutral).

table.name: Idle Speed - RPM Error Integrator Gain (new)
table.description: Gain of the speed error integrator used on return to idle.

table.name: Idle Speed - RPM Error Ramp Rate (new)
table.description: Slope of the speed error ramp when the filtered error is strongly negative.

table.name: Idle Speed - Target Rise Rate (new)
table.description: Maximum rise rate of the target idle speed (per calculation, every 10 ms).

table.name: Idle Speed - Voltage Interpolation Max. RPM (new)
table.description: Below this engine speed (engine running), a battery voltage dependent value is filtered and taken into account in the target idle speed calculation.

table.name: Idle Speed - Voltage Interpolation Rate (new)
table.description: Filter coefficient of the battery voltage dependent value used by the target idle speed (below 'Idle Speed - Voltage Interpolation Max. RPM (new)').

table.name: K-Line - Idle Speed Offset Max. (new)
table.description: Maximum idle offset accepted when the idle speed is adjusted with the diagnostic tester (K-line).

table.name: K-Line - Idle Speed Adjust Min. ECT (new)
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature to accept an idle speed adjustment with the tester (engine idling, automatic transmission not in gear).

table.name: K-Line - CO Adjust Min. ECT (new)
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature to accept a CO adjustment with the tester (vehicles without lambda control), at idle and with no stored fault.

table.name: IACV - AC Ramp Initial Value (new)
table.description: Start value of the ramp applying the A/C opening (see 'IACV - AC Compressor Ramp-in Rate (vs RPM) (new)').

table.name: IACV - Rate Limit Step (new)
table.description: Rate limiter of the idle valve target: maximum change step.

table.name: IACV - Rate Limit Deadband (new)
table.description: Rate limiter of the idle valve target: dead band.

table.name: IACV - Rate Limit Tolerance (new)
table.description: Rate limiter of the idle valve target: tolerance around the A/C pre-control.

table.name: IACV - Map Rise Step (new)
table.description: Maximum rise rate of the pre-control from 'IACV - TPS', per idle control calculation.

table.name: IACV - Map Fall Step (new)
table.description: Maximum fall rate of the pre-control from 'IACV - TPS', per idle control calculation.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Fuel Cut Offset (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heater: duty offset applied during overrun fuel cut.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Overrun Duty Step (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: change step towards 'O2 Sensor Heater - Overrun Duty (vs RPM) (new)' during overrun fuel cut.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Condensation Phase Factor (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: factor applied to the base duty cycle during the condensation phase.

table.name: Fuel - Injection Time Decrement Limit (new)
table.description: Maximum decrease of the injection time from one calculation to the next in some phases (limits sudden drops).

table.name: Rev Limiter - Catalyst Protection Fuel Factor (new)
