table.description: value subtracted from the score after a window that is not hard use (0 = the score never decreases).

table.name: Byte 4
table.description: Raw value of coding byte 4 (stock 0x26 = 38). See 'Byte 4 - A/C and VANOS (new)'.

table.name: Byte 5
table.description: Raw value of coding byte 5 (stock 0xAC = 172). See 'Byte 5 - Transmission (new)'.

table.name: Byte 6 - O2 Feedback

state.name: Lambda control - 1 sensor, auto-detection + CAN monitoring (0x38)
Lambda control - 2 sensors, auto-detection + CAN monitoring (0x3C)
No lambda control (engine without catalyst) + CAN monitoring (0x24)

table.description: Lambda configuration (bits 2-4 of coding byte 6). Bit 5 set: CAN monitoring forced on (see 'Byte 6 - CAN Monitoring / EWS Input (new)').

table.name: Byte 7
table.description: Raw value of coding byte 7 (stock 0x09 = 9). See 'Byte 7 - ABS/ASC / Purge / CRC (new)'.

table.name: Byte 8
table.description: Raw value of coding byte 8 (stock 0x0F = 15). See 'Byte 8 - OBD / EWS (new)'.

table.name: CH - Duration - Idle Speed Target Increase
table.description: Catalyst heating (CH): function active after a cold start. Time after start, as a function of coolant temperature at start, during which the target idle speed is raised (LoadSnapshot_And_SecondaryTargets).

table.name: CH - Idle Speed Target Offset (new)
table.description: Fixed addition to the target idle speed during catalyst heating. Stock value: 20 rpm.

table.name: CH - Duration - Ignition Retard
table.description: Catalyst heating (CH): function active after a cold start. Time after start of the heating ignition retard. Setting it to zero also removes the heating enrichment (LoadSnapshot_And_SecondaryTargets).

table.name: CH - Duration - Fuel Enrichment
table.description: Catalyst heating (CH): function active after a cold start. Time after start of the heating enrichment (LoadSnapshot_And_SecondaryTargets).

table.name: CH - Fuel Enrichment - Multiplicative (Idle)
table.description: Catalyst heating (CH): function active after a cold start. Factor (1.0 = 128) applied to 'CH - Fuel Enrichment - Nominal' at idle; the result, plus 'CH - Fuel Enrichment - Additive', gives the heating enrichment factor.

table.name: CH - Fuel Enrichment - Multiplicative (above Idle)
table.description: Catalyst heating (CH): function active after a cold start. Factor (1.0 = 128) applied to 'CH - Fuel Enrichment - Nominal' above idle; the result, plus 'CH - Fuel Enrichment - Additive', gives the heating enrichment factor.

table.name: CH - Fuel Enrichment - Nominal
table.description: Catalyst heating (CH): function active after a cold start. Base injection time correction factor (engine speed x load, RPM_Load_ScaledCorrection_Calc), multiplied by one of the 'Multiplicative' tables then increased by 'Additive'.

table.name: CH - Fuel Enrichment - Additive
table.description: Catalyst heating (CH): function active after a cold start. Catalyst heating base factor (0.5 to 1.5) combined with the multiplied nominal enrichment, as a function of coolant temperature and time after start.

table.name: COP - Fuel Enrichment - Nominal
table.description: Catalyst overheating protection (COP): high-load enrichment when ignition advance is reduced. Base correction factor (engine speed x load), added to 'COP - Fuel Enrichment - Additive'. The result cannot be negative: all zeros removes the protection (only without a catalyst).

table.name: COP - Fuel Enrichment - Additive
table.description: Catalyst overheating protection (COP): high-load enrichment when ignition advance is reduced. Signed factor (128 = 0) added to the nominal enrichment, as a function of the ignition correction. Cannot make the total negative.

table.name: COP - Fuel Enrichment - Step Size
table.description: Catalyst overheating protection (COP): high-load enrichment when ignition advance is reduced. Maximum change of the COP enrichment per calculation, up or down, to avoid mixture steps.

table.name: COP - Minimum Load
table.description: Catalyst overheating protection (COP): high-load enrichment when ignition advance is reduced. Minimum load (as a function of engine speed and ignition correction) to activate the protection. At maximum: protection disabled.

table.name: COP - Minimum Load Hystersis
table.description: Catalyst overheating protection (COP): high-load enrichment when ignition advance is reduced. Hysteresis of the minimum load threshold.

table.name: COP - Minimum Ignition Correction
table.description: Catalyst overheating protection (COP): high-load enrichment when ignition advance is reduced. The protection is only active when the ignition correction (knock and ECT/IAT compensations) is below this value.

table.name: Lambda Integrator - Minimum Limit
table.description: Lower limit of the per-bank lambda controller factor (Lambda_PerBank_ComputeBounds / Lambda_PerBank_SwitchTracker); also used as the limit of the tester CO adjustment (K-line 0x41 sub-command 1, vehicle without lambda) and for the reset of both banks (Lambda_DualInstance_Reset).

table.name: Lambda Integrator - Maximum Limit
table.description: Upper limit of the per-bank lambda controller factor (Lambda_PerBank_ComputeBounds / Lambda_PerBank_SwitchTracker); also used as the limit of the tester CO adjustment (K-line 0x41/1) and for the reset (Lambda_DualInstance_Reset).

table.name: Adaptation Multiplicative - Minimum Limit
table.description: Lower limit of the multiplicative adaptation of each bank (Lambda_ScaledAdjust_Bounded) and of the value read back from EEPROM (Lambda_RestoreOnBoot).

table.name: Adaptation Multiplicative - Maximum Limit
table.description: Upper limit of the multiplicative adaptation of each bank (Lambda_ScaledAdjust_Bounded) and of the value read back from EEPROM (Lambda_RestoreOnBoot).

table.name: Adaptation Additive - Minimum Limit
table.description: Lower limit of the additive adaptation of each bank (Lambda_PerBank_RateCalc_Clamped, Lambda_ScaledAdjust_RPM) and of the value read back from EEPROM (Lambda_RestoreOnBoot).

table.name: Adaptation Additive - Maximum Limit
table.description: Upper limit of the additive adaptation of each bank (Lambda_PerBank_RateCalc_Clamped, Lambda_ScaledAdjust_RPM). Also applied to the value read back from EEPROM at start-up (Lambda_RestoreOnBoot).

table.name: Adaptation Multiplicative - Warm-up Compensation
table.description: Weighting factor (as a function of the multiplicative adaptation and of temperature) applied to the learned multiplicative adaptation to reduce its effect while coolant temperature is below 'Adaptive Fuel Learning - Minimum ECT' (Lambda_CombineControllerAndAdaptation, computed by ECT_Dependent_Params_Update).

table.name: Adaptation Additive - Warm-up Compensation
table.description: Weighting factor applied to the learned additive adaptation to reduce its effect while coolant temperature is below 'Adaptive Fuel Learning - Minimum ECT' (Lambda_CombineControllerAndAdaptation).

table.name: Adaptive Fuel Learning - Minimum ECT
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature for learning the lambda adaptations; below it, the learned adaptations are weighted by the 'Warm-up Compensation' tables (Lambda_CombineControllerAndAdaptation).

table.name: Adaptive Fuel Learning - Maximum IAT
table.description: Maximum intake air temperature for learning the lambda adaptations (Lambda_Adaptation_Update). Above it, neither additive nor multiplicative adaptation is learned.

table.name: Adaptive Fuel Learning - Maximum MAF
table.description: Maximum air flow for learning the lambda adaptations (Lambda_Adaptation_Update).

table.name: Additive Fuel Learning - Maximum Load
table.description: Maximum load of the additive adaptation learning zone (low load / idle), Lambda_Adaptation_Update.

table.name: Multiplicative Fuel Learning - Minimum RPM
table.description: Minimum engine speed for learning the multiplicative adaptation (part load), Lambda_Adaptation_Update.

table.name: Multiplicative Fuel Learning - Minimum Load
table.description: Minimum load of the multiplicative adaptation learning zone (part load), Lambda_Adaptation_Update.

table.name: Closed Loop - Minimum RPM
table.description: Minimum engine speed for closed-loop lambda control (Lambda_PerBank_SwitchTracker). Name in the BMW software: C_LAM_N_MIN.

table.name: Closed Loop - Minimum Coolant Temperature - Idle
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature for closed-loop lambda control at idle (read without interpolation).

table.name: Closed Loop - Minimum Coolant Temperature - Above Idle
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature for closed-loop lambda control above idle (read without interpolation).

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS
table.description: Throttle tip-in enrichment (TPS_AccelEnrichment_Initiate / _DecayCalc). Factor (1.0 = 128) as a function of coolant temperature and throttle gradient. On the first trigger the value is multiplied by 'Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Initial'; on following triggers of the same session, by the stored value. The result, shifted into the enrichment sum (1.0 = 4096), is added like the full-load enrichment.

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Initial
table.description: Factor (x/256) applied to the initial enrichment computed by 'Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS', as a function of load, read without interpolation (Table_LookupValue_NoInterp) by TPS_AccelEnrichment_Initiate.

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Deactivation Duration
table.description: Throttle tip-in enrichment (TPS_AccelEnrichment_Initiate / _DecayCalc). On the first trigger the value is multiplied by 'Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Initial'; on following triggers of the same session, by the stored value. Duration of the progressive decay of the enrichment. Larger = smoother decay (useful with narrower-spray injectors, less wall wetting). Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment (engine task run at each ignition).

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Session Duration
table.description: Throttle tip-in enrichment (TPS_AccelEnrichment_Initiate / _DecayCalc). On the first trigger the value is multiplied by 'Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Initial'; on following triggers of the same session, by the stored value. Set on the first trigger then decremented by 1 per cycle; while it is not 0, a new trigger is handled as 'following', afterwards as 'first'. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment (engine task run at each ignition).

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Timer Initial Value
table.description: Throttle tip-in enrichment (TPS_AccelEnrichment_Initiate / _DecayCalc). On the first trigger the value is multiplied by 'Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Initial'; on following triggers of the same session, by the stored value. Start value of the counter armed at each trigger, decremented at each cycle. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment (engine task run at each ignition).

table.name: Detection - Increasing TPS
table.description: Throttle opening gradient threshold (as a function of engine speed and throttle angle): if the throttle opens faster than this threshold + 'Detection - Increasing TPS (ECT Compensation)', the acceleration enrichments are applied (Threshold_Crossing_Debounced_E8D0).

table.name: Detection - Increasing TPS (ECT Compensation)
table.description: Signed term added, depending on coolant temperature, to the 'Detection - Increasing TPS' threshold.

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Initial
table.description: Load increase enrichment (PerInstance_RPM_Load_Init / _Calc_C). Initial enrichment on the first trigger. If the MAF curve represents the real load well, these tables normally do not need changes on a naturally aspirated engine with the stock manifold. Name in the BMW software: IP_TI_FAC_AE(_AT)__N_32__MAF.

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Nominal
table.description: Load increase enrichment (PerInstance_RPM_Load_Init / _Calc_C). Factor applied to the initial enrichment (and, on re-trigger, to one of the 'Reduction Gradient' tables), as a function of the ratio load at trigger / current load. Name in the BMW software: IP_TI_FAC_TRA_AE(_AT)__MAF_RATIO_AE__TCO.

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Initial Session Denominator
table.description: Load increase enrichment (PerInstance_RPM_Load_Init / _Calc_C). Session denominator, set on the first trigger; a counter starts at 0 and advances at each cycle. While 1 - counter/denominator stays below the re-trigger duration, a new first trigger is possible if load increases. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment (engine task run at each ignition). Name in the BMW software: IP_TI_CYCNR_AE(_AT)__N_32__TCO.

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Reduction Gradient (Low ECT)
table.description: Load increase enrichment (PerInstance_RPM_Load_Init / _Calc_C). Reduction slope used when coolant temperature is below the threshold 'Fuel - Correction Table ECT Threshold (new)' (0x21C). Axis: remaining fraction of the session (255 - elapsed time x 256 / total time), x/256. Name in the BMW software: IP_TI_FAC_1_AE_RST(_AT)__CYC.

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Reduction Gradient (Normal ECT)
table.description: Load increase enrichment (PerInstance_RPM_Load_Init / _Calc_C). Reduction slope used when coolant temperature is at or above the threshold 'Fuel - Correction Table ECT Threshold (new)' (0x21C). Axis: remaining fraction of the session (255 - elapsed time x 256 / total time), x/256. Name in the BMW software: IP_TI_FAC_2_AE_RST(_AT)__CYC.

table.name: Fuel Restore - RPM
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Engine speed (as a function of coolant temperature) below which injection is always active. Raising it removes the closed-throttle overrun fuel cut.

table.name: Fuel Restore - RPM (AC on)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Engine speed (as a function of coolant temperature) below which injection is always active, A/C compressor engaged.

table.name: Fuel Cut - RPM Hysteresis (Maximum)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Above 'Fuel Restore - RPM' + this hysteresis, injection is cut with the throttle closed (immediately if a fast closing is detected, otherwise after a progressive ignition retard). Hysteresis used just after a fuel cut.

table.name: Fuel Cut - RPM Hysteresis (Minimum)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Hysteresis used once the 'Fuel Cut - Hysteresis Delay Counter' has elapsed.

table.name: Fuel Cut - Hysteresis Delay Counter
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Number of segments outside fuel cut after which the hysteresis changes from the maximum to the minimum value. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment (engine task run at each ignition). Counted only outside fuel cut.

table.name: Fuel Cut - RPM Hysteresis (below ECT Threshold)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Cut-off hysteresis used instead of 'Fuel Cut - RPM Hysteresis (Maximum)' when coolant temperature at start was below 'Fuel Cut - Hysteresis - ECT Threshold'.

table.name: Fuel Cut - Hysteresis Delay Counter (below ECT Threshold)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Counter used instead of 'Fuel Cut - Hysteresis Delay Counter' when coolant temperature at start was below 'Fuel Cut - Hysteresis - ECT Threshold'. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment (engine task run at each ignition). Counted only outside fuel cut.

table.name: Fuel Cut - Hysteresis - ECT Threshold
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Coolant temperature at start below which the '(below ECT Threshold)' tables are used.

table.name: Fuel Enleanment - Decreasing TPS
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Enleanment factor on throttle closing (engine speed x air flow), multiplied by 'Fuel Enleanment - Decreasing TPS - Multiplicative'. On following triggers of the session, the value of the first trigger is reused.

table.name: Fuel Enleanment - Decreasing TPS - Multiplicative
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Factor of the closing enleanment, as a function of the ratio current load / load at trigger and of coolant temperature (Deceleration_Enleanment_SessionTimer).

table.name: Fuel Enleanment - Decreasing TPS - Session Duration
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Duration of an enleanment session, in ignitions (the counter advances by 1 at each ignition, every 120 crank degrees), as a function of engine speed and coolant temperature. Duration in seconds = value x 20 / engine speed (e.g. 250 at 3000 rpm = 1.7 s). Main table of the rev-hang effect after lifting off. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment (engine task run at each ignition).

table.name: Fuel Enleanment - Decreasing TPS - Deactivation Factor
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Decay factor of the enleanment during the session, as a function of the session counter; the first value (counter 0) must stay 0. Axis: remaining fraction of the session (255 - elapsed time x 256 / total time), x/256.

table.name: Ignition Retard - Decreasing TPS
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Ignition retard applied progressively when the throttle closes, or with closed throttle below 'Fuel Restore - RPM' + hysteresis (IgnTiming_Accumulate_Corrections).

table.name: Ignition Retard - Decreasing TPS (Closed)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Retard applied progressively with closed throttle above 'Fuel Restore - RPM' + hysteresis; once reached, injection can be cut.

table.name: Ignition Retard - Decreasing TPS (Closed) (AC on)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Retard applied progressively with closed throttle above 'Fuel Restore - RPM' + hysteresis, A/C compressor engaged; once reached, injection can be cut.

table.name: Ignition Retard - Decreasing TPS - Step Size (ECT Compensation)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Term (coolant temperature) added to the step 'Ignition Retard - Decreasing TPS - Step Size'.

table.name: Ignition Retard - Decreasing TPS - Step Size
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Ignition rate-limit step on slow throttle closing (engine speed x load), added to the ECT compensation term (RPM_Load_Correction_WithDecay).

table.name: Ignition Retard - Fast Decreasing TPS (Closed)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Retard applied immediately (without ramp) on fast throttle closing above 'Fuel Restore - RPM' + hysteresis; only if the fast closing is detected.

table.name: Detection - Decreasing TPS
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Throttle closing gradient threshold (as a function of engine speed and throttle angle), as a positive magnitude; beyond this threshold + ECT compensation, the deceleration tables are applied (Threshold_Crossing_Debounced_E8D0).

table.name: Detection - Decreasing TPS (ECT Compensation)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Signed term added, depending on coolant temperature, to the 'Detection - Decreasing TPS' threshold.

table.name: Detection - Fast Decreasing TPS - Min. Throttle Gradient
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Throttle closing gradient (positive magnitude) beyond which the fast closing can be detected (all 'Fast Decreasing TPS' conditions must be met).

table.name: Detection - Fast Decreasing TPS - Min. RPM
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Fast closing condition: engine speed above this value, or engine speed gradient above 'Min. RPM Gradient'.

table.name: Detection - Fast Decreasing TPS - Min. RPM Gradient
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Fast closing condition: engine speed gradient above this value, or engine speed above 'Min. RPM'.

table.name: Detection - Fast Decreasing TPS - Min. Load
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Minimum load (as a function of engine speed) for fast closing detection.

table.name: Detection - Fast Decreasing TPS - Min. Load Difference
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Minimum load drop for fast closing detection.

table.name: Detection - Fast Decreasing TPS - Min. ECT
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Minimum coolant temperature for fast throttle closing detection.

table.name: AlphaN - TPS
table.description: Alpha-N load (throttle angle x engine speed), read by RPM_Load_ModeSelect_Calc_A / AlphaN_Load_Plausibility. Alpha-N load = [AlphaN - IACV x AlphaN - IACV (TPS Compensation) + AlphaN - TPS] / AlphaN - IAT Compensation; with a throttle fault (code 12) 'AlphaN - TPS (DTC 12)' replaces this table. Used as substitute load when the air flow meter cannot be used.

table.name: AlphaN - IAT Compensation
table.description: Intake air temperature dependent factor (AlphaN_IAT_Factor, 1.0 = 128) computed by ECT_Dependent_Params_Update and used by the alpha-N load calculation (throttle + idle valve). The alpha-N load is divided by this factor: 1.0 = neutral, larger = load reduced (warmer, less dense air).

table.name: AlphaN - TPS (DTC 12)
table.description: Alpha-N load as a function of throttle angle and engine speed, read by RPM_Load_ModeSelect_Calc_A; used as substitute load when the air flow meter cannot be used.

table.name: AlphaN - IACV
table.description: Contribution of the idle valve (bypass air) to the alpha-N load (RPM_Load_ModeSelect_Calc_A / AlphaN_Load_Plausibility).

table.name: AlphaN - IACV (TPS Compensation)
table.description: Weighting, as a function of throttle angle, of the idle valve contribution to the alpha-N load (RPM_Load_ModeSelect_Calc_A).

table.name: Fuel Injection - Base
table.description: Base injection time (engine speed x load) for a stoichiometric mixture, read by BaseMaps_PerEngineState_Calc (0x9CA) outside cranking. Starting point with other injectors: correct it by the flow ratio.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Open Loop Enrichment
table.description: Full-load (open loop) enrichment factor, read by BaseMaps_PerEngineState_Calc when word_FD12.10 is set (see 'Detection - Open Loop Enrichment'); result FullLoad_Enrichment (value x 16, 1.0 = 4096 in the enrichment sum).

table.name: Detection - Open Loop Enrichment
table.description: Throttle angle (as a function of engine speed) above which the full-load enrichment is activated (word_FD12.10, Threshold_Crossing_Debounced_E8D0).

table.name: Fuel Injection - Base - VANOS Correction
table.description: Injection time deviation with VANOS active (engine speed x load, words centred on 0x8000 = 0 ms), multiplied by the VANOS state (VANOS_CamAdvance_Ratio) and added to the base injection time (BaseMaps_PerEngineState_Calc).

table.name: Fuel Injection - Warmup Enrichment
table.description: Cold engine enrichment factor (engine speed x load), multiplied by 'Fuel Injection - Warmup Enrichment (ECT Compensation)' (RPM_Load_ScaledCorrection_Calc_Alt).

table.name: Fuel Injection - Warmup Enrichment (ECT Compensation)
table.description: Coolant temperature dependent factor (1.0 = 128) applied to 'Fuel Injection - Warmup Enrichment'.

table.name: Fuel Injector - Dead Time / Latency
table.description: Injector dead time as a function of battery voltage, added to each pulse (Fuel_InjectionTime_Calc, Injector_PulseWidth_Base). Adapt it to the injectors used.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Cranking - Initial
table.description: First injection during cranking (word, as a function of coolant temperature), multiplied by 'Fuel Injection - Cranking - Hot Start Factor (vs ECT) (new)' on a hot restart then by the final gain; the dead time is added (Fuel_Cranking_InitialPulse_Calc).

table.name: Fuel Injection - Cranking
table.description: Base quantity during cranking (engine state 1), as a function of engine speed and coolant temperature (word grid); result Crank_FuelBase, then multiplied by 'Fuel Injection - Cranking - Decay (vs ECT/Cranking Cycles) (new)' and the hot restart factor in Fuel_InjectionTime_Calc. Read by the per-engine-state base calculation routine (0x2FC66).

table.name: Fuel Economy Gauge - Scaling Factor
table.description: Factor (1.0 = 128; used x256 by MulU16_HighWord) applied to the sum of fuel flows (FuelConsumption_Rate) before division by 3 for the fuel consumption gauge. See also 'Scaling Factor 2'.

table.name: Fuel Economy Gauge - Scaling Factor 2
table.description: Factor (16-bit word, 1.0 = 8192) applied by MulU16_HighWord to the accumulated fuel flow (FuelConsumption_Accumulator_ED40) before it is sent to the fuel consumption gauge. Read as a word at 0x72 (0x73 is only its high byte).

table.name: Ignition Timing - Base
table.description: Base ignition advance map (engine speed x load) at part load / full load (engine states other than cranking and idle). The weighted VANOS correction (map 0x105E, RPM_Load_ModeSelectB_E978, 128 = 0) is added; result IgnTiming_BaseValue (routine 0x2FC66).

table.name: Ignition Timing - Base - VANOS Correction
table.description: Ignition correction (engine speed x load, 128 = 0) multiplied by the VANOS state and added to the base advance (BaseMaps_PerEngineState_Calc, RPM_Load_ModeSelectB_E978).

table.name: Ignition Timing - Base - ECT/IAT Compensation - Multiplicative
table.description: Weighting factor (intake air temperature x coolant temperature) multiplied by 'Ignition Timing - Base - ECT/IAT Compensation - Nominal' to obtain the temperature ignition correction (IgnTiming_Accumulate_Corrections).

table.name: Ignition Timing - Base - ECT/IAT Compensation - Nominal
table.description: Ignition correction (engine speed x load, 128 = 0) multiplied by the 'ECT/IAT Compensation - Multiplicative' factor; the weighted result (minus 128) is added to the ignition correction sum.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Cranking
table.description: Ignition advance during cranking (engine state 1), as a function of engine speed (BaseMaps_PerEngineState_Calc).

table.name: Ignition Timing - Idle - Base
table.description: Idle ignition advance (engine state 2), engine speed x load (BaseMaps_PerEngineState_Calc).

table.name: Ignition Timing - Idle - ECT Compensation
table.description: Advance added at idle when coolant temperature is low (IgnTiming_Accumulate_Corrections).

table.name: X Axis - Load
table.description: Load axis shared by the main fuel and ignition maps. After changing it, reload the file immediately.

table.name: Y Axis - Engine Speed
table.description: Engine speed axis shared by the main fuel and ignition maps. After changing it, reload the file immediately.

table.name: DTC 212 - Minimum RPM
table.description: Below this engine speed, check 212 (VANOS / minimum speed, DTC212_Check) is not evaluated.

table.name: CH - On/Off - VANOS
table.description: Catalyst heating (CH): function active after a cold start. 1: VANOS is engaged during the cold start to increase air flow and help heating; 0: disabled (can smooth a rough cold start).

table.name: Detection - Light/Heavy Throttle
table.description: Throttle angle (as a function of engine speed): below it, VANOS follows the 'Light Throttle' tables, above it the 'Heavy Throttle' tables.

table.name: VANOS - Min. Load (Light Throttle) (AT)
table.description: Light throttle: load above which VANOS is engaged (automatic transmission).

table.name: VANOS - Min. Load (Light Throttle) (MT)
table.description: Light throttle: load (as a function of engine speed and coolant temperature) above which VANOS is engaged (manual transmission).

table.name: VANOS - On/Off (Heavy Throttle) (MS41.1/MS41.0)
table.description: Heavy throttle: 1 = VANOS active at this engine speed, 0 = inactive. Use this table only to change the engine speed axis.

table.name: Nominal Idle Speed
table.description: Target idle speed as a function of coolant temperature, manual gearbox or automatic in neutral (computed in ECT_Dependent_Params_Update).

table.name: Nominal Idle Speed (A/C on)
table.description: Target idle speed as a function of coolant temperature, manual gearbox or automatic in neutral, A/C engaged.

table.name: Nominal Idle Speed (A/T in Drive)
table.description: Target idle speed as a function of coolant temperature, automatic transmission in gear.

table.name: Nominal Idle Speed (A/T in Drive and A/C on)
table.description: Target idle speed (as a function of coolant temperature), automatic transmission in gear and A/C engaged (IdleSpeed_Target_Candidate_Drive_AC), computed in ECT_Dependent_Params_Update.

table.name: IACV - TPS
table.description: Idle valve opening as a function of engine speed and throttle angle (support on throttle closing); the tracked value E8F4 rises by at most 'IACV - Map Rise Step (new)' and falls by at most 'IACV - Map Fall Step (new)' per calculation. Internally the byte is shifted by 7 bits into a word where 100 % = 32768, and IACV_Duty_Sum_Output subtracts 0x1999 (20 %) before doubling it into the final duty: hence 0.3906 % per step with a -20 % offset.

table.name: IACV - ECT (M/T or A/T in Neutral)
table.description: Base idle valve opening as a function of coolant temperature, manual gearbox or automatic in neutral (computed with the temperature dependent parameters).

table.name: IACV - ECT (M/T or A/T in Neutral and AC on)
table.description: Base idle valve opening as a function of coolant temperature, manual gearbox or automatic in neutral, A/C engaged.

table.name: IACV - ECT (A/T in Drive)
table.description: Base idle valve opening as a function of coolant temperature, automatic transmission in gear (A/T in Drive).

table.name: IACV - ECT (A/T in Drive and AC on)
table.description: Base idle valve opening as a function of coolant temperature, automatic transmission in gear and A/C engaged.

table.name: IACV - PWM
table.description: Conversion of the computed opening into the final idle valve control duty cycle (IACV_PWM_Output_Calc).

table.name: IACV - Latency
table.description: Battery voltage compensation: factor (1.0 = 128) applied to the final idle valve duty cycle (IACV_PWM_Output_Calc).

table.name: IACV - Cranking
table.description: Idle valve opening factor during cranking (word_FD14.1), as a function of engine speed and coolant temperature, multiplied by the temperature factor E8FF (1.0 = 128) then by the computed opening (IACV_Duty_E900); the product is shifted by 3 bits, so this factor is 1.0 = 64.

table.name: ISR - Proportional
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): proportional term as a function of the corrected speed error (128 = 0). Positive values when speed must be raised, negative to lower it.

table.name: ISR - Integral - Converging
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): integral term when the speed error decreases (converging to the target).

table.name: ISR - Integral - Diverging
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): integral term when the speed error increases.

table.name: ISR - Derivative
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): derivative term (128 = 0), as a function of the engine speed gradient: prevents the speed from dropping below the target on a fast drop; applies at idle and above.

table.name: ISR - Derivative - Decay Limitation
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): maximum decrease of the derivative term applied every 40 ms; no limit on its first application.

table.name: ISR - Derivative - Engine Speed Gradient Threshold
table.description: Engine speed gradient (RPM_Gradient_S8, signed) below 'Intercept - RPM' under which the speed drop is detected: word_FD26.2/3 set and the 'ISR - Derivative - Min. Time (new)' delay armed. See 'ISR - Derivative'.

table.name: ISR - Aggression - ECT Compensation
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): PID gain factor (1.0 = 128) as a function of coolant temperature; above 1 more aggressive control, below softer.

table.name: ISR - Minimum Integral Limit (Vehicle Stopped)
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): lower limit of the integral term at idle, vehicle stopped.

table.name: ISR - Maximum Integral Limit (Vehicle Stopped)
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): upper limit of the integral term at idle, vehicle stopped.

table.name: ISR - Minimum Integral Limit (Vehicle Moving)
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): lower limit of the integral term at idle, vehicle moving.

table.name: ISR - Maximum Integral Limit (Vehicle Moving)
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): upper limit of the integral term at idle, vehicle moving.

table.name: ISR - Minimum Integral Limit (Vehicle Moving w/ AC on)
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): lower limit of the integral term at idle, vehicle moving, A/C engaged.

table.name: ISR - Maximum Integral Limit (Vehicle Moving w/ AC on)
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): upper limit of the integral term at idle, vehicle moving, A/C engaged.

table.name: ISR - Minimum Integral Limit (above Idle)
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): lower limit of the integral term above idle.

table.name: ISR - Maximum Integral Limit (above Idle)
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): upper limit of the integral term above idle.

table.name: ISR - Minimum Integral Limit (above Idle w/ AC on)
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): lower limit of the integral term above idle, A/C engaged.

table.name: ISR - Maximum Integral Limit (above Idle w/ AC on)
table.description: Idle speed control (PID on the idle valve): upper limit of the integral term above idle, A/C engaged.

table.name: Detection - Closed Throttle
table.description: Throttle angle below which the throttle is considered closed (closed-throttle mode).

table.name: Intercept - RPM
table.description: Engine speed below which 'Intercept' mode is allowed: smooth transition from deceleration to idle (ignition, fuel, idle control, speed drop).

table.name: Rapid Engine Speed Drop - Integral Additive
table.description: On a rapid engine speed drop, value added immediately to the integral term of the idle speed control, ignoring its limits, to avoid dropping below the target.

table.name: Detection - Rapid Engine Speed Drop
table.description: Closed throttle, engine speed below 'Intercept - RPM' and speed gradient below this value: rapid engine speed drop detected.

table.name: Dashpot - Nominal
table.description: Closing damper (dashpot): extra idle valve opening when the throttle closes (engine speed x throttle angle) to soften the torque drop. Reduce it with a large-diameter throttle. The byte is shifted by 7 bits into the idle valve word (100 % = 32768): 0.3906 % per step.

table.name: Dashpot - Decay Limitation
table.description: Idle valve closing speed after a throttle lift (as a function of engine speed): smaller = more progressive closing. Step removed at each calculation (every 40 ms): the byte is shifted by 5 bits into the idle valve word (100 % = 32768), i.e. 0.0977 % per step.

table.name: Ignition Retard - ASC
table.description: Ignition retard requested by ASC (IgnTiming_Accumulate_Corrections, active if word_FD42.5 or .6). Rows = engine speed, columns = load.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit
table.description: Vehicle speed above which the speed limiter acts; 255 disables it.

table.name: Engine Speed Limiter (Hysteresis A)
table.description: Rev limiter hysteresis (RevLimit_ModeSelect_Debounced): injection resumes below the limit minus this value. Reduce it for a harder limiter.

table.name: Engine Speed Limiter (Hysteresis B)
table.description: Second rev limiter hysteresis (RevLimit_ModeSelect_Debounced).

table.name: Engine Speed Limiter (Hard Limiter)
table.description: Normal engine speed limit (RevLimit_TargetRPM) selected by RevLimit_ModeSelect_Debounced outside limp mode.

table.name: Engine Speed Limiter (Immediate)
table.description: Engine speed for immediate injection cut; set it above 'Engine Speed Limiter (Hard Limiter)' (RevLimit_ModeSelect_Debounced).

table.name: Engine Speed Limiter (VSS Error)
table.description: Engine speed limit when the vehicle speed sensor is faulty (code 214).

table.name: Engine Speed Limiter (Resume Delay)
table.description: Delay before injection resumes after the rev limiter has acted (RevLimiter_VSS_StateMachine); smaller = harder limiter. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment (engine task run at each ignition). Counted down by RevLimit_ModeSelect_Debounced (task 6).

table.name: Muffler Flap Solenoid
table.description: Throttle angle threshold of the exhaust flap (ExhaustFlap_Control), as a function of engine speed and coolant temperature: when the throttle angle exceeds this value, the flap is commanded open; it closes again when the angle falls below the value minus 'Exhaust Flap - TPS Hysteresis (new)'. Below 'Exhaust Flap - Minimum Vehicle Speed (new)' the flap is closed; just after start it is open. All zeros: flap always open above the minimum speed. Active if Byte 8 bit 3.

table.name: MAF (1024 kg/hr Mode) (256x1)
table.description: Air flow meter linearisation (256 voltage points, words) in the stock 1024 kg/h mode; read by the sampling interrupt (Timer3_Interrupt_Handler, pointer MAF_Table_Ptr). The kg/h scaling comes from the program.

table.name: MAF
table.description: Same table as 'MAF (1024 kg/hr Mode) (256x1)' shown as 16x16 for editing. If a MAF table in 2048 kg/h mode is displayed (256 KB files), only the last modified table is saved.

table.name: ECT Sensor Scaling
table.description: Linearisation of the coolant temperature sensor (ADC slot 9, AN0) into CoolantTemp_Lin (CoolantTemp_ECT_PlausibilityCheck); the result is checked against 'ECT Sensor - Upper Plausibility Limit (new)' / 'ECT Sensor - Lower Plausibility Limit (new)' (code 10). Axis: sensor voltage on the 10-bit ADC (5 V reference).

table.name: IAT Sensor Scaling
table.description: Linearisation of the intake air temperature sensor (IAT_Lin) by IAT_Linearize_PlausibilityCheck; the result is then checked against 'IAT Sensor - Upper Plausibility Limit (new)' / 'IAT Sensor - Lower Plausibility Limit (new)' (code 14). Axis: sensor voltage (8-bit, 5 V reference).

table.name: Minimum Mass Air Threshold for MAF Error
table.description: Low air mass threshold of the air flow meter diagnosis (short to ground, code 8); below it, switch to the alpha-N substitute mode. With another air flow meter, avoid zero values in the MAF table.

table.name: Maximum Mass Air Threshold for MAF Error
table.description: High air mass threshold of the air flow meter diagnosis (short to supply, code 8); can be raised up to 1389 with forced induction.

table.name: Knock Detection - Min. Load
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x26B82). Minimum load (engine speed x coolant temperature) to allow knock detection.

table.name: Max. Knock Retard (ECT)
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x26B82). Coolant temperature dependent weighting factor applied to the limp-home ignition angle.

table.name: No Knock Advance - Step Size
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x26B82). Advance-back step when no knock is detected.

table.name: Knock Retard - Step Size (Regular Intensity)
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x26B82). Retard step applied for a knock of normal intensity (intensity 1).

table.name: Knock Retard - Step Size (Higher Intensity)
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x26B82). Retard step applied for a knock of high intensity (intensity 2).

table.name: Knock Detection Threshold - Multiplicative Factor - Cylinder 6
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x26B82). Knock detection threshold factor of cylinder 6 (engine speed x load), applied to the reference level of the cylinder. For a value k of CylIndex_Latched (firing position 0-5), the program reads the factor table of firing position k+3 (jump table 0x2930).

table.name: Knock Detection Threshold - Multiplicative Factor - Cylinder 2
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x26B82). Knock detection threshold factor of cylinder 2 (engine speed x load), applied to the reference level of the cylinder. For a value k of CylIndex_Latched (firing position 0-5), the program reads the factor table of firing position k+3 (jump table 0x2930).

table.name: Knock Detection Threshold - Multiplicative Factor - Cylinder 4
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x26B82). Knock detection threshold factor of cylinder 4 (engine speed x load), applied to the reference level of the cylinder. For a value k of CylIndex_Latched (firing position 0-5), the program reads the factor table of firing position k+3 (jump table 0x2930).

table.name: Knock Detection Threshold - Multiplicative Factor - Cylinder 1
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x26B82). Knock detection threshold factor of cylinder 1 (engine speed x load), applied to the reference level of the cylinder. For a value k of CylIndex_Latched (firing position 0-5), the program reads the factor table of firing position k+3 (jump table 0x2930).

table.name: Knock Detection Threshold - Multiplicative Factor - Cylinder 5
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x26B82). Knock detection threshold factor of cylinder 5 (engine speed x load), applied to the reference level of the cylinder. For a value k of CylIndex_Latched (firing position 0-5), the program reads the factor table of firing position k+3 (jump table 0x2930).

table.name: Knock Detection Threshold - Multiplicative Factor - Cylinder 3
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x26B82). Knock detection threshold factor of cylinder 3 (engine speed x load), applied to the reference level of the cylinder. For a value k of CylIndex_Latched (firing position 0-5), the program reads the factor table of firing position k+3 (jump table 0x2930).

table.name: Knock Detection Window - Start - Cylinder 5
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x26B82). Start of the knock sensor listening window for cylinder 5 (engine speed x load, read without interpolation). 1 unit = 1 tooth = 6 crank degrees after TDC: the interrupt adds it to the cylinder tooth number modulo 120 (CC_AngleResult). The window of the next cylinder to fire is prepared (firing position k+1 for CylIndex_Latched = k, jump table 0x2930).

table.name: Knock Detection Window - Start - Cylinder 3
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x26B82). Start of the knock sensor listening window for cylinder 3 (engine speed x load, read without interpolation). 1 unit = 1 tooth = 6 crank degrees after TDC: the interrupt adds it to the cylinder tooth number modulo 120 (CC_AngleResult). The window of the next cylinder to fire is prepared (firing position k+1 for CylIndex_Latched = k, jump table 0x2930).

table.name: Knock Detection Window - Start - Cylinder 6
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x26B82). Start of the knock sensor listening window for cylinder 6 (engine speed x load, read without interpolation). 1 unit = 1 tooth = 6 crank degrees after TDC: the interrupt adds it to the cylinder tooth number modulo 120 (CC_AngleResult). The window of the next cylinder to fire is prepared (firing position k+1 for CylIndex_Latched = k, jump table 0x2930).

table.name: Knock Detection Window - Start - Cylinder 2
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x26B82). Start of the knock sensor listening window for cylinder 2 (engine speed x load, read without interpolation). 1 unit = 1 tooth = 6 crank degrees after TDC: the interrupt adds it to the cylinder tooth number modulo 120 (CC_AngleResult). The window of the next cylinder to fire is prepared (firing position k+1 for CylIndex_Latched = k, jump table 0x2930).

table.name: Knock Detection Window - Start - Cylinder 4
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x26B82). Start of the knock sensor listening window for cylinder 4 (engine speed x load, read without interpolation). 1 unit = 1 tooth = 6 crank degrees after TDC: the interrupt adds it to the cylinder tooth number modulo 120 (CC_AngleResult). The window of the next cylinder to fire is prepared (firing position k+1 for CylIndex_Latched = k, jump table 0x2930).

table.name: Knock Detection Window - Start - Cylinder 1
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x26B82). Start of the knock sensor listening window for cylinder 1 (engine speed x load, read without interpolation). 1 unit = 1 tooth = 6 crank degrees after TDC: the interrupt adds it to the cylinder tooth number modulo 120 (CC_AngleResult). The window of the next cylinder to fire is prepared (firing position k+1 for CylIndex_Latched = k, jump table 0x2930).

table.name: Knock Detection Window - End - Cylinder 5
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x26B82). End of the knock sensor listening window for cylinder 5 (engine speed x load, read without interpolation). 1 unit = 1 tooth = 6 crank degrees after TDC; if the start is beyond the end, the end is set to start + 1 tooth.

table.name: Knock Detection Window - End - Cylinder 3
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x26B82). End of the knock sensor listening window for cylinder 3 (engine speed x load, read without interpolation). 1 unit = 1 tooth = 6 crank degrees after TDC; if the start is beyond the end, the end is set to start + 1 tooth.

table.name: Knock Detection Window - End - Cylinder 6
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x26B82). End of the knock sensor listening window for cylinder 6 (engine speed x load, read without interpolation). 1 unit = 1 tooth = 6 crank degrees after TDC; if the start is beyond the end, the end is set to start + 1 tooth.

table.name: Knock Detection Window - End - Cylinder 2
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x26B82). End of the knock sensor listening window for cylinder 2 (engine speed x load, read without interpolation). 1 unit = 1 tooth = 6 crank degrees after TDC; if the start is beyond the end, the end is set to start + 1 tooth.

table.name: Knock Detection Window - End - Cylinder 4
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x26B82). End of the knock sensor listening window for cylinder 4 (engine speed x load, read without interpolation). 1 unit = 1 tooth = 6 crank degrees after TDC; if the start is beyond the end, the end is set to start + 1 tooth.

table.name: Knock Detection Window - End - Cylinder 1
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x26B82). End of the knock sensor listening window for cylinder 1 (engine speed x load, read without interpolation). 1 unit = 1 tooth = 6 crank degrees after TDC; if the start is beyond the end, the end is set to start + 1 tooth.

table.name: Knock Tables X Axis (Load)
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x26B82). Load axis shared by the knock tables. After changing it, reload the file immediately.

table.name: Knock Tables Y Axis (Engine Speed)
table.description: Knock control (Knock_Control_Update, 0x26B82). Engine speed axis shared by the knock tables. After changing it, reload the file immediately.

table.name: Engine Speed Limiter - IACV Fault (vs TPS) (new)
table.description: Maximum engine speed when an idle air actuator fault is detected, as a function of throttle angle. Stock: 1504 / 3488 / 6016 rpm at 1.4 / 5.2 / 30 deg throttle.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Max. Load (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Maximum air mass per stroke (as a function of engine speed) at which the idle air adaptation can learn. Learning also requires the idle valve opening to be between 'Idle Air Adaptation - Min. IACV Opening (new)' and 'Idle Air Adaptation - Max. IACV Opening (new)'.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Min. IACV Opening (new)
table.description: Minimum idle valve opening for the idle air adaptation to learn.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Max. IACV Opening (new)
table.description: Maximum idle valve opening for the idle air adaptation to learn.

table.name: TPS Substitute - Throttle Airflow vs RPM (TPS Fault) (new)
table.description: Substitute throttle angle when the throttle sensor is faulty, as a function of the air flow through the throttle (measured flow minus the idle valve share) and of engine speed. If the air flow meter is faulty too: 'TPS Substitute - Fixed Value (new)'.

table.name: Engine Roughness - ECT Factor (new)
table.description: Misfire detection from crankshaft speed irregularity: factor (1.0 = 128) applied to 'Engine Roughness - Reference (vs RPM/Load) (new)' as a function of coolant temperature.

table.name: Torque Model - Air Mass for Zero Torque (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Air mass per stroke corresponding to zero engine torque, as a function of engine speed; sent on the CAN bus in byte 5 of message DME1 (0x316) for the automatic transmission and ASC torque model. Above 'Torque Model - Max. Air Mass (new)', the byte is forced to 255.

table.name: Engine Roughness - Reference (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.description: Misfire detection: reference value used to normalise, cylinder by cylinder, the measured speed irregularity, as a function of engine speed and load. Multiplied by 'Engine Roughness - ECT Factor (new)'.

table.name: ECT Substitute - Temperature Rise Step (vs Airflow) (new)
table.description: Coolant temperature substitute model (coolant sensor fault): temperature increment added at each step, as a function of air flow; the substitute value is capped by 'ECT Substitute - Upper Limit (new)'.

table.name: CAN DME4 - Coolant Temperature Level (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Coolant temperature level (0 to 7) sent to the instrument cluster in CAN message DME4, as a function of coolant temperature. Read without interpolation. Overheating is signalled separately (see 'CAN DME4 - Overheat ECT Threshold (new)').

table.name: Ignition Feedback Diagnosis - Min. Spark Duration (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.description: Ignition coil diagnosis (DTC 1, 2, 3, 29, 30, 31): minimum spark burn duration expected from the ignition feedback signal of each cylinder, as a function of engine speed and load. Shorter = fault. Evaluated with a warm engine (above 'Ignition Feedback Diagnosis - Min. ECT (new)') and below 'Ignition Feedback Diagnosis - Max. RPM (new)'. Read without interpolation.

table.name: Multi-Spark - Dwell Time (vs Battery Voltage) (new)
table.description: Multiple sparks (cold start): coil recharge time between two sparks, as a function of battery voltage. Active below 'Multi-Spark - Max. ECT (new)' and below 'System - Max. Battery Voltage (Multi-Spark / O2 Heater) (new)'.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Dwell Time (new)
table.description: Ignition coil charge (dwell) time as a function of battery voltage; then corrected per cylinder from the ignition feedback (see 'Ignition Dwell - Target Ignition Current (vs RPM/Load) (new)').

table.name: Canister Purge Valve - Duty (vs Purge Level) (new)
table.description: Canister purge valve duty cycle as a function of the purge level requested by the control. Active only if purge is coded (Byte 7 bit 3).

table.name: Canister Purge Valve - Battery Voltage Correction (new)
table.description: Signed correction (128 = 0) added to the purge valve duty cycle as a function of battery voltage (engine running, valve commanded).

table.name: Ignition Dwell - Target Ignition Current (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.description: Target ignition current per cylinder (engine speed x load): when the measured current exceeds it, the dwell time of that cylinder is reduced by 'Ignition Dwell - Reduction Step (new)' (floor 'Ignition Dwell - Minimum Factor (new)'). Constant in this file.

table.name: Injection Timing - Angle (vs RPM/Injection Time) (new)
table.description: Start-of-injection angle (position of the injection event) as a function of engine speed and injection time (injection time + dead time), outside cranking. Internally 1 unit = 1 tooth = 6 crank degrees; the value is shown as the angle relative to the firing TDC (0 = 180 deg before).

table.name: Injection Timing - Angle (Cranking) (new)
table.description: Start-of-injection angle during cranking, as a function of engine speed and injection time. Internally 1 unit = 1 tooth = 6 crank degrees; the value is shown as the angle relative to the firing TDC (0 = 180 deg before).

table.name: Injection Timing - VANOS Correction (new)
table.description: Start-of-injection angle correction with VANOS active, multiplied by the VANOS position (full value with the cam fully advanced), as a function of engine speed and injection time (128 = 0).

table.name: Injection Timing - End Angle (Transient) (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: End-of-injection angle in transient operation at low engine speed, used below 'Injection Timing - End Angle Max. RPM (new)'; the value is clamped to 0..19 teeth, i.e. 330 to 444 crank degrees after TDC.

table.name: Torque Model - Torque Reduction (vs Normalized Retard) (new)
table.description: Torque model for the CAN bus: converts the applied ignition retard into a torque reduction factor, sent to the automatic transmission / ASC in message DME1. Inverse curve of 'Torque Model - Normalized Retard (vs Torque Reduction) (new)'.

table.name: Torque Model - Normalized Retard (vs Torque Reduction) (new)
table.description: Torque model: converts the torque reduction request of the automatic transmission (message EGS1) into an ignition retard factor. Inverse curve of 'Torque Model - Torque Reduction (vs Normalized Retard) (new)'.

table.name: Torque Model - Max. Reduction Factor (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.description: Torque model: maximum torque reduction factor obtainable by ignition retard, as a function of engine speed and load.

table.name: Torque Model - Latest Ignition Angle (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.description: Torque model: latest (most retarded) correction ignition angle allowed during a torque reduction, as a function of engine speed and load (128 = 0).

table.name: CH - IACV Adder at Idle (ECT vs Time) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating: opening added (or removed if negative) to the idle valve at idle, as a function of coolant temperature and time since the end of cranking; adds to 'CH - IACV - TPS (new)'.

table.name: CH - IACV - TPS (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating: idle valve base map (throttle angle x engine speed) used instead of 'IACV - TPS' while catalyst heating is active, with a progressive transition. Same internal scaling as 'IACV - TPS': 0.3906 % per step with a -20 % offset.

table.name: IACV - TPS (MSR Mode 1) (new)
table.description: Idle valve pre-control used when ABS/ASC requests MSR mode 1 (code 2): idle air is increased to limit engine braking (drive wheel slip). The program adds 0x1999 (20 %) to the shifted value, which cancels the -20 % offset of the normal map: 0.3906 % per step. Requires Byte 7 bits 0-2 = 001.

table.name: IACV - TPS (MSR Mode 2) (new)
table.description: Like 'IACV - TPS (MSR Mode 1) (new)', for MSR mode 2 (code 6).

table.name: IACV - Raised Idle Target Correction (vs RPM/Target Difference) (new)
table.description: Idle valve opening added when the target idle speed is raised, as a function of engine speed and of the difference between the raised target and the base target.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Enleanment Weight (No Lambda) (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Coolant temperature weighting of 'Fuel Injection - Enleanment (No Lambda) (new)' during warm-up.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Enleanment (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Enleanment (engine speed x load) removed from the fuel factor of each bank on the variant without catalyst / lambda control, weighted by 'Fuel Injection - Enleanment Weight (No Lambda) (vs ECT) (new)'. Not applied during full-load enrichment.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Anti-Jerk (new)
table.description: Anti-jerk function: ignition retard applied when a driveline oscillation is detected, as a function of engine speed and load. Multiplied by 'Anti-Jerk - Retard Factor (2nd Oscillation) (new)' on the 2nd oscillation then by 'Anti-Jerk - Retard Factor (Next Oscillations) (new)', and limited by 'Anti-Jerk - Retard Limit (vs RPM) (new)'.

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Retard Limit (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Maximum retard step applied by the anti-jerk function, as a function of engine speed (read without interpolation).

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Recovery Ramp Rate (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Speed at which the advance returns to the target after an anti-jerk intervention (degrees returned at each ignition), as a function of engine speed.

table.name: CH 2 - Ignition Weight (ECT vs Time) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: weighting of 'CH 2 - Ignition Timing (vs RPM/TPS) (new)', as a function of coolant temperature and of the time since the end of cranking.

table.name: CH 2 - Ignition Timing (vs RPM/TPS) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: ignition correction as a function of engine speed and throttle angle, weighted by 'CH 2 - Ignition Weight (ECT vs Time) (new)'.

table.name: CH - Ignition Timing (Idle) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating: ignition correction at idle, as a function of engine speed, weighted by 'CH - Ignition Weight (Idle) (ECT vs Time) (new)'.

table.name: CH - Ignition Weight (Idle) (ECT vs Time) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating: weighting of 'CH - Ignition Timing (Idle) (new)' as a function of coolant temperature and of the time since the end of cranking.

table.name: CH - Ignition Timing (Part Load) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating: ignition correction above idle (engine speed x load), weighted by 'CH - Ignition Weight (Part Load) (AT) (new)' or '(MT)'. Vehicles with lambda control.

table.name: CH - Ignition Weight (Part Load) (AT) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating: weighting of the above-idle ignition correction, as a function of coolant temperature and time since start; automatic transmission.

table.name: CH - Ignition Weight (Part Load) (MT) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating: weighting of the above-idle ignition correction, as a function of coolant temperature and time since start; manual gearbox.

table.name: Spark Plug Cleaning - Ignition Timing (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.description: Spark plug cleaning: ignition angle correction (engine speed x load) applied at part load when coolant temperature is between 'Spark Plug Cleaning - Min. ECT (new)' and 'Spark Plug Cleaning - Max. ECT (new)', during 'Spark Plug Cleaning - Duration (new)'. Constant (+3 deg) in this file.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Base - ECT/IAT Compensation - Nominal (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Like 'Ignition Timing - Base - ECT/IAT Compensation - Nominal', for vehicles without lambda control; weighted by 'Ignition Timing - Base - ECT/IAT Compensation - Multiplicative'.

table.name: CH - Duration - Idle Speed Target Increase (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Like 'CH - Duration - Idle Speed Target Increase', for vehicles without lambda control. Zero in this file.

table.name: Injection Timing - ECT Correction (new)
table.description: Start-of-injection angle correction as a function of coolant temperature.

table.name: Air Mass - Initial Value at Start (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Air mass per stroke used as the initial value at start, as a function of coolant temperature.

table.name: Load Filter - Coefficient (vs RPM/Air Mass) (new)
table.description: Filter coefficient of the measured load while driving, as a function of engine speed and air mass: ~1 = no filtering, smaller = smoother but slower load.

table.name: Load Filter - Coefficient (Deceleration) (vs RPM/Air Mass) (new)
table.description: Like 'Load Filter - Coefficient (vs RPM/Air Mass) (new)', during a deceleration (overrun reduction).

table.name: Load Filter - Coefficient (Idle/Overrun) (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Filter coefficient of the load at idle and in overrun, as a function of engine speed (no filtering during cranking).

table.name: Ignition Timing - Re-entry Rate Limit (Idle) (vs RPM Gradient) (new)
table.description: Ignition rate limit on re-entry into idle after a fuel cut, as a function of the engine speed gradient.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Re-entry Rate Limit (Part Load) (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Ignition rate limit on re-entry into part load after a fuel cut, as a function of engine speed. Read without interpolation.

table.name: Detection - Tip-in for Knock Control (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Throttle opening speed threshold (as a function of engine speed) above which a fast opening is reported to the knock control, which then adapts its detection during 'Knock Control - Tip-in Duration (vs RPM) (new)'. Read without interpolation between engine speed points.

table.name: Knock Control - Tip-in Duration (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Duration during which the knock control treats the engine as transient after a fast throttle opening (see 'Detection - Tip-in for Knock Control (vs RPM) (new)'), as a function of engine speed. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment.

table.name: Detection - Fast Increasing TPS (new)
table.description: Throttle opening speed threshold (as a function of engine speed) above which the retard 'Ignition Retard - Fast Increasing TPS (new)' is applied.

table.name: Ignition Retard - Fast Increasing TPS (new)
table.description: Ignition correction applied on a fast throttle opening (negative value = retard), as a function of engine speed and load. Weighted by 'Ignition Retard - Fast Increasing TPS (IAT Compensation) (new)', applied during 'Ignition Retard - Fast Increasing TPS - Duration (new)' and limited by 'Ignition Timing - Re-entry Correction (Part Load) (vs RPM/ECT) (new)'. Read without interpolation.

table.name: Ignition Retard - Fast Increasing TPS (IAT Compensation) (new)
table.description: Weighting of the fast throttle opening retard according to intake air temperature: 1.0 = full retard, 0 = no retard.

table.name: Ignition Retard - Fast Increasing TPS - Duration (new)
table.description: Duration of the fast throttle opening retard, as a function of engine speed. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Re-entry Correction (Part Load) (vs RPM/ECT) (new)
table.description: Ignition correction on re-entry into part load after a fuel cut, as a function of engine speed and coolant temperature; also limits the advance during its progressive return to the target. Read without interpolation.

table.name: VANOS - Min. Load Hysteresis (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: VANOS switch-off hysteresis: load difference removed from the activation threshold, as a function of engine speed. Read without interpolation.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Overrun Exit Correction A (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Injection time added when injection resumes after an overrun fuel cut (intercept), as a function of coolant temperature; then progressively reduced to 0 (see 'Fuel - Overrun Exit Correction Step (new)'). Read without interpolation.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Overrun Exit Correction B (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Injection time added when injection resumes after a fuel cut caused by a throttle opening (re-entry, acceleration), as a function of coolant temperature; then progressively reduced to 0.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Overrun Exit Correction C (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Injection time added when injection resumes after a fuel cut, into part load, as a function of coolant temperature; then progressively reduced to 0.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Overrun Exit Correction D (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Injection time added when injection resumes after a fuel cut into idle/overrun (default variant), as a function of coolant temperature; then progressively reduced to 0.

table.name: VANOS - Lock ECT Threshold (vs IAT at Start) (new)
table.description: Coolant temperature below which VANOS stays locked, frozen at start as a function of intake air temperature. Read without interpolation.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Enable Delay (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Idle time before the idle air adaptation is enabled, as a function of engine speed.

table.name: ISR - Integral - Initial Value at Start (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Initial value of the idle speed control integral term at start, as a function of coolant temperature (0 = neutral).

table.name: Fuel Injection - After-Start Enrichment Decay (ECT at Start vs Cycles) (new)
table.description: Decay factor of the after-start enrichment, as a function of coolant temperature at start and of the number of cycles since start. At 0, the after-start enrichment is finished.

table.name: Fuel Injection - After-Start Enrichment (ECT vs IAT) (new)
table.description: Cold after-start enrichment factor (1.0 = 64), frozen at start according to coolant and intake air temperatures; then multiplied by 'Fuel Injection - After-Start Enrichment Decay (ECT at Start vs Cycles) (new)' and added to the fuel.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Cranking - Hot Start Factor (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Factor applied to the quantities injected during cranking on a hot restart (see 'Fuel Injection - Hot Restart ECT Margin (new)'); factor 1 otherwise.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Cranking - Decay (vs ECT/Cranking Cycles) (new)
table.description: Factor applied to the injection time during cranking, as a function of coolant temperature and of the number of cycles since the start of cranking: progressively reduces injection if the engine is slow to start.

table.name: Ignition Timing - After-Start Overshoot Limit (vs RPM Error) (new)
table.description: Ignition limitation against engine speed overshoot after start, as a function of the speed error. Used in one of the two idle control modes; the other mode uses 'Ignition Timing - Idle - ISR Correction 2 (vs RPM Error) (new)'.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Cranking - ECT Correction (new)
table.description: Ignition correction added during cranking, as a function of coolant temperature (adds to 'Ignition Timing - Cranking').

table.name: Cranking - End RPM (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Engine speed above which the engine is considered started (end of the cranking state), as a function of coolant temperature.

table.name: CH 2 - Idle Speed Target Increase (M/T or Neutral) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: target idle speed increase, as a function of coolant temperature at start (manual gearbox or automatic not in gear); then reduced by 'CH 2 - Idle Speed Target Increase Decay (vs ECT) (new)'.

table.name: CH 2 - Idle Speed Target Increase (A/T in Drive) (new)
table.description: Like 'CH 2 - Idle Speed Target Increase (M/T or Neutral) (new)', automatic transmission in gear.

table.name: CH 2 - Idle Speed Target Increase Decay (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: decrease rate of the idle speed increase (removed at each calculation), as a function of coolant temperature.

table.name: Idle Speed Target - Tester Offset Weight (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Weighting, according to coolant temperature, of the idle offset set with the tester (K-line) added to the target.

table.name: Idle Speed Target - Floor (A/T in Drive) (new)
table.description: Minimum target idle speed applied when the vehicle is moving outside the idle state, automatic transmission in gear, as a function of the filtered battery voltage. Read without interpolation.

table.name: Idle Speed Target - Floor (M/T or Neutral) (new)
table.description: Minimum target idle speed applied when the vehicle is moving outside the idle state, manual gearbox or automatic not in gear, as a function of the filtered battery voltage. Read without interpolation.

table.name: IACV - Drive Engage Ramp Down (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Ramp-down limit of the idle valve opening when the automatic transmission is shifted into or out of drive, as a function of coolant temperature.

table.name: IACV - Drive Engage Ramp Up (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Ramp-up limit of the idle valve opening when the automatic transmission is shifted into or out of drive, as a function of coolant temperature.

table.name: IACV - Throttle Leakage Pre-control (vs IAT) (new)
table.description: Idle valve pre-control compensating the throttle leakage air, as a function of intake air temperature (128 = 0).

table.name: IACV / Air Mass - IAT Density Factor (new)
table.description: Intake air temperature (density) factor applied to the idle valve opening calculation and to the air mass plausibility check.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Start Value (vs IAT) (new)
table.description: Start value of the idle air adaptation as a function of intake air temperature. Constant (1.0) in this file.

table.name: IACV - AC Compressor Pre-control (vs AC Pressure/IAT) (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Like 'IACV - AC Compressor Pre-control (vs AC Pressure/IAT) (new)', for vehicles without lambda control.

table.name: IACV - AC Compressor Pre-control Scale (vs RPM/Load) (No Lambda) (new)
table.description: Like 'IACV - AC Compressor Pre-control Scale (vs RPM/Load) (new)', for vehicles without lambda control.

table.name: IACV - AC Compressor Ramp-in Rate (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Rate at which the extra idle valve opening is applied when the A/C compressor engages (step added at each calculation), as a function of engine speed. Larger = faster opening. Ramp start: 'IACV - AC Ramp Initial Value (new)'.

table.name: IACV - AC Transient Adder (new)
table.description: Opening (or closing if negative) added briefly to the idle valve when the A/C compressor switches on or off, then progressively reduced to 0. As a function of engine speed. Applied as soon as A/C is requested, before the compressor engages (+2.3 to +6.6 % opening in this software).

table.name: AC Compressor - On Delay (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Delay between the A/C request and the compressor engagement, as a function of engine speed (gives the idle valve time to open). In this file: 360 ms at 800 rpm, 50 ms at 3600 rpm. When it expires, the relay cut order (bit 5 of 0xF12B, message 0x104 to the satellite) is cleared and the compressor enable is signalled on CAN (DME1 byte 0 bit 6).

table.name: AC Compressor - Off Delay (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Delay between the end of the A/C request and the compressor switch-off, as a function of engine speed.

table.name: IACV - Tester Offset Pre-control (new)
table.description: Idle valve opening corresponding to the idle offset set with the tester, weighted by 'IACV - Tester Offset ECT Weight (new)'.

table.name: IACV - Tester Offset ECT Weight (new)
table.description: Weighting, according to coolant temperature, of 'IACV - Tester Offset Pre-control (new)'.

table.name: CH 2 - IACV for Speed Increase (M/T or Neutral) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: idle valve opening corresponding to the remaining idle speed increase ('CH 2 - Idle Speed Target Increase (M/T or Neutral) (new)'), as a function of coolant temperature; manual gearbox or automatic not in gear.

table.name: CH 2 - IACV for Speed Increase (A/T in Drive) (new)
table.description: Like 'CH 2 - IACV for Speed Increase (M/T or Neutral) (new)', automatic transmission in gear.

table.name: CH 2 - IACV for Ignition Retard (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: extra idle valve opening compensating the torque loss of the heating ignition retard, as a function of coolant temperature and of the ignition correction.

table.name: CH 2 - IACV for VANOS (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: idle valve opening added in proportion to the VANOS position; the displayed value is the contribution with the cam fully advanced.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Idle - ISR Correction (vs RPM Error) (new)
table.description: Idle fuel correction factor according to the speed error, in the second idle control mode (128 = no correction).

table.name: Ignition Timing - Idle - ISR Correction 2 (vs RPM Error) (new)
table.description: Idle ignition correction according to the speed error, in the second idle control mode; weighted by 'Ignition Timing - Idle - ISR Correction Weight (vs ECT) (new)'.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Idle - ISR Correction Weight (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Weighting of 'Ignition Timing - Idle - ISR Correction 2 (vs RPM Error) (new)' according to coolant temperature.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Intercept Advance (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Absolute ignition angle used on intercept (resumption of injection after an overrun fuel cut), as a function of coolant temperature. Same scale as the base ignition maps.

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Exit Threshold (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: End of the anti-jerk intervention: it stops when the crankshaft speed variation rises above this threshold. Value = relative change of the rotation period between two measurements (negative = engine accelerating), as a function of engine speed.

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Detection Threshold (First Oscillation) (new)
table.description: Detection of the first oscillation: anti-jerk acts when the relative change of the crankshaft rotation period falls below this threshold (negative = engine accelerating), as a function of engine speed. The closer to 0, the more sensitive the detection.

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Detection Threshold (Next Oscillations) (new)
table.description: Like 'Anti-Jerk - Detection Threshold (First Oscillation) (new)', for the following oscillations (see 'Anti-Jerk - Max. Detections (new)').

table.name: STFT - Neg I (new)
table.description: Lambda control: integral slope, lean -> rich direction, as a function of engine speed and load. Correction added every 20 ms: map value x 'Lambda PI - I Multiplier Bank 1 (new)' / 'Lambda PI - I Multiplier Bank 2 (new)' (both x/256), then x 'STFT - Overrun Slowdown Factor (vs ECT) (new)'.

table.name: STFT - Neg P (new)
table.description: Lambda control: proportional jump, lean -> rich direction, as a function of engine speed and load. Jump applied at each sensor switch: map value x 'Lambda PI - P Multiplier (new)' (both x/256), then x 'STFT - Overrun Slowdown Factor (vs ECT) (new)'.

table.name: STFT - Pos I (new)
table.description: Lambda control: integral slope, rich -> lean direction, as a function of engine speed and load. Correction added every 20 ms: map value x 'Lambda PI - I Multiplier Bank 1 (new)' / 'Lambda PI - I Multiplier Bank 2 (new)' (both x/256), then x 'STFT - Overrun Slowdown Factor (vs ECT) (new)'.

table.name: STFT - Pos P (new)
table.description: Lambda control: proportional jump, rich -> lean direction, as a function of engine speed and load. Jump applied at each sensor switch: map value x 'Lambda PI - P Multiplier (new)' (both x/256), then x 'STFT - Overrun Slowdown Factor (vs ECT) (new)'.

table.name: STFT - Overrun Slowdown Factor (vs ECT) (new)
table.description: Factor slowing the lambda control in overrun, as a function of coolant temperature; maximum value (1.0) = no slowing.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Condensation Phase (vs ECT at Start) (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: duration of the condensation phase (reduced heating while there may be water in the exhaust), as a function of coolant temperature at start. Budget counted down by 'O2 Sensor Heater - Condensation Phase Decrement (vs Air Flow) (new)'; 0 = no condensation phase. Only with lambda control coded.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Condensation Phase Decrement (vs Air Flow) (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: amount removed every second from the condensation phase budget, as a function of air flow (more flow = exhaust dries faster). Budget used up: full power during 'O2 Sensor Heater - Full Power Time (new)'.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Base Duty (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: base duty cycle, as a function of engine speed and load, then multiplied by the heater adaptation factor.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Base Duty Ramp Up (vs Air Flow) (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: rate of increase of the duty cycle towards 'O2 Sensor Heater - Base Duty (vs RPM/Load) (new)', as a function of air flow.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Base Duty Ramp Down (vs Air Flow) (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: rate of decrease of the duty cycle towards 'O2 Sensor Heater - Base Duty (vs RPM/Load) (new)', as a function of air flow.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Adaptation Step Bank 1 (vs Signal Center) (new)
table.description: Bank 1 O2 sensor heating: correction of the heating factor as a function of the deviation of the sensor signal centre from 'O2 Sensor Heater - Signal Center Reference (new)' (positive deviation = more heating, negative = less).

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Adaptation Step Bank 2 (vs Signal Center) (new)
table.description: Like 'O2 Sensor Heater - Adaptation Step Bank 1 (vs Signal Center) (new)', for the bank 2 sensor.

table.name: Max. Knock Retard (Lambda) (new)
table.description: Limp-home ignition angle of the knock control (engine speed x load), vehicles with lambda control; 'Max. Knock Retard' is only read without lambda control.

table.name: Knock Detection - Reference Level Initial (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Initial noise reference level of each cylinder when the knock control is reset, as a function of engine speed; also used to normalise the noise level.

table.name: Knock Sensor - Satellite Gain Factor (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Knock sensor signal gain factor, as a function of engine speed (multiplied by the adapted gain, capped at 255). The gain is sent to the satellite in message ASC1 0x101 at each TDC; the measured level is read back 48 deg later (message 0x102).

table.name: Knock Detection - Reference Offset (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Offset (knock addend) added to the noise reference level of each cylinder before comparison (0 = no offset). Read without interpolation.

table.name: Knock Detection - Dynamic Mode RPM Gradient (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Engine speed change above which knock detection switches to transient mode (faster filtering of the reference level), as a function of engine speed.

table.name: Knock Detection - Dynamic Mode Duration (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Duration of the transient mode of knock detection, as a function of engine speed. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment.

table.name: Knock Adaptation - Min. Load (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Minimum load for learning the per-cylinder knock retard, as a function of engine speed (outside transients and faults). Read without interpolation.

table.name: Canister Purge - HC Adaptation Step (vs Air Flow) (new)
table.description: Learning rate of the canister fuel vapour load (mixture correction due to purge), as a function of air flow (rate limit of the lambda controller preset value). Larger = faster learning.

table.name: Canister Purge - Purge Level Step Down (vs Air Flow) (new)
table.description: Rate of decrease of the purge level (share of the target removed every 100 ms), as a function of air flow.

table.name: Canister Purge - Purge Level Step Up (vs Air Flow) (new)
table.description: Rate of increase of the purge level (share of the target added every 100 ms), as a function of air flow.

table.name: Canister Purge - Flow Limit (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.description: Limit of the purge level according to engine speed and load (lambda controller preset value).

table.name: Canister Purge - Min. Load for Adaptation (vs RPM) (new)
table.description: Minimum load for the purge adjustment, as a function of engine speed. Zero in this file.
