table.description: O2 sensor heating: reference of the sensor signal centre (mean of the rich and lean peaks). Centre above = more heating, below = less. Voltage read directly on the sensor input (AN6 bank 1, AN7 bank 2): titania sensors supplied with 5 V, about 4.6 V lean and 0.1 V rich.

table.name: Lambda - Stability Average Weight (new)
table.description: Averaging weight of an internal lambda stability quantity (used during canister purge).

table.name: Lambda - Adaptation Min. Switch Count (new)
table.description: Minimum number of sensor switches before the lambda adaptations are learned, outside idle.

table.name: Lambda - Adaptation Min. Switch Count (Idle) (new)
table.description: Minimum number of sensor switches before the lambda adaptations are learned, at idle.

table.name: Lambda - Adaptation Step (Part Load) (new)
table.description: Learning step of the lambda adaptations at part load.

table.name: Lambda - Adaptation Step (After Reset) (new)
table.description: Learning step applied once after the adaptations are reset. 0 in this file.

table.name: Lambda - Adaptation Step (Idle) (new)
table.description: Learning step of the lambda adaptations at idle.

table.name: Lambda - Adaptation Step (Purge Active) (new)
table.description: Learning step of the lambda adaptations when canister purge is active; 0 = no learning during purge.

table.name: Lambda - Reset Counter Init (new)
table.description: Internal initial value of the reset counters of both lambda banks.

table.name: Lambda PI - Idle Fixed-Value Switch Delay (new)
table.description: Number of lambda proportional jumps (probe switching events) made with the normal P/I maps after the engine enters the idle state, before the lambda controller switches to the fixed idle P/I values (CAL_0191/0192/0194/0195). The per-bank counter is loaded with this value on the first switching event in idle and decremented at each proportional jump; when it reaches zero, the fixed values are used for the rest of the idle phase. Leaving idle returns to the maps and re-arms the counter. 0 = fixed values are used immediately in idle.

table.name: Lambda - Sensor Ready Init (Bank 1) (new)
table.description: Number of sensor switches expected, after the end of heating, before the signal centre calculation is allowed (applies to both banks).

table.name: Lambda - Mode Init (Bank 1) (new)
table.description: Initial voltage offset of the sensor rich threshold, bank 1 (bank 2 uses the next byte). Voltage read directly on the sensor input (AN6 bank 1, AN7 bank 2): titania sensors supplied with 5 V, about 4.6 V lean and 0.1 V rich.

table.name: Lambda PI - I Multiplier Bank 1 (new)
table.description: Multiplier (1.0 = 256) of the integral slope of the bank 1 lambda control ('STFT - Neg I (new)' / 'STFT - Pos I (new)' or fixed values).

table.name: Lambda PI - I Multiplier Bank 2 (new)
table.description: Multiplier (1.0 = 256) of the integral slope of the bank 2 lambda control.

table.name: Lambda PI - P Multiplier (new)
table.description: Multiplier (1.0 = 256) of the proportional jump of the lambda control of both banks ('STFT - Neg P (new)' / 'STFT - Pos P (new)' or fixed values).

table.name: Lambda PI - Idle Fixed I (Neg) (new)
table.description: Fixed integral slope, Neg direction, used at idle instead of the corresponding lambda PI map ('STFT - Neg I (new)') once the number of switching events set by 'Lambda PI - Idle Fixed-Value Switch Delay' has elapsed in the idle state (immediately if that value is 0). Multiplied by the per-bank I multiplier (and by the coolant-temperature factor when active) before being applied to the lambda correction.

table.name: Lambda PI - Idle Fixed P (Neg) (new)
table.description: Fixed proportional jump, Neg direction, used at idle instead of the corresponding lambda PI map ('STFT - Neg P (new)') once the number of switching events set by 'Lambda PI - Idle Fixed-Value Switch Delay' has elapsed in the idle state (immediately if that value is 0). Multiplied by the P multiplier (and by the coolant-temperature factor when active) before being applied to the lambda correction.

table.name: Lambda PI - Idle Fixed I (Pos) (new)
table.description: Fixed integral slope, Pos direction, used at idle instead of the corresponding lambda PI map ('STFT - Pos I (new)') once the number of switching events set by 'Lambda PI - Idle Fixed-Value Switch Delay' has elapsed in the idle state (immediately if that value is 0). Multiplied by the per-bank I multiplier (and by the coolant-temperature factor when active) before being applied to the lambda correction.

table.name: Lambda PI - Idle Fixed P (Pos) (new)
table.description: Fixed proportional jump, Pos direction, used at idle instead of the corresponding lambda PI map ('STFT - Pos P (new)') once the number of switching events set by 'Lambda PI - Idle Fixed-Value Switch Delay' has elapsed in the idle state (immediately if that value is 0). Multiplied by the P multiplier (and by the coolant-temperature factor when active) before being applied to the lambda correction.

table.name: Lambda - Seed Selection ECT (new)
table.description: Coolant temperature choosing the initialisation value of the sensor lean threshold: below it 'Lambda - Seed Value (Cold) (new)', above it 'Lambda - Seed Value (Warm) (new)'.

table.name: Lambda - Seed Value (Warm) (new)
table.description: Initial value of the sensor lean threshold, warm engine. Voltage read directly on the sensor input (AN6 bank 1, AN7 bank 2): titania sensors supplied with 5 V, about 4.6 V lean and 0.1 V rich.

table.name: Lambda - Seed Value (Cold) (new)
table.description: Initial value of the sensor lean threshold, cold engine. Voltage read directly on the sensor input (AN6 bank 1, AN7 bank 2): titania sensors supplied with 5 V, about 4.6 V lean and 0.1 V rich.

table.name: Lambda Tracker - Decrement Step (new)
table.description: Decrease step of the sensor rich threshold offset. Voltage read directly on the sensor input (AN6 bank 1, AN7 bank 2): titania sensors supplied with 5 V, about 4.6 V lean and 0.1 V rich.

table.name: Lambda - Min. Detection Band Width (new)
table.description: Minimum width of the sensor detection band (difference between lean and rich thresholds). If the band stays narrower, a counter loaded with 254 counts down; at 0: sensor anomaly DTC 200 (bank 1) / 201 (bank 2). 51 = 1.0 V in this software. Voltage read directly on the sensor input (AN6 bank 1, AN7 bank 2): titania sensors supplied with 5 V, about 4.6 V lean and 0.1 V rich.

table.name: Lambda - Detection Band Factor Upper (new)
table.description: Factor of the upper limit of the sensor rich/lean detection band.

table.name: Lambda - Detection Band Factor Lower (new)
table.description: Factor of the lower limit of the sensor rich/lean detection band.

table.name: Lambda Tracker - Band Offset (new)
table.description: Difference between the signal peaks and the switching thresholds: lean threshold = lean peak + value, rich threshold = rich peak - value. Voltage read directly on the sensor input (AN6 bank 1, AN7 bank 2): titania sensors supplied with 5 V, about 4.6 V lean and 0.1 V rich.

table.name: Lambda - Band Reset Value (new)
table.description: Value reloaded into the detection band after a band width anomaly. Voltage read directly on the sensor input (AN6 bank 1, AN7 bank 2): titania sensors supplied with 5 V, about 4.6 V lean and 0.1 V rich.

table.name: Lambda - Sensor Voltage Upper Limit (new)
table.description: Sensor voltage above which the sample is abnormal (DTC 75/76). Voltage read directly on the sensor input (AN6 bank 1, AN7 bank 2): titania sensors supplied with 5 V, about 4.6 V lean and 0.1 V rich.

table.name: Lambda - Sensor Voltage Lower Limit (new)
table.description: Sensor voltage below which the sample is abnormal after heating (DTC 75/76). Voltage read directly on the sensor input (AN6 bank 1, AN7 bank 2): titania sensors supplied with 5 V, about 4.6 V lean and 0.1 V rich.

table.name: Lambda Tracker - Filter Coefficient (new)
table.description: Filter coefficient of the sensor threshold tracking.

table.name: Lambda Diagnosis - Min. Switch Count (new)
table.description: Sensor ageing diagnosis: minimum number of switches for the evaluation in deceleration.

table.name: Lambda Diagnosis - Max. Rich Peak Voltage (new)
table.description: Sensor ageing diagnosis: maximum rich peak for the evaluation. Voltage read directly on the sensor input (AN6 bank 1, AN7 bank 2): titania sensors supplied with 5 V, about 4.6 V lean and 0.1 V rich.

table.name: Lambda Diagnosis - Max. O2 Heater Duty (new)
table.description: Sensor ageing diagnosis: heater duty cycle below which an ageing sensor (low rich peak, many switches) activates the catalyst protection.

table.name: Catalyst Protection - Activation Delay (new)
table.description: Delay before catalyst protection mode is activated. When the catalyst-protection activation conditions are met (engine load above the activation map threshold with the lambda probes switching normally, or the coolant-temperature activation path), the catalyst-protection request bits are set. If this value is 0, the protection-active flag is set immediately; otherwise the value is loaded into a 1 s soft timer (only if it is not already running) and the flag is set when the timer expires. While the flag is set, closed-loop lambda control is suspended (controller state reset) and the catalyst-protection fuel factor is applied during rev/speed limiter cuts. The pending timer is cancelled if the conditions disappear. At expiry, the 'Lambda Diagnosis Hold Time' timer is also started when the load-based path is active.

table.name: Lambda Diagnosis - Hold Time (new)
table.description: Delay armed at the end of the sensor diagnosis evaluation.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Full Power Time (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: full-power heating time after the condensation phase, before the sensors are activated.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Initial State Timer (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: delay armed at the end of the condensation phase, before the initial control state.

table.name: O2 Heater - Duty Update Period (new)
table.description: Execution period of the O2 sensor heater duty update task. The value is loaded into a 1 s soft timer at start-up; at each expiry the timer callback posts the heater duty update task (task 2 of the background task table) to the low-priority queue and reloads the timer with this value. Smaller values update the heater duty more often.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Upper Limit (new)
table.description: Idle air adaptation, A/C off: upper limit of the learned value.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Upper Limit (A/C on) (new)
table.description: Idle air adaptation, A/C engaged: upper limit of the learned value.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Lower Limit (new)
table.description: Idle air adaptation, A/C off: lower limit of the learned value.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Lower Limit (A/C on) (new)
table.description: Idle air adaptation, A/C engaged: lower limit of the learned value.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Min. ECT (new)
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature for the idle air adaptation, A/C off.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Min. ECT (A/C on) (new)
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature for the idle air adaptation, A/C engaged.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Max. Deviation (new)
table.description: Maximum deviation between the filtered value and the idle speed control; beyond it, idle air learning is suspended.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Settle Threshold (new)
table.description: Engine speed stability threshold before idle air learning.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Settle Delay (new)
table.description: Number of stable checks required before the idle air learning is validated. Unit: x 40 ms.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Filter Coefficient (new)
table.description: Filter coefficient of the value used for idle air learning.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Gain (new)
table.description: Gain applied to the candidate value of the idle air learning.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Max. ECT (new)
table.description: Coolant temperature limit for idle air learning (vehicle stopped).

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - EEPROM Save Factor (new)
table.description: Factor applied to the 'A/C engaged' adaptation before it is saved to EEPROM.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Zone Offset (new)
table.description: Offset added to the zone result of the idle air adaptation.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation Diagnosis - Lower Margin (new)
table.description: Idle air adaptation diagnosis: lower margin. 0 in this file.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation Diagnosis - Upper Margin (new)
table.description: Idle air adaptation diagnosis: upper margin; 255 = check inactive.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation Diagnosis - Result Limit (new)
table.description: Idle air adaptation diagnosis: limit beyond which an anomaly is reported; 255 = never.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation Diagnosis - Filter Factor (new)
table.description: Idle air adaptation diagnosis: filter factor.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation Diagnosis - Load Offset (new)
table.description: Idle air adaptation diagnosis: air flow offset added to the corrected value.

table.name: Idle Air Adaptation - Accumulator Step (new)
table.description: Rate at which the integral term of the idle speed control approaches the adapted value.

table.name: Idle Speed Control - Moving Integrator Limits Delay (new)
table.description: Delay after the vehicle starts moving before the idle speed controller switches its integrator limits from the 'vehicle stopped' set to the 'vehicle moving' set (or the 'vehicle moving with AC on' set when the compressor is engaged). Loaded into a 10 ms soft timer when vehicle speed becomes non-zero; when it expires, the moving-vehicle limits are used. If a bypass condition flag is set, the moving limits are used immediately. When vehicle speed returns to zero, the stopped limits are used again at once.

table.name: ISR - Derivative - Min. Time (new)
table.description: Minimum active time of the idle speed control derivative term after an engine speed drop below 'Intercept - RPM'.

table.name: Idle Speed - RPM Drop Threshold (new)
table.description: Engine speed drop, relative to the return-to-idle reference speed, beyond which 'Idle Speed - RPM Drop Hold Time (new)' is armed.

table.name: Idle Speed - RPM Rise Threshold (new)
table.description: Engine speed rise, relative to the return-to-idle reference speed, beyond which the second correction mode is activated. 0 in this file.

table.name: Idle Speed - RPM Drop Hold Time (new)
table.description: Delay armed after an engine speed drop larger than 'Idle Speed - RPM Drop Threshold (new)'.

table.name: Idle Speed - RPM Error Ramp Offset (new)
table.description: Offset added to the stored speed error to compute the idle exit threshold.

table.name: Idle Speed - RPM Error Integrator Min. (new)
table.description: Lower limit of the speed error integrator used on return to idle (0 = neutral).

table.name: Idle Speed - RPM Error Integrator Gain (new)
table.description: Gain of the speed error integrator used on return to idle.

table.name: Idle Speed - RPM Error Ramp Rate (new)
table.description: Slope of the speed error ramp when the filtered error is strongly negative.

table.name: Idle Speed - Target Rise Rate (new)
table.description: Maximum rise rate of the target idle speed (per calculation, every 10 ms).

table.name: Idle Speed - Voltage Interpolation Max. RPM (new)
table.description: Below this engine speed (engine running), a battery voltage dependent value is filtered and taken into account in the target idle speed calculation.

table.name: Idle Speed - Voltage Interpolation Rate (new)
table.description: Filter coefficient of the battery voltage dependent value used by the target idle speed (below 'Idle Speed - Voltage Interpolation Max. RPM (new)').

table.name: K-Line - Idle Speed Offset Max. (new)
table.description: Maximum idle offset accepted when the idle speed is adjusted with the diagnostic tester (K-line).

table.name: K-Line - Idle Speed Adjust Min. ECT (new)
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature to accept an idle speed adjustment with the tester (engine idling, automatic transmission not in gear).

table.name: K-Line - CO Adjust Min. ECT (new)
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature to accept a CO adjustment with the tester (vehicles without lambda control), at idle and with no stored fault.

table.name: IACV - AC Ramp Initial Value (new)
table.description: Start value of the ramp applying the A/C opening (see 'IACV - AC Compressor Ramp-in Rate (vs RPM) (new)').

table.name: IACV - Rate Limit Step (new)
table.description: Rate limiter of the idle valve target: maximum change step.

table.name: IACV - Rate Limit Deadband (new)
table.description: Rate limiter of the idle valve target: dead band.

table.name: IACV - Rate Limit Tolerance (new)
table.description: Rate limiter of the idle valve target: tolerance around the A/C pre-control.

table.name: IACV - Map Rise Step (new)
table.description: Maximum rise rate of the pre-control from 'IACV - TPS', per idle control calculation.

table.name: IACV - Map Fall Step (new)
table.description: Maximum fall rate of the pre-control from 'IACV - TPS', per idle control calculation.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Condensation Phase Factor (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: factor applied to the base duty cycle during the condensation phase.

table.name: Fuel - Injection Time Decrement Limit (new)
table.description: Maximum decrease of the injection time from one calculation to the next in some phases (limits sudden drops).

table.name: Rev Limiter - Catalyst Protection Fuel Factor (new)
table.description: Fuel factor applied during rev limiting for catalyst protection: applied fuel factor = 1 - this value (1 = full cut).

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limiter - Fuel Factor (new)
table.description: Fuel factor applied during vehicle speed limiting: applied fuel factor = 1 - this value.

table.name: Fuel - Minimum Injection Time (new)
table.description: Minimum injection time (before the injector dead time is added), during cranking and running.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Cranking - First Start Pulse Factor (new)
table.description: Correction factor applied to the cranking injection pulse width (base cranking pulse from coolant temperature, times hot-start factor) only for the first engine start after the DME is switched on: the flag enabling it is set when the DME initializes at ignition on and cleared when the engine state machine enters the running state after start. Restarts later in the same ignition cycle use the uncorrected pulse. 1.000 = no change.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Hot Restart ECT Margin (new)
table.description: Hot restart detection: if coolant temperature at start is higher than the temperature stored at shutdown minus this margin, the restart is considered hot (Hot Start Factor tables).

table.name: CH 2 - Fuel Correction (Acceleration) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: fuel correction applied on acceleration, multiplied by the VANOS position.

table.name: CH 2 - Fuel Correction (Warm-up) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: fuel correction applied during warm-up, multiplied by the VANOS position.

table.name: CH 2 - Fuel Correction Decay Step (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: decay step of the fuel correction.

table.name: Fuel - Overrun Exit Correction Step (new)
table.description: Rate at which the re-entry correction after a fuel cut ('Fuel Injection - Overrun Exit Correction A (vs ECT) (new)' to D) returns to 0, removed at each ignition.

table.name: Fuel - Overrun Exit Correction Step (Alt.) (new)
table.description: Like 'Fuel - Overrun Exit Correction Step (new)', in a particular re-entry case.

table.name: Fuel - Re-entry Correction Increment (new)
table.description: Fuel re-entry correction: increment per engine cycle during the fuel cut.

table.name: Fuel - Overrun Exit Correction Counter Init (new)
table.description: Number of steps of the re-entry correction after a fuel cut.

table.name: Spark Plug Cleaning - Factor Decrement (new)
table.description: Decrement step of the spark plug cleaning weighting factor.

table.name: Fuel - Correction Table ECT Threshold (new)
table.description: Coolant temperature below which 'Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Reduction Gradient (Low ECT)' is used instead of 'Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Reduction Gradient (Normal ECT)'.

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Max. Cycle Fraction (new)
table.description: Load increase enrichment: maximum remaining-session fraction for a re-trigger.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Ramp Down Rate (new)
table.description: Rate at which the applied advance decreases towards the target, in some phases (fuel cut). Value added to the applied advance at each ignition.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Ramp Up Rate (Load) (new)
table.description: Rate at which the applied advance increases towards the target, under load (above 'Ignition Timing - Ramp RPM Threshold (new)' or 'Ignition Timing - Ramp Load Threshold (new)'). Value added to the applied advance at each ignition.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Ramp Up Rate (Low Load) (new)
table.description: Rate at which the applied advance increases towards the target below 'Ignition Timing - Ramp Load Threshold (new)'; also used for the advance return after knock. Value added to the applied advance at each ignition.

table.name: Ignition Timing - ASC Retard Step (new)
table.description: Ignition retard step applied on an ASC torque reduction request, per ignition.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Ramp RPM Threshold (new)
table.description: Engine speed above which 'Ignition Timing - Ramp Up Rate (Load) (new)' is used.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Ramp Load Threshold (new)
table.description: Load below which 'Ignition Timing - Ramp Up Rate (Low Load) (new)' is used.

table.name: CH - Ignition Rate Limit (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating: ignition rate limit per engine cycle.

table.name: CH 3 - Ignition Rate Limit (Part Load) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 3: ignition rate limit at part load per engine cycle.

table.name: CH 3 - Min. Idle Time (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 3: minimum idle time before the coolant threshold 'CH 3 - Min. ECT (Lambda) (new)' / '(No Lambda)' is tested.

table.name: CH 3 - Min. ECT (Lambda) (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 3: minimum coolant temperature (vehicles with lambda control).

table.name: CH 3 - Vehicle Speed Threshold (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 3: vehicle speed threshold; at or below it the idle time counter is reset.

table.name: CH 3 - Part Load Time Threshold (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 3: part-load time (below 'CH 3 - Part Load Max. RPM (new)' and 'CH 3 - Part Load Max. Load (new)') beyond which the heating correction is activated.

table.name: CH 3 - Part Load Time Max. (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 3: cap of the part-load time counter.

table.name: CH 3 - Part Load Max. RPM (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 3: maximum engine speed for the part-load time counter to advance.

table.name: CH 3 - Part Load Max. Load (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 3: maximum load for the part-load time counter to advance.

table.name: CH 2 - Max. Vehicle Speed (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: maximum vehicle speed.

table.name: CH 3 - Ignition Weight (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 3: ignition weighting factor.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Offset (TPS & Load Fault) (new)
table.description: Offset added to the base advance when both the throttle sensor and the load measurement are faulty.

table.name: Spark Plug Cleaning - Max. ECT (new)
table.description: Coolant temperature below which spark plug cleaning ('Spark Plug Cleaning - Ignition Timing (vs RPM/Load) (new)') is applied.

table.name: Spark Plug Cleaning - Min. ECT (new)
table.description: Coolant temperature above which spark plug cleaning is evaluated.

table.name: Ignition Dwell - Per Cylinder Step (new)
table.description: Rate at which the per-cylinder dwell factor returns to 1.0. 0 in this file: inactive.

table.name: Ignition Dwell - Maximum Factor (new)
table.description: Maximum per-cylinder dwell factor (1.0 = nominal dwell time).

table.name: Ignition Dwell - Cranking Init (new)
table.description: Internal initial value of the ignition feedback tracking during cranking.

table.name: Ignition Dwell - Per-Cylinder Feedback Max RPM (new)
table.description: Engine speed threshold of the per-cylinder ignition dwell feedback. Below this speed, the dwell factor of every cylinder is regulated individually by the dwell feedback. Above it (flag set when RPM is above the threshold, cleared when RPM falls below it), only the reference cylinder is regulated; the dwell factors of the other cylinders are derived from the reference cylinder's correction multiplied by each cylinder's stored ratio and limited to the dwell minimum/maximum factors. When the speed drops back below the threshold, the per-cylinder factors are re-initialized once in the same way before individual regulation resumes.

table.name: Ignition Current Diagnosis - Max. Value (new)
table.description: Maximum ignition current used by the per-cylinder ignition circuit diagnosis.

table.name: VSS Limiter - Time Base Divisor (new)
table.description: Calibration constant of the vehicle speed calculation used by the speed limiter (speed = 3600 / this value x sensor frequency). Only change it for another sensor or final drive ratio.

table.name: VSS Plausibility - Max. Count (new)
table.description: Vehicle speed sensor plausibility (DTC 214): number of checks with zero speed while engine speed and load are high before the fault is reported.

table.name: VSS Plausibility - Min. RPM (new)
table.description: Minimum engine speed for the vehicle speed sensor plausibility check (DTC 214).

table.name: VSS Plausibility - Min. Load (new)
table.description: Minimum load for the vehicle speed sensor plausibility check (DTC 214).

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limiter - Mode (new)
table.description: Speed limiter mode: 1 = mode with delay ('Vehicle Speed Limiter - Timer (new)'); 0 in this file.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limiter - Hysteresis (new)
table.description: Speed limiter exit hysteresis: the intervention stops below 'Vehicle Speed Limit' minus this value.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limiter - Timer (new)
table.description: Speed limiter delay.

table.name: Engine Speed Limiter - TPS & MAF Fault (new)
table.description: Engine speed limit when both the throttle sensor and the air flow meter are faulty.

table.name: Engine Speed Limiter - TPS Fault (new)
table.description: Engine speed limit when the throttle sensor is faulty.

table.name: Fuel Cut - RPM Gradient Threshold (new)
table.description: Engine speed drop (negative gradient) from which injection is forced back on during a deceleration fuel cut below 'Intercept - RPM', to avoid stalling.

table.name: Engine State - Idle Entry RPM (new)
table.description: Engine speed below which the engine enters the idle state. 0 in this file (not used).

table.name: Dashpot - Min. RPM (new)
table.description: Minimum engine speed for the dashpot.

table.name: Fuel Cut - Min. RPM (Diagnosis) (new)
table.description: Minimum engine speed for the overrun fuel cut diagnosis.

table.name: Engine State - Running RPM Threshold (Anti-Theft) (new)
table.description: Engine speed above which the engine is considered running for the anti-theft (immobiliser) logic, once EWS is validated.

table.name: Fuel Pump - Run-On After Last Crank Signal (new)
table.description: Fuel pump run time after the last crankshaft sensor signal (switches the pump off if the engine stalls).

table.name: Fuel Pump - Prime Time (Ignition On) (new)
table.description: Fuel pump prime time at ignition on; the pump is then switched off if the engine is not turning.

table.name: System - Main Relay After-Run Time (new)
table.description: Main relay hold time after the engine stops (6.0 s in this software; 300 s if the engine has not run). Ignition off is detected by the voltage drop on the battery input AN5 (after-run state); the ECU saves the EEPROM (adaptations, faults) then releases P3.0.

table.name: Spark Plug Cleaning - Duration (new)
table.description: Duration of the spark plug cleaning after reset. Unit: cycles (720 deg crank).

table.name: System - Coding Check Timer (new)
table.description: Time allowed for the EWS immobiliser check at ignition on (message 0x109 relayed by the satellite, before the starter acts); without a valid message within this time: DTC 18. 4.0 s in this software.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Adaptation Factor Init (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: initial value of the adaptation factor at start (1.0 = neutral).

table.name: VANOS - Enable Delay after Start (new)
table.description: Delay after the end of cranking before VANOS is allowed (5.0 s in this software): timer B+0x18 armed by EngineState_Machine; when it expires, SoftTimerB_Cb12 sets word_FD2E.6, without which the cam stays at rest. Canister purge is reset at the same place in the program.

table.name: IAT/ECT Diagnosis - Delay after Start (new)
table.description: Delay after start before the intake air / coolant temperature diagnosis is evaluated.

table.name: Hot Restart - Max. Time (new)
table.description: Maximum time after shutdown for a restart to be treated as a hot restart.

table.name: CH 2 - Max. Part Load Time (new)
table.description: Catalyst heating 2: maximum part-load time.

table.name: ABS/ASC - Max. Duration P1.12 (Cut) (new)
table.description: Maximum duration of the ABS/ASC injection and ignition cut request (wire P1.12); beyond it: DTC 80.

table.name: ABS/ASC - Max. Duration P1.14 (Torque Reduction) (new)
table.description: Maximum duration of the ABS/ASC torque reduction request (wire P1.14); beyond it: DTC 82.

table.name: ABS/ASC - Max. Duration P1.13 (MSR) (new)
table.description: Maximum duration of the MSR request (engine drag torque control, wire P1.13); beyond it: DTC 81.

table.name: CAN DME4 - Temperature Display Hysteresis (new)
table.description: Hysteresis of the coolant temperature value sent to the gauge (CAN DME4): the stored value is updated when the temperature rises by more than this value.

table.name: Knock Adaptation - Max. ECT (new)
table.description: Maximum coolant temperature for the knock adaptation.

table.name: Knock Adaptation - Min. ECT (new)
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature for the knock adaptation.

table.name: Full Load Detection - Min. Vehicle Speed (new)
table.description: Minimum vehicle speed for full-load detection.

table.name: Full Load Detection - Min. ECT (new)
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature for full-load detection.

table.name: Load Filter - Coefficient (Intercept) (new)
table.description: Load filter coefficient on intercept (resumption after overrun fuel cut).

table.name: Load Filter - Coefficient (Idle) (new)
table.description: Load filter coefficient at idle.

table.name: Load Mode - Filter Coefficient (new)
table.description: Final filter coefficient of the engine load.

table.name: Knock - Dynamic Mode Factor (new)
table.description: Factor applied to the noise level deviation in transient mode.

table.name: Knock - Mode Enable (new)
table.description: 0 = blocks the learning of the knock retard in the speed/load zone.

table.name: Knock - Reference Upper Limit (new)
table.description: Maximum value of the per-cylinder noise reference level.

table.name: Knock - Reference Lower Limit (new)
table.description: Minimum value of the per-cylinder noise reference level; when the reference is at this limit the cylinder is flagged for the knock sensor diagnosis (above 'Knock Sensor Diagnosis - Minimum RPM (new)').

table.name: Knock - Reference Filter (Normal) (new)
table.description: Filter coefficient of the per-cylinder noise reference level in normal operation.

table.name: Knock - Reference Filter (Dynamic) (new)
table.description: Filter coefficient of the per-cylinder noise reference level in dynamic mode (engine speed gradient above 'Knock Detection - Dynamic Mode RPM Gradient (vs RPM) (new)', for 'Knock Detection - Dynamic Mode Duration (vs RPM) (new)') and during the tip-in duration.

table.name: Knock - Load Change Threshold (new)
table.description: Load change beyond which knock detection switches to transient mode.

table.name: Knock - RPM Change Threshold (new)
table.description: Engine speed change beyond which knock detection switches to transient mode.

table.name: Knock - Retard Step (new)
table.description: Transfer step of the knock retard to the adaptation cell on a cell change.

table.name: Knock - Max Cylinder Retard Deviation From Average (new)
table.description: Maximum allowed deviation of an individual cylinder's knock retard from the average knock retard of all cylinders. After each per-cylinder retard update (retard step, decay, adaptation offset and retard limit applied), the cylinder's retard is clamped to the range average retard - value ... average retard + value. Small values keep all cylinders close to the common average; large values allow fully individual retard.

table.name: Knock Sensor Diagnosis - Minimum RPM (new)
table.description: Engine speed above which the knock sensor diagnosis (DTC 57/59) is evaluated.

table.name: Knock - Gain Adaptation Upper Limit (new)
table.description: Upper limit of the knock signal gain adaptation.

table.name: Knock - Gain Adaptation Lower Limit (new)
table.description: Lower limit of the knock signal gain adaptation.

table.name: Knock - Gain Adaptation Rate (new)
table.description: Knock signal gain adaptation rate (targets a mean level normalised by 'Knock Detection - Reference Level Initial (vs RPM) (new)').

table.name: Knock - Offset Adaptation Delay (Up) (new)
table.description: Time before the adaptive knock offset is increased by one step. Unit: segments (120 deg crank).

table.name: Knock - Offset Adaptation Delay (Down) (new)
table.description: Time before the adaptive knock offset is decreased by one step. Unit: segments (120 deg crank).

table.name: Knock - Offset Adaptation Low Threshold (new)
table.description: Low deviation threshold to decrease the adaptive knock offset.

table.name: Knock - Offset Adaptation High Threshold (new)
table.description: High deviation threshold to increase the adaptive knock offset.

table.name: Adaptation Cells - EEPROM Save Offset (new)
table.description: Offset added to the adaptation cells before they are saved to EEPROM.

table.name: Engine Roughness - Filter Coefficient (new)
table.description: Misfire detection: filter coefficient of the per-cylinder speed irregularity.

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Max. Detections (new)
table.description: Number of detections from which the threshold 'Anti-Jerk - Detection Threshold (Next Oscillations) (new)' replaces the first-oscillation threshold.

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Retard Factor (2nd Oscillation) (new)
table.description: Factor applied to the retard 'Ignition Timing - Anti-Jerk (new)' on the 2nd oscillation (1 = full retard).

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Retard Factor (Next Oscillations) (new)
table.description: Factor applied to the retard 'Ignition Timing - Anti-Jerk (new)' from the 3rd oscillation (1 = full retard).

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Max Retard Duration (new)
table.description: Maximum duration of one anti-jerk ignition-retard intervention. Loaded into a 10 ms soft timer each time a jerk is detected and the retard is activated. When the timer expires, the intervention is ended: the retard-active flag is cleared and the anti-jerk retard output is set to zero. The intervention can end earlier if the engine-period gradient goes back above the exit threshold.

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Detection Sequence Window (new)
table.description: Length of the anti-jerk detection sequence window. Loaded into a 10 ms soft timer at the first jerk detection of a sequence (detection counter set to 1). Further detections within the window increment the detection counter (limited by 'Anti-Jerk Max Detections') and re-trigger the retard. When the window expires, the detection counter is reset to zero, the retard-duration timer is cancelled and any running intervention is ended (retard output set to zero).

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Minimum ECT (new)
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature to allow anti-jerk.

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Minimum RPM (new)
table.description: Minimum engine speed to allow anti-jerk (and no active sensor fault).

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Maximum RPM (new)
table.description: Maximum engine speed to allow anti-jerk.

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Minimum Vehicle Speed (new)
table.description: Minimum vehicle speed to allow anti-jerk.

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Maximum Vehicle Speed (new)
table.description: Maximum vehicle speed to allow anti-jerk.

table.name: Anti-Jerk - Gradient Source RPM (new)
table.description: Measurement switch-over speed: below it, the speed variation is measured over 120 crank degrees (one ignition), above it over 360 degrees (one revolution).

table.name: AC - WOT Cut-off Time (new)
table.description: A/C compressor cut-off time when going to full load (to free power). 4.0 s in this software; the compressor is re-engaged 0.5 to 1 s after returning to part load.

table.name: AC - WOT Cut-off Re-trigger Lockout (new)
table.description: Lockout time after a full-load (WOT) AC compressor cut-off has been triggered. If non-zero, a lockout flag is set and this value is loaded into a 1 s soft timer when the cut-off starts; while the flag is set, a new WOT cut-off cannot be triggered. The flag is cleared when the timer expires. 0 = no lockout (the cut-off can be re-triggered immediately).

table.name: AC - Cut-off Time at Start (new)
table.description: Time during which the A/C compressor stays off after engine start.

table.name: AC - Compressor Restart Inhibit Time (new)
table.description: Minimum compressor off time after the AC compressor has been switched off (full-load cut-off, and normal switch-off when the switch-off delay timer expires). The value is loaded into a 100 ms soft timer; while it is running, the compressor switch-on delay is not armed and a compressor request is handled as off. When it expires, an internal status byte is set to 0xCC (marker only, not used for control).

table.name: AC - WOT Cut-off Max. Speed (Lambda) (new)
table.description: Vehicle speed below which the full-load compressor cut-off is allowed (vehicles with lambda control).

table.name: VANOS - Immediate Release RPM (new)
table.description: Below this engine speed, the cam returns to rest as soon as VANOS is no longer requested; above it, the return waits for 'VANOS - Release Delay (new)'.

table.name: VANOS - RPM Hysteresis (new)
table.description: Engine speed hysteresis of the VANOS command.

table.name: VANOS - Release Delay (new)
table.description: VANOS release delay before the cam returns to rest, above 'VANOS - Immediate Release RPM (new)'.

table.name: VANOS - DTC 212 Delay (new)
table.description: Delay before DTC 212 is evaluated after each VANOS position change.

table.name: VANOS - Cam Tolerance (Learned) (new)
table.description: Tolerance added to 'VANOS - Rest Window (new)' once the cam rest position is learned. Value in crank degrees (half in camshaft degrees), measured relative to a reference tooth of the software, not to the absolute timing.

table.name: VANOS - Learning Convergence Threshold (new)
table.description: Deviation between the measured cam position and the learned rest position below which learning is considered finished. Value in crank degrees (half in camshaft degrees), measured relative to a reference tooth of the software, not to the absolute timing.

table.name: VANOS - Cam Tolerance (Not Learned) (new)
table.description: Tolerance added to 'VANOS - Rest Window (new)' while the rest position is not learned; also limits the learned value around 'VANOS - Cam Rest Position Default (new)'. Value in crank degrees (half in camshaft degrees), measured relative to a reference tooth of the software, not to the absolute timing.

table.name: VANOS - Rest Window (new)
table.description: Base half-width of the cam rest position window (before the tolerance is added). Value in crank degrees (half in camshaft degrees), measured relative to a reference tooth of the software, not to the absolute timing.

table.name: VANOS - Advanced Window Extra (new)
table.description: Extra half-width of the full-advance window relative to the rest window. Value in crank degrees (half in camshaft degrees), measured relative to a reference tooth of the software, not to the absolute timing.

table.name: VANOS - Cam Advance Travel (new)
table.description: Expected difference between the cam rest position and the full-advance position; used to compute the VANOS position (0 to 100 %) weighting the VANOS corrections of the maps. Value in crank degrees (half in camshaft degrees), measured relative to a reference tooth of the software, not to the absolute timing.

table.name: VANOS - Cam Rest Position Default (new)
table.description: Default cam rest position, after the adaptations are cleared. Value in crank degrees (half in camshaft degrees), measured relative to a reference tooth of the software, not to the absolute timing.

table.name: VANOS - Cam Rest Learning Filter (new)
table.description: Filter coefficient of the cam rest position learning.

table.name: Exhaust Flap - TPS Hysteresis (new)
table.description: Exhaust flap closing hysteresis: once open, the flap only closes again when the throttle angle falls below the 'Muffler Flap Solenoid' threshold minus this value.

table.name: Exhaust Flap - Minimum Vehicle Speed (new)
table.description: Vehicle speed below which the exhaust flap stays closed; above it, it opens according to the 'Muffler Flap Solenoid' throttle threshold. Also read by VANOS_Control_Update: below this speed, VANOS stays at rest (0 in this software: no effect).

table.name: Exhaust Flap - Delay After Start (new)
table.description: Time after start during which the exhaust flap stays open before being controlled normally.

table.name: CAN EGS1 - Idle Request Max. Duration (new)
table.description: Maximum time during which a non-zero request from the automatic transmission (byte 2 of message EGS1, taken into account at idle by the idle control and the ignition ramp) is accepted; beyond it, word_FD08.12 is set and the request is forced to 0. 3.0 s in this software.

table.name: Byte 4 - A/C and VANOS (new)

state.name: VANOS + A/C with wired inputs (0x26, stock)
No VANOS, A/C with wired inputs (0x06)
No VANOS, A/C with pressure sensor (0x10)

table.description: Air conditioning and VANOS configuration. VANOS: present when bits 5-7 = 001 (0x20). A/C: absent when bits 0-4 = 0. With bit 4 set, the A/C request and the A/C-on information are taken from the A/C pressure sensor (bits 0-3 ignored). With bit 4 = 0, they come from the two A/C inputs of the satellite: the compressor request (compressor control, cut at full load) and the A/C switch (idle speed raise, used only when bit 2 = 1 and bit 3 = 0). Bit 0 / bit 1 = 1: compressor request / A/C switch input taken as read; 0: input inverted. Stock 0x26: VANOS, wired A/C inputs, compressor request inverted, A/C switch used. Other combinations: see 'Byte 4 - A/C and VANOS - Bits (new)'.

table.name: Byte 4 - A/C and VANOS - Bits (new)

bit.name: Bit 0 - A/C compressor request input not inverted
Bit 1 - A/C switch input not inverted
Bit 2 - A/C switch input used for the idle speed (bit 3 = 0)
Bit 4 - A/C pressure sensor instead of the inputs
Bit 5 - VANOS present (bits 6-7 = 0)

table.description: Detail of coding byte 4. A/C present if any of bits 0-4 is set. Bits 3, 6 and 7 must stay at 0 (bit 3 = 1 disables the A/C switch input, bits 6-7 = 1 disable the VANOS).

table.name: Byte 5 - Transmission (new)
table.description: Gearbox type (bits 0-5): 0x00 manual, 0x2B automatic (EGS on CAN), 0x2C detection at power-up. Bit 6: propagation of the stored-fault state. Bit 7: knock control (keep set). CAN monitoring = bus-off monitoring and EGS message 0x43F monitoring (with their faults). It is on when the gearbox is coded automatic or auto-detection (Byte 5), or when Byte 6 bits 5-7 are not 0, or when Byte 7 bit 2 = 1. Stock: 0xAC.

table.name: Byte 5 - Options (new)

bit.name: Bit 6 - Propagation of the stored-fault state
Bit 7 - Knock control active

table.description: Bit 6: propagation of the stored-fault state. Bit 7: knock control active (keep set).

table.name: Byte 6 - CAN Monitoring / EWS Input (new)

bit.name: Bit 0 - EWS removed: external immobiliser input on the satellite (bit 1 = 0)
Bit 5 - CAN monitoring forced on

table.description: Bit 5 (bits 6-7 act the same, keep them at 0): CAN monitoring = bus-off monitoring and EGS message 0x43F monitoring (with their faults). It is on when the gearbox is coded automatic or auto-detection (Byte 5), or when Byte 6 bits 5-7 are not 0, or when Byte 7 bit 2 = 1. Bit 0 (with bit 1 = 0), used only when EWS is removed (Byte 8 bit 7): satellite input bit 2 (Sat_ACInputs_F129) becomes an external immobiliser input; while it is active the engine is blocked as after an EWS refusal. Without this bit, EWS removed means no immobiliser at all. Bits 2-4: see 'Byte 6 - O2 Feedback'. Stock: 0x1C.

table.name: Byte 7 - ABS/ASC / Purge / CRC (new)

bit.name: Bit 0 - ABS/ASC interface by wires P1.12-P1.14 (bits 1-2 = 0)
Bit 2 - CAN monitoring on (no ABS/ASC wire interface)
Bit 3 - Canister purge active
Bit 4 - Calibration CRC check disabled

table.description: Bits 0-2: ABS/ASC (traction control) interface. 001 (bit 0 alone): torque reduction and MSR requests by the three wires P1.14, P1.13 and P1.12, with their duration faults. Any other non-zero value only enables the input states (reported over the K-line) and does not start the interface; bit 2 = 1 also switches CAN monitoring on. Bit 3: canister purge. Bit 4: no CRC check of the calibration regions (a modified calibration is then accepted without checksum correction). Bits 5-7: no effect. Stock: 0x09.

table.name: Byte 8 - OBD / EWS (new)

bit.name: Bit 2 - Idle valve diagnosis
Bit 3 - Exhaust flap (DTC 52)
Bit 7 - EWS removed

table.description: Bit 2: idle valve output diagnosis. Bit 3: exhaust flap. Bit 7: EWS removed (no ISN check). Other bits: no effect. Stock: 0x0F.

table.name: Checksum - Program Code Section (new)
table.description: Enables or disables the integrity check (CRC) of the flash memory. Disabled (0xFF): a wrong CRC is ignored (no fault 100). Stock (0x30): a wrong CRC triggers fault 100 (ECU self-test). Useful after changing the program code (e.g. 'MAF Mode - 2048 kg/hr (new)').

table.name: Checksum - Program Code CRC (new)
table.description: Expected CRC of the program area (the calibration is not covered). Value specific to each file, to recompute after any change of the program code (e.g. 'MAF Mode - 2048 kg/hr (new)') or of bytes 0x2066-0x2067 of the identity block, unless 'Checksum - Program Code Section (new)' = Disabled. Algorithm: reflected CRC-16, polynomial 0xA001, start value = bytes 0x2066-0x2067, over addresses 0x2100-0x3675, 0x4000-0x5E7F and 0x20000-0x3201F.

table.name: Checksum - Boot Sector CRC (new)
table.description: Expected CRC of the boot sector (addresses 0x0000-0x1C13; reflected CRC-16, polynomial 0xA001, start 0x4711). Value specific to the file. Sector 0x0000-0x1FFF is not rewritten by K-line programming: a change here only applies with a programmer, out of the vehicle.

table.name: MAF Mode - 2048 kg/hr (new)
table.description: Choice of the air flow meter scale: 1024 kg/h (stock) or 2048 kg/h (computed flow doubled, for a larger air flow meter). In 2048 mode, edit the curve with 'MAF (2048 kg/hr Mode) (EDIT) (new)'. This setting changes the program code: recompute 'Checksum - Program Code CRC (new)' or set 'Checksum - Program Code Section (new)' to Disabled. Procedure: open the 256 KB file, choose 2048 kg/hr, adjust the curve, correct the CRC, program, then read back the 24 KB.

table.name: MAF (2048 kg/hr Mode) (EDIT) (new)
0 to 5 Volts - Each row is ~0.3 Volts wide

table.description: Air flow meter curve (same bytes as 'MAF') shown with the 2048 kg/h mode scale. Use only if 'MAF Mode - 2048 kg/hr (new)' is set to 2048.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Trim per Cylinder (new)
table.description: Multiplicative factor of the effective injection time of each cylinder (Ext_Trim_InjCyl, 0xDC28-0xDC2D), in firing order 1-5-3-6-2-4: factor = 0.5 + x/256, 0x80 = 100 %. Stock value: 0x80 everywhere; some modified files have 0x64 on all six cylinders (-11 % effective time). Block 0x0050-0x0063 (CRC region no. 4, sum at 0x0064-0x0065), copied with its sum at every start into external RAM 0xDC20-0xDC35 (CopyBlock_ToFixedAddr_DC20); the area 0xDC20-0xDC36 can also be written over the K-line. Changing a value requires recomputing the region sum (checksum correction function of MS41 ECU Tool), otherwise code 100.

table.name: Knock Control - Retard Offset per Cylinder (new)
table.description: Signed offset added to the knock advance reduction of each cylinder (Ext_Trim_KnockCyl, 0xDC2E-0xDC33), firing order 1-5-3-6-2-4. Stock: 0. Block 0x0050-0x0063 (CRC region no. 4, sum at 0x0064-0x0065), copied with its sum at every start into external RAM 0xDC20-0xDC35 (CopyBlock_ToFixedAddr_DC20); the area 0xDC20-0xDC36 can also be written over the K-line. Changing a value requires recomputing the region sum (checksum correction function of MS41 ECU Tool), otherwise code 100.

table.name: Injector - Dead Time Offset (new)
table.description: Signed adjustment of the injector dead time (Ext_Trim_InjDeadTime, 0xDC23). Stock: 0. Block 0x0050-0x0063 (CRC region no. 4, sum at 0x0064-0x0065), copied with its sum at every start into external RAM 0xDC20-0xDC35 (CopyBlock_ToFixedAddr_DC20); the area 0xDC20-0xDC36 can also be written over the K-line. Changing a value requires recomputing the region sum (checksum correction function of MS41 ECU Tool), otherwise code 100.

table.name: IACV - Duty Offset (new)
table.description: Signed adjustment of the idle valve command (Ext_Trim_IACV, 0xDC24). Stock: 0. Block 0x0050-0x0063 (CRC region no. 4, sum at 0x0064-0x0065), copied with its sum at every start into external RAM 0xDC20-0xDC35 (CopyBlock_ToFixedAddr_DC20); the area 0xDC20-0xDC36 can also be written over the K-line. Changing a value requires recomputing the region sum (checksum correction function of MS41 ECU Tool), otherwise code 100.

table.name: Canister Purge - Adaptation Step Factor after Leak Test (new)
Adaptation Step Factor after Leak Test
table.data: Adaptation Step Factor after Leak Test

table.description: Factor applied to the purge adaptation step ('Canister Purge - Purge Level Step Up (vs Air Flow) (new)') after the EVAP leak test, if the purge adaptation had already learnt (word_FD3A.1); 255 = full step, the value is set back to 255 when soft timer B8 expires. Read by EVAP_LeakDiag_EnableConditions.

table.name: O2 Sensor Heater - Adaptation Factor Return Step (new)
table.description: O2 sensor heating: step by which the heater adaptation factor returns towards 1.0 at each heater update when the adaptation is not running. Read by O2Heater_AdaptFactor_Relax.

table.name: Byte 4
table.description: Raw value of coding byte 4 (stock 0x26 = 38). See 'Byte 4 - A/C and VANOS (new)'.

table.name: Byte 5
table.description: Raw value of coding byte 5 (stock 0xEC = 236). See 'Byte 5 - Transmission (new)'.

table.name: Byte 6 - O2 Feedback
table.description: Lambda configuration (bits 2-4 of coding byte 6). Lambda control is always active, there are no '(No Lambda)' maps and no auto-detection. 0x0C (stock): O2Sensor_Count = 1; 0x14 or any other value: O2Sensor_Count = 2. Bit 5 set: CAN monitoring forced on (see 'Byte 6 - CAN Monitoring / EWS Input (new)').

table.name: Byte 7
table.description: Raw value of coding byte 7 (stock 0x09 = 9). See 'Byte 7 - ABS/ASC / Purge / CRC (new)'.

table.name: Byte 8
table.description: Raw value of coding byte 8 (stock 0x1E = 30). See 'Byte 8 - OBD / EWS (new)'.

table.name: CH - Duration - Idle Speed Target Increase
table.description: Catalyst heating (CH): function active after a cold start. Time after start, as a function of coolant temperature at start, during which the target idle speed is raised (LoadSnapshot_And_SecondaryTargets).

table.name: CH - Idle Speed Target Offset (new)
table.description: Fixed addition to the target idle speed during catalyst heating. Stock value: 20 rpm.

table.name: CH - Duration - Ignition Retard
table.description: Catalyst heating (CH): function active after a cold start. Time after start of the heating ignition retard. Setting it to zero also removes the heating enrichment (LoadSnapshot_And_SecondaryTargets).

table.name: CH - Duration - Fuel Enrichment
table.description: Catalyst heating (CH): function active after a cold start. Time after start of the heating enrichment (LoadSnapshot_And_SecondaryTargets).

table.name: CH - Fuel Enrichment - Multiplicative (Idle)
table.description: Catalyst heating (CH): function active after a cold start. Factor (1.0 = 128) applied to 'CH - Fuel Enrichment - Nominal' at idle; the result, plus 'CH - Fuel Enrichment - Additive', gives the heating enrichment factor.

table.name: CH - Fuel Enrichment - Multiplicative (above Idle)
table.description: Catalyst heating (CH): function active after a cold start. Factor (1.0 = 128) applied to 'CH - Fuel Enrichment - Nominal' above idle; the result, plus 'CH - Fuel Enrichment - Additive', gives the heating enrichment factor.

table.name: CH - Fuel Enrichment - Nominal
table.description: Catalyst heating (CH): function active after a cold start. Base injection time correction factor (engine speed x load, RPM_Load_ScaledCorrection_Calc), multiplied by one of the 'Multiplicative' tables then increased by 'Additive'.

table.name: CH - Fuel Enrichment - Additive
table.description: Catalyst heating (CH): function active after a cold start. Catalyst heating base factor (0.5 to 1.5) combined with the multiplied nominal enrichment, as a function of coolant temperature and time after start.

table.name: COP - Fuel Enrichment - Nominal
table.description: Catalyst overheating protection (COP): high-load enrichment when ignition advance is reduced. Base correction factor (engine speed x load), added to 'COP - Fuel Enrichment - Additive'. The result cannot be negative: all zeros removes the protection (only without a catalyst).

table.name: COP - Fuel Enrichment - Additive
table.description: Catalyst overheating protection (COP): high-load enrichment when ignition advance is reduced. Signed factor (128 = 0) added to the nominal enrichment, as a function of the ignition correction. Cannot make the total negative.

table.name: COP - Fuel Enrichment - Step Size
table.description: Catalyst overheating protection (COP): high-load enrichment when ignition advance is reduced. Maximum change of the COP enrichment per calculation, up or down, to avoid mixture steps.

table.name: COP - Minimum Load
table.description: Catalyst overheating protection (COP): high-load enrichment when ignition advance is reduced. Minimum load (as a function of engine speed and ignition correction) to activate the protection. At maximum: protection disabled.

table.name: COP - Minimum Load Hystersis
table.description: Catalyst overheating protection (COP): high-load enrichment when ignition advance is reduced. Hysteresis of the minimum load threshold.

table.name: COP - Minimum Ignition Correction
table.description: Catalyst overheating protection (COP): high-load enrichment when ignition advance is reduced. The protection is only active when the ignition correction (knock and ECT/IAT compensations) is below this value.

table.name: Lambda Integrator - Minimum Limit
table.description: Lower limit of the per-bank lambda controller factor (Lambda_PerBank_ComputeBounds / Lambda_PerBank_SwitchTracker); also used as the limit of the tester CO adjustment (K-line 0x41 sub-command 1, vehicle without lambda) and for the reset of both banks (Lambda_DualInstance_Reset).

table.name: Lambda Integrator - Maximum Limit
table.description: Upper limit of the per-bank lambda controller factor (Lambda_PerBank_ComputeBounds / Lambda_PerBank_SwitchTracker); also used as the limit of the tester CO adjustment (K-line 0x41/1) and for the reset (Lambda_DualInstance_Reset).

table.name: Adaptation Multiplicative - Minimum Limit
table.description: Lower limit of the multiplicative adaptation of each bank (Lambda_ScaledAdjust_Bounded) and of the value read back from EEPROM (Lambda_RestoreOnBoot).

table.name: Adaptation Multiplicative - Maximum Limit
table.description: Upper limit of the multiplicative adaptation of each bank (Lambda_ScaledAdjust_Bounded) and of the value read back from EEPROM (Lambda_RestoreOnBoot).

table.name: Adaptation Additive - Minimum Limit
table.description: Lower limit of the additive adaptation of each bank (Lambda_PerBank_RateCalc_Clamped, Lambda_ScaledAdjust_RPM) and of the value read back from EEPROM (Lambda_RestoreOnBoot).

table.name: Adaptation Additive - Maximum Limit
table.description: Upper limit of the additive adaptation of each bank (Lambda_PerBank_RateCalc_Clamped, Lambda_ScaledAdjust_RPM). Also applied to the value read back from EEPROM at start-up (Lambda_RestoreOnBoot).

table.name: Adaptation Multiplicative - Warm-up Compensation
table.description: Weighting factor (as a function of the multiplicative adaptation and of temperature) applied to the learned multiplicative adaptation to reduce its effect while coolant temperature is below 'Adaptive Fuel Learning - Minimum ECT' (Lambda_CombineControllerAndAdaptation, computed by ECT_Dependent_Params_Update).

table.name: Adaptation Additive - Warm-up Compensation
table.description: Weighting factor applied to the learned additive adaptation to reduce its effect while coolant temperature is below 'Adaptive Fuel Learning - Minimum ECT' (Lambda_CombineControllerAndAdaptation).

table.name: Adaptive Fuel Learning - Minimum ECT
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature for learning the lambda adaptations; below it, the learned adaptations are weighted by the 'Warm-up Compensation' tables (Lambda_CombineControllerAndAdaptation).

table.name: Adaptive Fuel Learning - Maximum IAT
table.description: Maximum intake air temperature for learning the lambda adaptations (Lambda_Adaptation_Update). Above it, neither additive nor multiplicative adaptation is learned.

table.name: Adaptive Fuel Learning - Maximum MAF
table.description: Maximum air flow for learning the lambda adaptations (Lambda_Adaptation_Update).

table.name: Additive Fuel Learning - Maximum Load
table.description: Maximum load of the additive adaptation learning zone (low load / idle), Lambda_Adaptation_Update.

table.name: Multiplicative Fuel Learning - Minimum RPM
table.description: Minimum engine speed for learning the multiplicative adaptation (part load), Lambda_Adaptation_Update.

table.name: Multiplicative Fuel Learning - Minimum Load
table.description: Minimum load of the multiplicative adaptation learning zone (part load), Lambda_Adaptation_Update.

table.name: Closed Loop - Minimum RPM
table.description: Minimum engine speed for closed-loop lambda control (Lambda_PerBank_SwitchTracker). Name in the BMW software: C_LAM_N_MIN.

table.name: Closed Loop - Minimum Coolant Temperature - Idle
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature for closed-loop lambda control at idle (read without interpolation).

table.name: Closed Loop - Minimum Coolant Temperature - Above Idle
table.description: Minimum coolant temperature for closed-loop lambda control above idle (read without interpolation).

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS
table.description: Throttle tip-in enrichment (TPS_AccelEnrichment_Initiate / _DecayCalc). Factor (1.0 = 128) as a function of coolant temperature and throttle gradient. On the first trigger the value is multiplied by 'Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Initial'; on following triggers of the same session, by the stored value. The result, shifted into the enrichment sum (1.0 = 4096), is added like the full-load enrichment.

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Initial
table.description: Factor (x/256) applied to the initial enrichment computed by 'Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS', as a function of load, read without interpolation (Table_LookupValue_NoInterp) by TPS_AccelEnrichment_Initiate.

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Deactivation Duration
table.description: Throttle tip-in enrichment (TPS_AccelEnrichment_Initiate / _DecayCalc). On the first trigger the value is multiplied by 'Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Initial'; on following triggers of the same session, by the stored value. Duration of the progressive decay of the enrichment. Larger = smoother decay (useful with narrower-spray injectors, less wall wetting). Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment (engine task run at each ignition).

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Session Duration
table.description: Throttle tip-in enrichment (TPS_AccelEnrichment_Initiate / _DecayCalc). On the first trigger the value is multiplied by 'Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Initial'; on following triggers of the same session, by the stored value. Set on the first trigger then decremented by 1 per cycle; while it is not 0, a new trigger is handled as 'following', afterwards as 'first'. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment (engine task run at each ignition).

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Timer Initial Value
table.description: Throttle tip-in enrichment (TPS_AccelEnrichment_Initiate / _DecayCalc). On the first trigger the value is multiplied by 'Fuel Enrichment - Increasing TPS - Initial'; on following triggers of the same session, by the stored value. Start value of the counter armed at each trigger, decremented at each cycle. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment (engine task run at each ignition).

table.name: Detection - Increasing TPS
table.description: Throttle opening gradient threshold (as a function of engine speed and throttle angle): if the throttle opens faster than this threshold + 'Detection - Increasing TPS (ECT Compensation)', the acceleration enrichments are applied (Threshold_Crossing_Debounced_E8D0).

table.name: Detection - Increasing TPS (ECT Compensation)
table.description: Signed term added, depending on coolant temperature, to the 'Detection - Increasing TPS' threshold.

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Initial
table.description: Load increase enrichment (PerInstance_RPM_Load_Init / _Calc_C). Initial enrichment on the first trigger. If the MAF curve represents the real load well, these tables normally do not need changes on a naturally aspirated engine with the stock manifold. Name in the BMW software: IP_TI_FAC_AE(_AT)__N_32__MAF.

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Nominal
table.description: Load increase enrichment (PerInstance_RPM_Load_Init / _Calc_C). Factor applied to the initial enrichment (and, on re-trigger, to one of the 'Reduction Gradient' tables), as a function of the ratio load at trigger / current load. Name in the BMW software: IP_TI_FAC_TRA_AE(_AT)__MAF_RATIO_AE__TCO.

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Initial Session Denominator
table.description: Load increase enrichment (PerInstance_RPM_Load_Init / _Calc_C). Session denominator, set on the first trigger; a counter starts at 0 and advances at each cycle. While 1 - counter/denominator stays below the re-trigger duration, a new first trigger is possible if load increases. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment (engine task run at each ignition). Name in the BMW software: IP_TI_CYCNR_AE(_AT)__N_32__TCO.

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Reduction Gradient (Low ECT)
table.description: Load increase enrichment (PerInstance_RPM_Load_Init / _Calc_C). Reduction slope used when coolant temperature is below the threshold 'Fuel - Correction Table ECT Threshold (new)' (0x365). Axis: remaining fraction of the session (255 - elapsed time x 256 / total time), x/256. Name in the BMW software: IP_TI_FAC_1_AE_RST(_AT)__CYC.

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Increasing Load - Reduction Gradient (Normal ECT)
table.description: Load increase enrichment (PerInstance_RPM_Load_Init / _Calc_C). Reduction slope used when coolant temperature is at or above the threshold 'Fuel - Correction Table ECT Threshold (new)' (0x365). Axis: remaining fraction of the session (255 - elapsed time x 256 / total time), x/256. Name in the BMW software: IP_TI_FAC_2_AE_RST(_AT)__CYC.

table.name: Fuel Restore - RPM
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Engine speed (as a function of coolant temperature) below which injection is always active. Raising it removes the closed-throttle overrun fuel cut.

table.name: Fuel Restore - RPM (AC on)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Engine speed (as a function of coolant temperature) below which injection is always active, A/C compressor engaged.

table.name: Fuel Cut - RPM Hysteresis (Maximum)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Above 'Fuel Restore - RPM' + this hysteresis, injection is cut with the throttle closed (immediately if a fast closing is detected, otherwise after a progressive ignition retard). Hysteresis used just after a fuel cut.

table.name: Fuel Cut - RPM Hysteresis (Minimum)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Hysteresis used once the 'Fuel Cut - Hysteresis Delay Counter' has elapsed.

table.name: Fuel Cut - Hysteresis Delay Counter
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Number of segments outside fuel cut after which the hysteresis changes from the maximum to the minimum value. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment (engine task run at each ignition). Counted only outside fuel cut.

table.name: Fuel Cut - RPM Hysteresis (below ECT Threshold)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Cut-off hysteresis used instead of 'Fuel Cut - RPM Hysteresis (Maximum)' when coolant temperature at start was below 'Fuel Cut - Hysteresis - ECT Threshold'.

table.name: Fuel Cut - Hysteresis Delay Counter (below ECT Threshold)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Counter used instead of 'Fuel Cut - Hysteresis Delay Counter' when coolant temperature at start was below 'Fuel Cut - Hysteresis - ECT Threshold'. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment (engine task run at each ignition). Counted only outside fuel cut.

table.name: Fuel Cut - Hysteresis - ECT Threshold
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Coolant temperature at start below which the '(below ECT Threshold)' tables are used.

table.name: Fuel Enleanment - Decreasing TPS
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Enleanment factor on throttle closing (engine speed x air flow), multiplied by 'Fuel Enleanment - Decreasing TPS - Multiplicative'. On following triggers of the session, the value of the first trigger is reused.

table.name: Fuel Enleanment - Decreasing TPS - Multiplicative
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Factor of the closing enleanment, as a function of the ratio current load / load at trigger and of coolant temperature (Deceleration_Enleanment_SessionTimer).

table.name: Fuel Enleanment - Decreasing TPS - Session Duration
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Duration of an enleanment session, in ignitions (the counter advances by 1 at each ignition, every 120 crank degrees), as a function of engine speed and coolant temperature. Duration in seconds = value x 20 / engine speed (e.g. 250 at 3000 rpm = 1.7 s). Main table of the rev-hang effect after lifting off. Unit: 1 = one 120 deg crank segment (engine task run at each ignition).

table.name: Fuel Enleanment - Decreasing TPS - Deactivation Factor
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Decay factor of the enleanment during the session, as a function of the session counter; the first value (counter 0) must stay 0. Axis: remaining fraction of the session (255 - elapsed time x 256 / total time), x/256.

table.name: Ignition Retard - Decreasing TPS
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Ignition retard applied progressively when the throttle closes, or with closed throttle below 'Fuel Restore - RPM' + hysteresis (IgnTiming_Accumulate_Corrections).

table.name: Ignition Retard - Decreasing TPS (Closed)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Retard applied progressively with closed throttle above 'Fuel Restore - RPM' + hysteresis; once reached, injection can be cut.

table.name: Ignition Retard - Decreasing TPS (Closed) (AC on)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Retard applied progressively with closed throttle above 'Fuel Restore - RPM' + hysteresis, A/C compressor engaged; once reached, injection can be cut.

table.name: Ignition Retard - Decreasing TPS - Step Size (ECT Compensation)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Term (coolant temperature) added to the step 'Ignition Retard - Decreasing TPS - Step Size'.

table.name: Ignition Retard - Decreasing TPS - Step Size
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Ignition rate-limit step on slow throttle closing (engine speed x load), added to the ECT compensation term (RPM_Load_Correction_WithDecay).

table.name: Ignition Retard - Fast Decreasing TPS (Closed)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Retard applied immediately (without ramp) on fast throttle closing above 'Fuel Restore - RPM' + hysteresis; only if the fast closing is detected.

table.name: Detection - Decreasing TPS
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Throttle closing gradient threshold (as a function of engine speed and throttle angle), as a positive magnitude; beyond this threshold + ECT compensation, the deceleration tables are applied (Threshold_Crossing_Debounced_E8D0).

table.name: Detection - Decreasing TPS (ECT Compensation)
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Signed term added, depending on coolant temperature, to the 'Detection - Decreasing TPS' threshold.

table.name: Detection - Fast Decreasing TPS - Min. Throttle Gradient
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Throttle closing gradient (positive magnitude) beyond which the fast closing can be detected (all 'Fast Decreasing TPS' conditions must be met).

table.name: Detection - Fast Decreasing TPS - Min. RPM
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Fast closing condition: engine speed above this value, or engine speed gradient above 'Min. RPM Gradient'.

table.name: Detection - Fast Decreasing TPS - Min. RPM Gradient
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Fast closing condition: engine speed gradient above this value, or engine speed above 'Min. RPM'.

table.name: Detection - Fast Decreasing TPS - Min. Load
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Minimum load (as a function of engine speed) for fast closing detection.

table.name: Detection - Fast Decreasing TPS - Min. Load Difference
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Minimum load drop for fast closing detection.

table.name: Detection - Fast Decreasing TPS - Min. ECT
table.description: Deceleration enleanment / fuel cut. Minimum coolant temperature for fast throttle closing detection.

table.name: AlphaN - TPS
table.description: Alpha-N load (throttle angle x engine speed), read by AlphaN_FuelCalc_TPS_IACV / RPM_Load_ModeSelect_Calc_A. Alpha-N load = [AlphaN - IACV x AlphaN - IACV (TPS Compensation) + AlphaN - TPS] / AlphaN - IAT Compensation; with a throttle fault (code 12) 'AlphaN - TPS (DTC 12)' replaces this table. Used as substitute load when the air flow meter cannot be used.

table.name: AlphaN - IAT Compensation
table.description: Intake air temperature dependent factor (AlphaN_IAT_Factor, 1.0 = 128) computed by ECT_Dependent_Params_Update and used by the alpha-N load calculation (throttle + idle valve). The alpha-N load is divided by this factor: 1.0 = neutral, larger = load reduced (warmer, less dense air).

table.name: AlphaN - TPS (DTC 12)
table.description: Alpha-N load as a function of throttle angle and engine speed, read by RPM_Load_ModeSelect_Calc_A; used as substitute load when the air flow meter cannot be used.

table.name: AlphaN - IACV
table.description: Contribution of the idle valve (bypass air) to the alpha-N load (AlphaN_FuelCalc_TPS_IACV / RPM_Load_ModeSelect_Calc_A).

table.name: AlphaN - IACV (TPS Compensation)
table.description: Weighting, as a function of throttle angle, of the idle valve contribution to the alpha-N load (AlphaN_FuelCalc_TPS_IACV).

table.name: Fuel Injection - Base
table.description: Base injection time (engine speed x load) for a stoichiometric mixture, read by BaseMaps_PerEngineState_Calc (0x0B44) outside cranking. Starting point with other injectors: correct it by the flow ratio.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Open Loop Enrichment
table.description: Full-load (open loop) enrichment factor, read by BaseMaps_PerEngineState_Calc when word_FD12.10 is set (see 'Detection - Open Loop Enrichment'); result FullLoad_Enrichment (value x 16, 1.0 = 4096 in the enrichment sum).

table.name: Detection - Open Loop Enrichment
table.description: Throttle angle (as a function of engine speed) above which the full-load enrichment is activated (word_FD12.10, Threshold_Crossing_Debounced_E8D0).

table.name: Fuel Injection - Base - VANOS Correction
table.description: Injection time deviation with VANOS active (engine speed x load, words centred on 0x8000 = 0 ms), multiplied by the VANOS state (VANOS_CamAdvance_Ratio) and added to the base injection time (BaseMaps_PerEngineState_Calc).

table.name: Fuel Injection - Warmup Enrichment
table.description: Cold engine enrichment factor (engine speed x load), multiplied by 'Fuel Injection - Warmup Enrichment (ECT Compensation)' (RPM_Load_ScaledCorrection_Calc_Alt).

table.name: Fuel Injection - Warmup Enrichment (ECT Compensation)
table.description: Coolant temperature dependent factor (1.0 = 128) applied to 'Fuel Injection - Warmup Enrichment'.

table.name: Fuel Injector - Dead Time / Latency
table.description: Injector dead time as a function of battery voltage, added to each pulse (Fuel_InjectionTime_Calc, Injector_PulseWidth_Base). Adapt it to the injectors used.

table.name: Fuel Injection - Cranking - Initial
table.description: First injection during cranking (word, as a function of coolant temperature), multiplied by 'Fuel Injection - Cranking - Hot Start Factor (vs ECT) (new)' on a hot restart then by the final gain; the dead time is added (Fuel_Cranking_InitialPulse_Calc).

table.name: Fuel Injection - Cranking
table.description: Base quantity during cranking (engine state 1), as a function of engine speed and coolant temperature (word grid); result Crank_FuelBase, then multiplied by 'Fuel Injection - Cranking - Decay (vs ECT/Cranking Cycles) (new)' and the hot restart factor in Fuel_InjectionTime_Calc. Read by the per-engine-state base calculation routine (0x3E426).

table.name: Fuel Economy Gauge - Scaling Factor
table.description: Factor (1.0 = 128; used x256 by MulU16_HighWord) applied to the sum of fuel flows (FuelConsumption_Rate) before division by 3 for the fuel consumption gauge. See also 'Scaling Factor 2'.

table.name: Fuel Economy Gauge - Scaling Factor 2
table.description: Factor (16-bit word, 1.0 = 8192) applied by MulU16_HighWord to the accumulated fuel flow (FuelConsumption_Accumulator_ED42) before it is sent to the fuel consumption gauge. Read as a word at 0x72 (0x73 is only its high byte).

table.name: Ignition Timing - Base
table.description: Base ignition advance map (engine speed x load) at part load / full load (engine states other than cranking and idle). The weighted VANOS correction (map 0x1314, RPM_Load_ModeSelectB_E97C, 128 = 0) is added; result IgnTiming_BaseValue (routine 0x3E426).

table.name: Ignition Timing - Base 2
table.description: Map in the calibration with the layout of 'Ignition Timing - Base' (same axes); it is not read by the program of this ECU, so editing it has no effect.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Base - VANOS Correction
table.description: Ignition correction (engine speed x load, 128 = 0) multiplied by the VANOS state and added to the base advance (BaseMaps_PerEngineState_Calc, RPM_Load_ModeSelectB_E97C).

table.name: Ignition Timing - Base - ECT/IAT Compensation - Multiplicative
table.description: Weighting factor (intake air temperature x coolant temperature) multiplied by 'Ignition Timing - Base - ECT/IAT Compensation - Nominal' to obtain the temperature ignition correction (IgnTiming_Accumulate_Corrections).

table.name: Ignition Timing - Base - ECT/IAT Compensation - Nominal
table.description: Ignition correction (engine speed x load, 128 = 0) multiplied by the 'ECT/IAT Compensation - Multiplicative' factor; the weighted result (minus 128) is added to the ignition correction sum.

table.name: Ignition Timing - Cranking
table.description: Ignition advance during cranking (engine state 1), as a function of engine speed (BaseMaps_PerEngineState_Calc).

table.name: Ignition Timing - Idle - Base
table.description: Idle ignition advance (engine state 2), engine speed x load (BaseMaps_PerEngineState_Calc).

table.name: Ignition Timing - Idle - ECT Compensation
table.description: Advance added at idle when coolant temperature is low (IgnTiming_Accumulate_Corrections).

table.name: X Axis - Load
table.description: Load axis shared by the main fuel and ignition maps. After changing it, reload the file immediately.

table.name: Y Axis - Engine Speed
table.description: Engine speed axis shared by the main fuel and ignition maps. After changing it, reload the file immediately.

table.name: DTC 212 - Minimum RPM
table.description: Below this engine speed, check 212 (VANOS / minimum speed, DTC212_Check) is not evaluated.

table.name: CH - On/Off - VANOS
table.description: Catalyst heating (CH): function active after a cold start. 1: VANOS is engaged during the cold start to increase air flow and help heating; 0: disabled (can smooth a rough cold start).

table.name: Detection - Light/Heavy Throttle
table.description: Throttle angle (as a function of engine speed): below it, VANOS follows the 'Light Throttle' tables, above it the 'Heavy Throttle' tables.

table.name: VANOS - Min. Load (Light Throttle) (AT)
table.description: Light throttle: load above which VANOS is engaged (automatic transmission).

table.name: VANOS - Min. Load (Light Throttle) (MT)
table.description: Light throttle: load (as a function of engine speed and coolant temperature) above which VANOS is engaged (manual transmission).

table.name: VANOS - On/Off (Heavy Throttle) (MS41.1/MS41.0)
table.description: Heavy throttle: 1 = VANOS active at this engine speed, 0 = inactive. Use this table only to change the engine speed axis.

table.name: Nominal Idle Speed
table.description: Target idle speed as a function of coolant temperature, manual gearbox or automatic in neutral (computed in ECT_Dependent_Params_Update).

table.name: Nominal Idle Speed (A/C on)
table.description: Target idle speed as a function of coolant temperature, manual gearbox or automatic in neutral, A/C engaged.

table.name: Nominal Idle Speed (A/T in Drive)
