Tank pressure scale deduced from the sensor linearisation table 'EVAP P0451 Tank Pressure vs F5A8': 0.5 Pa per unit, 5000 = ambient (sensor range +/-3.75 kPa over 0.5-4.5 V).

table.name: EVAP Shutoff Valve (P0446) - Pressure High Limit (new)
table.description: Upper limit of the tank pressure for the stuck-shut check. Read by EVAP_ShutoffValveStuckShut_P0446. IDA name: CAL_0086_EVAP_Shutoff_Valve_P0446_Pressure_High_Limit. Tank pressure scale deduced from the sensor linearisation table 'EVAP P0451 Tank Pressure vs F5A8': 0.5 Pa per unit, 5000 = ambient (sensor range +/-3.75 kPa over 0.5-4.5 V).

table.name: EVAP Shutoff Valve (P0446) - Pressure Low Limit (new)
table.description: Lower limit of the tank pressure for the stuck-shut check. Read by EVAP_ShutoffValveStuckShut_P0446. IDA name: CAL_0088_EVAP_Shutoff_Valve_P0446_Pressure_Low_Limit. Tank pressure scale deduced from the sensor linearisation table 'EVAP P0451 Tank Pressure vs F5A8': 0.5 Pa per unit, 5000 = ambient (sensor range +/-3.75 kPa over 0.5-4.5 V).

table.name: EVAP Leak Test - Small Leak Limit P0442 (Mode 06) (new)
table.description: Tank pressure gradient limit for the small leak (P0442); Mode 06 limit. Read by EVAP_Test_Step_SmallLeak_P0442, OBD2_Mode06_FuelSystem_Results. IDA name: CAL_008A_EVAP_Leak_Test_Small_Leak_Limit_P0442_Mode_06. Tank pressure scale deduced from the sensor linearisation table 'EVAP P0451 Tank Pressure vs F5A8': 0.5 Pa per unit, 5000 = ambient (sensor range +/-3.75 kPa over 0.5-4.5 V).

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Stability Window High (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Upper hysteresis value of the per-bank stability counter (FD10.1 cleared above). Read by O2Cat_Monitor_PerBank_Main. IDA name: CAL_008C_Catalyst_Monitor_Stability_Window_High.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Stability Window Low (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Lower hysteresis value of the per-bank stability counter (FD10.1 set below). Read by O2Cat_Monitor_PerBank_Main. IDA name: CAL_008E_Catalyst_Monitor_Stability_Window_Low.

table.name: Misfire - Inhibit Time after TPS Transient (new)
table.description: Misfire detection suspended for this time when the throttle gradient exceeds TPS Gradient Threshold vs TPS (10 ms timer). Read by Threshold_Crossing_Debounced_E8D0. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_0090_Misfire_Inhibit_Time_after_TPS_Transient.

table.name: Misfire - Segment Time Adaptation Max Deviation (new)
table.description: Maximum |segment time - adapted segment time| (crank timer units) accepted to update the crank segment adaptation (wheel tolerance learning). Read by Misfire_SegmentTime_Evaluate. IDA name: CAL_0094_Misfire_Segment_Time_Adaptation_Max_Deviation.

table.name: MAF/TPS Plausibility - Max Ratio (new)
table.description: Ratio measured air mass / throttle-model air mass above which the sample is implausible. Read by MAF_TPS_Plausibility_OBD. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_0096_MAF_TPS_Plausibility_Max_Ratio.

table.name: MAF/TPS Plausibility - Min Ratio (new)
table.description: Ratio below which the sample is implausible. Read by MAF_TPS_Plausibility_OBD. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_0098_MAF_TPS_Plausibility_Min_Ratio.

table.name: Misfire - Roughness Gain (new)
table.description: Gain applied to the positive roughness value (segment time difference) before filtering. Read by Misfire_SegmentTime_Evaluate. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_009A_Misfire_Roughness_Gain.

table.name: Misfire - Roughness Gain (Cylinder Masked) (new)
table.description: Gain applied to the roughness value when one or more cylinders are excluded from detection (Misfire_InhibitCylMask). Read by Misfire_SegmentTime_Evaluate. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_009C_Misfire_Roughness_Gain_Cylinder_Masked.

table.name: Fuel System Monitor - Max Adaptation Value (new)
table.description: Adaptation value must stay below this value (and the neutral value below the next one) to set FD10.2. Read by FuelSystem_Monitor_PerBank. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_00A0_Fuel_System_Monitor_Max_Adaptation_Value.

table.name: Secondary Air - Bank 2 Monitor Enable (new)
table.description: 0 = secondary air monitored on bank 1 only; other value = per bank when 2 O2 sensors are coded. Read by SecondaryAir_Start_Init. IDA name: CAL_00A4_Secondary_Air_Bank_2_Monitor_Enable.

table.name: Fuel System Monitor - Lean Limit (new)
table.description: Mixture correction (lambda controller + adaptation) above which the bank is counted as lean. Read by FuelSystem_Monitor_PerBank. Unit: %. IDA name: CAL_00A6_Fuel_System_Monitor_Lean_Limit.

table.name: Fuel System Monitor - Rich Limit (new)
table.description: Mixture correction below which the bank is counted as rich. Read by FuelSystem_Monitor_PerBank. Unit: %. IDA name: CAL_00A8_Fuel_System_Monitor_Rich_Limit.

table.name: Misfire - Segment Adaptation Initial Value (new)
table.description: Initial / reset value of the crank segment adaptation (x24 internally). Also the clamp of the adapted value (x64). Loaded at boot, after K-line clear adaptations and at cycle end. Read by KLine_Cmd43_ClearAdaptations, Misfire_Monitor_CycleEnd_Reset, Misfire_SegAdapt_RestoreOnBoot, Misfire_SegmentTime_Evaluate. IDA name: CAL_00AC_Misfire_Segment_Adaptation_Initial_Value.

table.name: Purge Adaptation - Neutral Value Limit (new)
table.description: Limit of the neutral adaptation value selecting the learning rate. Read by AdaptiveCorrection_Learn. Unit: % (offset binary, 32768 = 0 %). IDA name: CAL_00C0_Purge_Adaptation_Neutral_Value_Limit.

table.name: Purge Adaptation - Max Deviation (Mode 06) (new)
table.description: Maximum |neutral adaptation value|; Mode 06 limit. Read by AdaptiveCorrection_Learn, OBD2_Mode06_FuelSystem_Results. Unit: %. IDA name: CAL_00C2_Purge_Adaptation_Max_Deviation_Mode_06.

table.name: Fuel System Monitor - Max Neutral Value (new)
table.description: Limit of the neutral adaptation value for the fuel system check. Read by FuelSystem_Monitor_PerBank. Unit: % (offset binary, 32768 = 0 %). IDA name: CAL_00C6_Fuel_System_Monitor_Max_Neutral_Value.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Max Lambda Integrator Deviation (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Maximum deviation of the lambda controller value from its filtered value for stable conditions. Read by O2Cat_Monitor_PerBank_Main. IDA name: CAL_00C8_Catalyst_Monitor_Max_Lambda_Integrator_Deviation. Maximum difference between the lambda correction (Lambda_B1_Correction_Mean / Lambda_B2_Correction_Mean) and its filtered value, same scale as 'Lambda Integrator - Minimum/Maximum Limit'.

table.name: Secondary Air Monitor - Max Lambda Controller Value (new)
table.description: Lambda controller value must stay below this value during air injection (lean shift expected). Read by SecondaryAir_Monitor_PerBank. Unit: % (offset binary, 32768 = 0 %). IDA name: CAL_00CC_Secondary_Air_Monitor_Max_Lambda_Controller_Value.

table.name: Secondary Air Monitor - Max Lambda Shift (new)
table.description: Maximum difference between the reference and the lambda controller value; above = fault detected. Read by SecondaryAir_Monitor_PerBank. Unit: %. IDA name: CAL_00CE_Secondary_Air_Monitor_Max_Lambda_Shift.

table.name: EVAP Leak Test - Pressure Build-up Limit (new)
table.description: Pressure rise above which the leak step is ended. Read by EVAP_LeakDiag_Step. IDA name: CAL_00DC_EVAP_Leak_Test_Pressure_Build_up_Limit. Compared with a difference of two purge adaptation cell values, not with the tank pressure.

table.name: Misfire - Inhibit Time after Load Transient (new)
table.description: Misfire detection suspended for this time when the load change exceeds Load Delta Threshold vs Load (10 ms timer). Read by RPM_Load_ModeSelect_Calc_A. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_00E6_Misfire_Inhibit_Time_after_Load_Transient.

table.name: Purge Test - Load Margin (new)
table.description: Test runs while the load stays above (snapshot - this value); Mode 06 limit. Read by EVAP_TankVentValveFunction_B, OBD2_Mode06_FuelSystem_Results. Unit: mg/stroke. IDA name: CAL_00E8_Purge_Test_Load_Margin.

table.name: Secondary Air Pump - Max Air Flow (new)
table.description: Pump is switched on only below this air flow. Read by SecondaryAir_Pump_Control. Unit: kg/h. IDA name: CAL_00EA_Secondary_Air_Pump_Max_Air_Flow.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Ratio Limit (Mode 06) (new)
table.description: Catalyst monitor result limit (rear/front O2 activity ratio). Fault when the result exceeds this value; also reported as Mode 06 limit. Read by Catalyst_Monitor_SwitchStateMachine, OBD2_Mode06_TestResult_A. IDA name: CAL_00F4_Catalyst_Monitor_Ratio_Limit_Mode_06.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - TPS Filter Constant (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Filter constant of the throttle position used for the steady-state check. Read by Lambda_ClosedLoop_Update. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_00F6_Catalyst_Monitor_TPS_Filter_Constant.

table.name: Exhaust Temp. Model - Offset with Secondary Air (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Exhaust / Catalyst Temperature Model (new)
table.description: Offset added to the model rate while secondary air is active (0 = none). Read by O2Cat_Monitor_LoadThreshold. IDA name: CAL_00F8_Exhaust_Temp_Model_Offset_with_Secondary_Air. Filter rate (fraction per pass, 65536 = 1) used while secondary air is active.

table.name: Exhaust Temp. Model - Offset with Purge (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Exhaust / Catalyst Temperature Model (new)
table.description: Offset added to the model rate while canister purge is active (0 = none). Read by O2Cat_Monitor_LoadThreshold. IDA name: CAL_00FA_Exhaust_Temp_Model_Offset_with_Purge. Filter rate (fraction per pass, 65536 = 1) used while purging.

table.name: Misfire - Roughness Filter Constant (new)
table.description: First-order filter constant of the roughness value (higher = faster). Read by Misfire_SegmentTime_Evaluate. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_00FC_Misfire_Roughness_Filter_Constant.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Lambda Filter Constant (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Filter constant of the lambda controller value used for the steady-state check. Read by Lambda_ClosedLoop_Update. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_00FE_Catalyst_Monitor_Lambda_Filter_Constant.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - RPM Filter Constant (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Filter constant of the engine speed used for the steady-state check. Read by Lambda_ClosedLoop_Update. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_0100_Catalyst_Monitor_RPM_Filter_Constant.

table.name: IACV - Duty Filter Constant (new)
table.description: Filter constant of the filtered IACV duty. Read by IACV_Duty_Sum_Output. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_0102_IACV_Duty_Filter_Constant.

table.name: Idle Control - IACV Deviation Filter Constant (new)
table.description: Filter constant used by the IACV deviation check. Read by IdleControl_IACV_FilterDeviation. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_0104_Idle_Control_IACV_Deviation_Filter_Constant.

table.name: Catalyst Temp. Model - Filter Constant (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Exhaust / Catalyst Temperature Model (new)
table.description: Filter constant of the catalyst temperature model towards Catalyst Temp. Model Target vs RPM/Load. Read by CatalystTemp_Model_Update. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_0106_Catalyst_Temp_Model_Filter_Constant.

table.name: EVAP Tank Vent Test - Max RPM Drop (new)
table.description: Test aborted when the engine speed drops more than this value. Read by EVAP_TankVentValveFunction_A. Unit: rpm. IDA name: CAL_010A_EVAP_Tank_Vent_Test_Max_RPM_Drop.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Max RPM Deviation (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Maximum |engine speed - filtered engine speed| for steady state. Read by Lambda_ClosedLoop_Update. Unit: rpm. IDA name: CAL_0114_Catalyst_Monitor_Max_RPM_Deviation.

table.name: EVAP Tank Vent Test - Min RPM Rise (new)
table.description: Engine speed rise above which a test count is recorded. Read by EVAP_TankVentValveFunction_A. Unit: rpm. IDA name: CAL_0116_EVAP_Tank_Vent_Test_Min_RPM_Rise.

table.name: Speed Band 1 (below 60 km/h) - Factor (new)
table.description: Filter constant loaded into word_FAD6 (used as the fraction of Interpolate_ByFraction16 in Misfire_RingBuffer_Variance_Check) when the vehicle speed is in band 1 (bands switch at 60 and 120 km/h). Read by RevLimiter_VSS_StateMachine, SystemReinit_FullEngineSubsystems. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_0120_Speed_Band_1_below_60_km_h_Factor.

table.name: Speed Band 2 (60-120 km/h) - Factor (new)
table.description: Filter constant loaded into word_FAD6 in speed band 2. Read by RevLimiter_VSS_StateMachine. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_0122_Speed_Band_2_60_120_km_h_Factor.

table.name: Speed Band 3 (above 120 km/h) - Factor (new)
table.description: Filter constant loaded into word_FAD6 in speed band 3. Read by RevLimiter_VSS_StateMachine. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_0124_Speed_Band_3_above_120_km_h_Factor.

table.name: Misfire - Window Sum Threshold (Cylinder Cut) (new)
table.description: Sum of the weighted counts of the 6 cylinders above which the worst cylinder is cut (catalyst protection). Read by Misfire_Monitor_CountAndCylCut. IDA name: CAL_0126_Misfire_Window_Sum_Threshold_Cylinder_Cut.

table.name: Misfire - Total Events Threshold (Cylinder Cut) (new)
table.description: Total misfire events above which the worst cylinder is searched for injection cut-off. Read by Misfire_Monitor_CountAndCylCut. IDA name: CAL_0128_Misfire_Total_Events_Threshold_Cylinder_Cut.

table.name: Exhaust Temp. Model - Target during Fuel Cut (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Exhaust / Catalyst Temperature Model (new)
table.description: Target of the exhaust temperature model while cylinders are cut or the rev limiter is active. Read by O2Cat_Monitor_LoadThreshold. IDA name: CAL_0152_Exhaust_Temp_Model_Target_during_Fuel_Cut.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Exhaust Temp. Window High (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Upper limit of the exhaust temperature model for the catalyst monitor period window (0 = disabled). Read by O2Cat_Monitor_PeriodWindow. IDA name: CAL_0154_Catalyst_Monitor_Exhaust_Temp_Window_High. Compared with the 16-bit model value word_DBD2 (high byte = model value of the other 'Exhaust Temp. Model' items).

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Exhaust Temp. Window Low (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Lower limit of the exhaust temperature model for the catalyst monitor period window. Read by O2Cat_Monitor_PeriodWindow. IDA name: CAL_0156_Catalyst_Monitor_Exhaust_Temp_Window_Low. Compared with the 16-bit model value word_DBD2 (high byte = model value of the other 'Exhaust Temp. Model' items).

table.name: Pre-Cat Efficiency - Limit Bank 1 (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Fault limit of the pre-catalyst efficiency result, bank 1 (0 = disabled). Read by PreCat_Efficiency_Monitor_248_249. IDA name: CAL_0158_Pre_Cat_Efficiency_Limit_Bank_1.

table.name: Pre-Cat Efficiency - Limit Bank 2 (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Fault limit of the pre-catalyst efficiency result, bank 2 (0 = disabled). Read by PreCat_Efficiency_Monitor_248_249. IDA name: CAL_015A_Pre_Cat_Efficiency_Limit_Bank_2.

table.name: Fuel Enrichment - Additive Factor (Secondary Air Inactive) (new)
table.description: Additive enrichment added to the fuel enrichment sum when the secondary air variant flag (GPIO_Variant_FlagByte bit 1) is not set; the sum + 1.0 (4096) is the fuel multiplication factor applied to the injection time (MulU16_Div4096). Read by Fuel_InjectionTime_Calc. Unit: factor (4096 = 1.0). IDA name: CAL_0166_Fuel_Enrichment_Additive_Factor_Secondary_Air_Inactive.

table.name: Misfire - Segment Adaptation Filter Constant (new)
table.description: Filter constant of the crank segment adaptation (wheel tolerance learning). Read by Misfire_Monitor_CycleEnd_Reset, Misfire_SegmentTime_Evaluate. Unit: factor. IDA name: CAL_0170_Misfire_Segment_Adaptation_Filter_Constant.

table.name: Misfire - Inhibit Time after Fuel Cut Exit (new)
Inhibit Time after Fuel Cut Exit
table.data: Inhibit Time after Fuel Cut Exit

table.description: Misfire detection suspended for this time at the end of a fuel cut / overrun phase (10 ms timer). Read by SoftTimerA_Cb10. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_0172_Misfire_Inhibit_Time_after_Fuel_Cut_Exit.

table.name: Speed Band 1 (below 60 km/h) - Count (new)
table.description: Value loaded into word_FADA when entering speed band 1. Read by RevLimiter_VSS_StateMachine, SystemReinit_FullEngineSubsystems. IDA name: CAL_0174_Speed_Band_1_below_60_km_h_Count.

table.name: Speed Band 2 (60-120 km/h) - Count (new)
table.description: Value loaded into word_FADA when entering speed band 2. Read by RevLimiter_VSS_StateMachine. IDA name: CAL_0176_Speed_Band_2_60_120_km_h_Count.

table.name: Speed Band 3 (above 120 km/h) - Count (new)
table.description: Value loaded into word_FADA when entering speed band 3. Read by RevLimiter_VSS_StateMachine. IDA name: CAL_0178_Speed_Band_3_above_120_km_h_Count.

table.name: Misfire - Inhibit Time after Engine Start (new)
table.description: Misfire detection suspended for this time after the engine reaches the running state (10 ms timer). Read by EngineState_Machine. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_017A_Misfire_Inhibit_Time_after_Engine_Start.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Max Period Counter (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Upper limit of the per-bank period counter (0 = no limit). Read by O2Cat_Monitor_PerBank_Main. IDA name: CAL_017E_Catalyst_Monitor_Max_Period_Counter.

table.name: Rear O2 Heater - Energy Counter Limit (new)
table.category: ID60 - Post-Cat Trim / Rear O2 Sensors (new)
table.description: Accumulated heater energy counter above which the heater test is evaluated. Read by O2Heater_PostCat_Control_Diag. IDA name: CAL_0180_Rear_O2_Heater_Energy_Counter_Limit.

table.name: Rear O2 Heater - Energy Counter Step (new)
table.category: ID60 - Post-Cat Trim / Rear O2 Sensors (new)
table.description: Increment of the heater energy counter (also its clamp in the enable conditions). Read by O2Cat_Monitor_EnableConditions, O2Heater_PostCat_Control_Diag. IDA name: CAL_0182_Rear_O2_Heater_Energy_Counter_Step.

table.name: Secondary Air Monitor - Min Duration (new)
table.description: Minimum valid monitoring time (20 ms task count). Read by SecondaryAir_Monitor_PerBank, SecondaryAir_Start_Init. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_0184_Secondary_Air_Monitor_Min_Duration.

table.name: Secondary Air - Sequence E Time (new)
table.description: Time of sequence step E (100 ms timer). Read by SoftTimerB_Cb16_SecondaryAir_SeqE. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_0186_Secondary_Air_Sequence_E_Time.

table.name: Secondary Air - Sequence B Time 2 (new)
table.description: Second time of sequence step B (100 ms timer). Read by SoftTimerB_Cb13_SecondaryAir_SeqB. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_018C_Secondary_Air_Sequence_B_Time_2.

table.name: Secondary Air - Sequence B Time 1 (new)
table.description: First time of sequence step B (100 ms timer). Read by SoftTimerB_Cb13_SecondaryAir_SeqB. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_018E_Secondary_Air_Sequence_B_Time_1.

table.name: Misfire Inhibit Input (P1.15) - Hold Time (new)
table.description: Time the misfire inhibit is held after the P1.15 input changes (1 s timer). Read by P1_15_Input_Debounce. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_0190_Misfire_Inhibit_Input_P1_15_Hold_Time.

table.name: Misfire - Inhibit Time after Engine Start (Long) (new)
table.description: Minimum value of the 1 s inhibit timer loaded at engine start (1 s timer). Read by EngineState_Machine. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_0192_Misfire_Inhibit_Time_after_Engine_Start_Long.

table.name: Fuel System Monitor - Evaluation Time (new)
table.description: Duration of the fuel system evaluation (1 s timer). Read by FuelSystem_Monitor_PerBank. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_0194_Fuel_System_Monitor_Evaluation_Time.

table.name: Fuel System Monitor - Lean Count Limit (new)
table.description: Number of lean samples above which the fuel system fault is set. Read by FuelSystem_Monitor_PerBank. IDA name: CAL_0196_Fuel_System_Monitor_Lean_Count_Limit.

table.name: Fuel System Monitor - Rich Count Limit (new)
table.description: Number of rich samples above which the fuel system fault is set. Read by FuelSystem_Monitor_PerBank. IDA name: CAL_0198_Fuel_System_Monitor_Rich_Count_Limit.

table.name: Rear O2 Heater - Energy Counter Init (new)
table.category: ID60 - Post-Cat Trim / Rear O2 Sensors (new)
table.description: Initial value of the heater energy counter. Read by O2Heater_PostCat_Control_Diag. IDA name: CAL_019A_Rear_O2_Heater_Energy_Counter_Init.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Period Count Low (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Lower limit of the period counter to run the pre-catalyst efficiency evaluation. Read by O2Cat_Monitor_PeriodWindow. IDA name: CAL_019E_Catalyst_Monitor_Period_Count_Low.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Period Count High (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Upper limit of the period counter to run the pre-catalyst efficiency evaluation. Read by O2Cat_Monitor_PeriodWindow. IDA name: CAL_01A6_Catalyst_Monitor_Period_Count_High.

table.name: Engine State - Start Phase Time (new)
table.description: 100 ms timer loaded at start. Read by EngineState_Machine. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_01A8_Engine_State_Start_Phase_Time.

table.name: EVAP Tank Vent Test - Init Value F5C8 (new)
table.description: Initial value of EVAP_Var_FB0E. Read by EVAP_TankVentValveFunction_A. IDA name: CAL_01B4_EVAP_Tank_Vent_Test_Init_Value_F5C8.

table.name: Purge Adaptation - Learning Rate Fast (new)
table.description: Learning step used when the adaptation is far from neutral. Read by AdaptiveCorrection_Learn. IDA name: CAL_01C0_Purge_Adaptation_Learning_Rate_Fast.

table.name: Purge Adaptation - Learning Rate Slow (new)
table.description: Learning step used near neutral. Read by AdaptiveCorrection_Learn. IDA name: CAL_01C2_Purge_Adaptation_Learning_Rate_Slow.

table.name: Exhaust Temp. Model - Init Value F5A0 (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Exhaust / Catalyst Temperature Model (new)
table.description: Initial value of word_FAE6 at start. Read by LoadSnapshot_And_SecondaryTargets. IDA name: CAL_01C4_Exhaust_Temp_Model_Init_Value_F5A0.

table.name: Secondary Air Monitor - Start Delay (new)
table.description: Delay before the monitoring starts after the pump is switched on (20 ms task count). Read by SecondaryAir_Monitor_PerBank, SecondaryAir_Start_Init. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_01C6_Secondary_Air_Monitor_Start_Delay.

table.name: Secondary Air - Sequence A Time (new)
table.description: Time of sequence step A (100 ms timer). Read by SecondaryAir_Pump_Control, SoftTimerB_Cb12_SecondaryAir_SeqA. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_01C8_Secondary_Air_Sequence_A_Time.

table.name: EVAP Leak Test - Abort Pause Time (new)
table.description: 100 ms timer; time before a new test after an abort. Read by EVAP_LeakDiag_Abort. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_01CC_EVAP_Leak_Test_Abort_Pause_Time.

table.name: O2 Sensor Switching (P1178/P1179) - Max Period Count (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Maximum period counter of the front O2 switching check. Read by O2Sensor_Switching_PreCat_P1178_P1179. IDA name: CAL_01CE_O2_Sensor_Switching_P1178_P1179_Max_Period_Count.

table.name: O2 Sensor Slow Response - Min Switch Count (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Number of front O2 switches required before the slow response result is evaluated. Read by O2Sensor_SlowResponse_Monitor. IDA name: CAL_01D0_O2_Sensor_Slow_Response_Min_Switch_Count.

table.name: EVAP Tank Pressure Sensor (P0451) - High Limit (new)
table.description: Filtered tank pressure sensor signal above which the sensor is out of range high. Read by EVAP_TankPressureSensor_Diag_P0451. Unit: V. IDA name: CAL_01D2_EVAP_Tank_Pressure_Sensor_P0451_High_Limit.

table.name: EVAP Tank Pressure Sensor (P0451) - Low Limit (new)
table.description: Filtered tank pressure sensor signal below which the sensor is out of range low. Read by EVAP_TankPressureSensor_Diag_P0451. Unit: V. IDA name: CAL_01D4_EVAP_Tank_Pressure_Sensor_P0451_Low_Limit.

table.name: EVAP Shutoff Valve (P0446) - Pressure Limit (new)
table.description: Pressure value at or below which the stuck-shut fault is detected (also its reset value). Read by EVAP_ShutoffValveStuckShut_P0446, LoadSnapshot_And_SecondaryTargets. IDA name: CAL_01D6_EVAP_Shutoff_Valve_P0446_Pressure_Limit. Compared with the tank pressure sensor voltage (ADC 10 bits, 5 V = 1024).

table.name: EVAP Purge - Duty Ramp Down Step (new)
table.description: Purge duty ramp-down step (x1/16). Read by EVAP_PurgeFlow_Dispatcher. IDA name: CAL_0206_EVAP_Purge_Duty_Ramp_Down_Step. Step per pass of the purge level (16 steps = 1 unit of the 0-255 purge level).

table.name: EVAP Purge - Duty Ramp Up Step (new)
table.description: Purge duty ramp-up step (x1/16). Read by EVAP_TankVentValveFunction_B. IDA name: CAL_0207_EVAP_Purge_Duty_Ramp_Up_Step. Step per pass of the purge level (16 steps = 1 unit of the 0-255 purge level).

table.name: OBD - Driving Cycles for DTC Bitmap Update (new)

table.description: 100 ms timer. Read by EVAP_LeakDiag_Step. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_0369_EVAP_Leak_Test_Step_Time.

table.name: Speed Window - Max Vehicle Speed (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Upper limit of the vehicle speed window; inside the window LambdaB*_Fld3F.5 is cleared (monitor enable). Read by RevLimiter_VSS_StateMachine. Unit: km/h. IDA name: CAL_036C_Speed_Window_Max_Vehicle_Speed.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Max Vehicle Speed (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Maximum vehicle speed for the catalyst monitor period window (0 = condition never met). Read by O2Cat_Monitor_PeriodWindow. Unit: km/h. IDA name: CAL_0371_Catalyst_Monitor_Max_Vehicle_Speed.

table.name: Speed Window - Min Vehicle Speed (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Lower limit of the vehicle speed window. Read by RevLimiter_VSS_StateMachine. Unit: km/h. IDA name: CAL_0373_Speed_Window_Min_Vehicle_Speed.

table.name: Speed Band - Time Base Divisor (new)
table.description: Divisor of the vehicle speed time base (word_FAD2). Read by RevLimiter_VSS_StateMachine. IDA name: CAL_0374_Speed_Band_Time_Base_Divisor.

table.name: EVAP Valve Stuck Open (P0440) - Test Time (new)
table.description: 100 ms timer; also divisor of the small leak gradient. Read by EVAP_Test_Step_SmallLeak_P0442, EVAP_ValveStuckOpen_P0440_A. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_0378_EVAP_Valve_Stuck_Open_P0440_Test_Time.

table.name: EVAP Leak Test - Step B Time (new)
table.description: 100 ms timer; also multiplier of the small leak gradient. Read by EVAP_Test_Step_B, EVAP_Test_Step_SmallLeak_P0442. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_0379_EVAP_Leak_Test_Step_B_Time.

table.name: EVAP Leak Test - Stabilisation Time (new)
table.description: 100 ms timer. Read by EVAP_Test_Step_MinMaxTrack. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_037A_EVAP_Leak_Test_Stabilisation_Time.

table.name: EVAP Diag - K-line Forced Test Time (new)
table.description: Duration of the test started by K-line command 0x22 (100 ms timer). Read by KLine_Cmd22_Misc. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_0381_EVAP_Diag_K_line_Forced_Test_Time.

table.name: Engine State - Lambda Fld74 Window Low (new)
table.description: Lower limit (0 = disabled). Read by EngineState_Machine. IDA name: CAL_0386_Engine_State_Lambda_Fld74_Window_Low.

table.name: EVAP Leak Test - Pressure Build-up Time (new)
table.description: 100 ms timer. Read by EVAP_LeakDiag_Step. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_0387_EVAP_Leak_Test_Pressure_Build_up_Time.

table.name: Engine State - Lambda Fld74 Window High (new)
table.description: Upper limit (0 = disabled). Read by EngineState_Machine. IDA name: CAL_038D_Engine_State_Lambda_Fld74_Window_High.

table.name: Catalyst Temp. Model - Max ECT at Start for Init (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Exhaust / Catalyst Temperature Model (new)

table.name: Max ECT at Start for Init
table.data: Max ECT at Start for Init

table.description: Below this coolant temperature at start, the catalyst temperature model is initialised from the coolant temperature at start; otherwise it is initialised with this value. Read by LoadSnapshot_And_SecondaryTargets. Unit: °C. IDA name: CAL_0391_Catalyst_Temp_Model_Max_ECT_at_Start_for_Init.

table.name: EVAP Tank Vent Test - Init Value F5C6 (new)
table.description: Initial value of EVAP_Var_FB0C. Read by EVAP_TankVentValveFunction_A. IDA name: CAL_0392_EVAP_Tank_Vent_Test_Init_Value_F5C6.

table.name: EVAP Tank Vent Test B - Time (new)
table.description: 100 ms timer. Read by EVAP_TankVentValveFunction_B. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_0393_EVAP_Tank_Vent_Test_B_Time.

table.name: EVAP Tank Vent Test A - Time (new)
table.description: 100 ms timer. Read by EVAP_TankVentValveFunction_A. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_0394_EVAP_Tank_Vent_Test_A_Time.

table.name: ECT Plausibility - Sample Count (new)
table.description: Number of samples before the plausibility decision. Read by CoolantTemp_ECT_PlausibilityCheck. IDA name: CAL_0395_ECT_Plausibility_Sample_Count.

table.name: ECT Plausibility - Enable (new)
table.description: 0 = plausibility flag not set by this check. Read by CoolantTemp_ECT_PlausibilityCheck. IDA name: CAL_0396_ECT_Plausibility_Enable.

table.name: ECT Plausibility - Confirmation Count (new)
table.description: Number of confirmations before the result is final. Read by CoolantTemp_ECT_PlausibilityCheck. IDA name: CAL_0397_ECT_Plausibility_Confirmation_Count.

table.name: EVAP Diag - Pause Time between Steps (new)
table.description: 100 ms timer. Read by AdaptiveCorrection_Learn, EVAP_TankVentValveFunction_A, EVAP_TankVentValveFunction_B. Unit: s. IDA name: CAL_0399_EVAP_Diag_Pause_Time_between_Steps.

table.name: O2 Sensor - Ready Delay (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Countdown loaded at start / reset before the O2 sensor is considered ready. Read by BackgroundTask_Scheduler, LoadSnapshot_And_SecondaryTargets, MasterSystemState_Reset, O2Cat_Monitor_EnableConditions. IDA name: CAL_039B_O2_Sensor_Ready_Delay.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Rear O2 Rich Threshold (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Rear O2 sensor signal below which the sensor is considered rich (switch counter); the O2 signal is inverted by the input stage (rich = low value). Read by Catalyst_Monitor_SwitchStateMachine and O2Cat_Monitor_PerBank_Main. Unit: V at the CPU input (x*5/256). IDA name: CAL_03A4_Catalyst_Monitor_Rear_O2_Rich_Threshold.

table.name: O2 Sensor Switching (P1178/P1179) - Hysteresis (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Voltage hysteresis added to the switching threshold. Read by O2Sensor_Switching_PreCat_P1178_P1179. Unit: V. IDA name: CAL_03A6_O2_Sensor_Switching_P1178_P1179_Hysteresis.

table.name: Rear O2 Sensor Circuit - High Voltage Limit (new)
table.category: ID60 - Post-Cat Trim / Rear O2 Sensors (new)
table.description: Rear O2 sensor voltage above which the circuit high fault is detected. Read by O2Sensor_PostCat_Circuit_Diag. Unit: V. IDA name: CAL_03AA_Rear_O2_Sensor_Circuit_High_Voltage_Limit.

table.name: Rear O2 Sensor Circuit - Low Voltage Limit (new)
table.category: ID60 - Post-Cat Trim / Rear O2 Sensors (new)
table.description: Rear O2 sensor voltage below which the circuit low test is done. Read by O2Sensor_PostCat_Circuit_Diag. Unit: V. IDA name: CAL_03AB_Rear_O2_Sensor_Circuit_Low_Voltage_Limit.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Rear O2 Lean Threshold (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Rear O2 sensor signal above which the sensor is considered lean (switch counter); the O2 signal is inverted by the input stage (lean = high value). Read by Catalyst_Monitor_SwitchStateMachine and O2Cat_Monitor_PerBank_Main. IDA name: CAL_03AC_Catalyst_Monitor_Rear_O2_Lean_Threshold.

table.name: Rear O2 Heater - Voltage Reference (new)
table.category: ID60 - Post-Cat Trim / Rear O2 Sensors (new)
table.description: Reference voltage; (reference - sensor voltage)/2 is the input of O2 Heater Post-Cat Duty vs Delta. Read by O2Heater_PostCat_Control_Diag. Unit: V. IDA name: CAL_03B2_Rear_O2_Heater_Voltage_Reference.

table.name: Rear O2 Heater Monitor - Max Sensor Voltage (new)
table.category: ID60 - Post-Cat Trim / Rear O2 Sensors (new)
table.description: Sensor voltage must be below this value to run the heater check. Read by O2Cat_Monitor_EnableConditions. Unit: V. IDA name: CAL_03B3_Rear_O2_Heater_Monitor_Max_Sensor_Voltage.

table.name: Rear O2 Heater Monitor - Min Sensor Voltage (new)
table.category: ID60 - Post-Cat Trim / Rear O2 Sensors (new)
table.description: Sensor voltage must be above this value to run the heater check. Read by O2Cat_Monitor_EnableConditions. Unit: V. IDA name: CAL_03B4_Rear_O2_Heater_Monitor_Min_Sensor_Voltage.

table.name: Catalyst Efficiency (225/226) - Index High Limit (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Catalyst efficiency index above which fault 225 is reported (0 = disabled). Read by CatalystEfficiency_Diag_225_226. IDA name: CAL_03B6_Catalyst_Efficiency_225_226_Index_High_Limit.

table.name: Catalyst Efficiency (225/226) - Index Low Limit (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Catalyst efficiency index below which fault 226 is reported (0 = disabled). Read by CatalystEfficiency_Diag_225_226. IDA name: CAL_03B7_Catalyst_Efficiency_225_226_Index_Low_Limit.

table.name: Ignition Timing Ramp - Rate (new)
table.description: Ignition timing decrease threshold: when the previous ramped timing (IgnTiming_Ramped) exceeds the new idle-corrected timing by more than this value, the misfire inhibit counter byte_F504 is raised to Ignition Timing Ramp Misfire Inhibit Count (CAL_03CD). Read by IgnTiming_Ramp_And_TorqueModel. Unit: °CRK. IDA name: CAL_03C2_Ignition_Timing_Ramp_Rate.

table.name: Ignition Timing Ramp - Misfire Inhibit Count (new)
table.description: Minimum value loaded into the misfire inhibit counter when the timing jump is large. Read by IgnTiming_Ramp_And_TorqueModel. IDA name: CAL_03CD_Ignition_Timing_Ramp_Misfire_Inhibit_Count.

table.name: Misfire - Catalyst Damage Low Zone Min. Ignitions (new)
table.description: Minimum number of ignitions, out of the 600 of a 200-revolution window, that must lie in the low speed/load zone ('Misfire - Catalyst Damage Low Zone Max. RPM (new)' / 'Max. Load (new)') when the window exceeds 'Misfire - Window Sum Threshold (Cylinder Cut) (new)'; above it the catalyst damage counter is increased step by step (+1 plus an exhaust temperature term), below it the counter is set to 3 and the catalyst-damaging misfire is confirmed at once. Read by Misfire_Monitor_CountAndCylCut.

table.name: Misfire - Catalyst Damage Low Zone Max. RPM (new)
table.description: Engine speed up to which an ignition is counted as being in the low speed/load zone (together with 'Misfire - Catalyst Damage Low Zone Max. Load (new)'); the count over 200 revolutions is compared with 'Misfire - Catalyst Damage Low Zone Min. Ignitions (new)'. Read by Misfire_Monitor_CountAndCylCut.

table.name: Misfire - Catalyst Damage Low Zone Max. Load (new)
table.description: Load up to which an ignition is counted as being in the low speed/load zone (together with 'Misfire - Catalyst Damage Low Zone Max. RPM (new)'). Read by Misfire_Monitor_CountAndCylCut.

table.name: Misfire - Total Events Threshold (First Window) (new)
table.description: Total misfire events (all cylinders) of the 1000-revolution window above which the worst cylinder is searched and the emission misfire evaluation is done, used for the first window after start (Misfire_StatusFlags.13 clear); afterwards 'Misfire - Total Events Threshold (Cylinder Cut) (new)' is used. Read by Misfire_Monitor_CountAndCylCut.

table.name: Post-Cat Trim - Max. Catalyst Monitor Result (new)
table.category: ID60 - Post-Cat Trim / Rear O2 Sensors (new)
table.description: The post-cat trim of a bank is blocked (and returned to its stored value) while the catalyst monitor result of that bank (same value as compared with 'Catalyst Monitor - Ratio Limit (Mode 06) (new)') is at or above this value. Read by Lambda_PostCat_Trim_Conditions.

table.name: Post-Cat Trim - Min. Purge Correction (new)
table.category: ID60 - Post-Cat Trim / Rear O2 Sensors (new)
table.description: The post-cat trim is only enabled while the canister purge mixture correction (AdaptiveCorrection_NeutralValue1, 0 % = no purge correction) is above this value. Read by Lambda_PostCat_Trim_Conditions.

table.name: Post-Cat Trim - Min. Exhaust Temp. Model (new)
table.category: ID60 - Post-Cat Trim / Rear O2 Sensors (new)
table.description: The post-cat trim is only enabled while the exhaust temperature model is above this value. Read by Lambda_PostCat_Trim_Conditions.

table.name: Post-Cat Trim - Max. Load (vs RPM) (new)
table.category: ID60 - Post-Cat Trim / Rear O2 Sensors (new)
table.description: The post-cat trim is only enabled while the engine load is below this value (0 = trim disabled at that speed), as a function of engine speed. Read by Lambda_PostCat_Trim_Conditions.

table.name: Post-Cat Trim - Min. Load (vs RPM) (new)
table.category: ID60 - Post-Cat Trim / Rear O2 Sensors (new)
table.description: The post-cat trim is only enabled while the engine load is above this value (65535 = trim disabled at that speed), as a function of engine speed. Read by Lambda_PostCat_Trim_Conditions.

table.name: Post-Cat Trim - Min. Air Mass (Total) (new)
table.category: ID60 - Post-Cat Trim / Rear O2 Sensors (new)
table.description: Air mass that must have flowed in closed loop (outside the rich bias mode) before the post-cat trim is enabled; integrated every 100 ms from the mean air flow. Read by Lambda_PostCat_Trim_Conditions.

table.name: Post-Cat Trim - Min. Air Mass (Phase) (new)
table.category: ID60 - Post-Cat Trim / Rear O2 Sensors (new)
table.description: Air mass that must have flowed since the per-bank monitor phase flag ([r9+56h] bit 1) was set before the post-cat trim is enabled (sets FD10.8); integrated every 100 ms from the mean air flow. Read by Lambda_PostCat_Trim_Conditions.

table.name: Post-Cat Trim - Evaluation Period (new)
table.category: ID60 - Post-Cat Trim / Rear O2 Sensors (new)
table.description: Number of 1-second periods with the trim enabled after which a trim step is made; the step is read from 'Post-Cat Trim - Step (vs Periods above Rear O2 Threshold) (new)' with the number of those periods whose mean rear O2 signal was above 'Catalyst Monitor - Rear O2 Lean Threshold (new)', then the counters restart. Read by Lambda_PostCat_Trim_Update.

table.name: Post-Cat Trim - Step (vs Periods above Rear O2 Threshold) (new)
table.category: ID60 - Post-Cat Trim / Rear O2 Sensors (new)
table.description: Change of the post-cat trim (P-jump delay after the front O2 switch, 20 ms steps) made at the end of each evaluation period, as a function of the number of 1-second periods whose mean rear O2 signal was above 'Catalyst Monitor - Rear O2 Lean Threshold (new)'; stored with an offset of 32768 (32768 = no change). Read by Lambda_PostCat_Trim_Update.

table.name: Post-Cat Trim - Max. Value (new)
table.category: ID60 - Post-Cat Trim / Rear O2 Sensors (new)
table.description: Upper limit of the post-cat trim, i.e. of the delay of the lambda P-jump after the front O2 switch (20 ms steps); also the limit of the value restored from and saved to EEPROM, and the rear O2 activity test (P0140/P0160) fails if the rear sensor never crosses 'Catalyst Monitor - Rear O2 Rich Threshold (new)' with the trim at this limit. Read by Lambda_PostCat_Trim_Update, Lambda_RestoreOnBoot, Lambda_SaveWindows_ToEEPROM, O2Cat_Monitor_PerBank_Main.

table.name: Post-Cat Trim - Min. Steps for Rear O2 Activity Test (new)
table.category: ID60 - Post-Cat Trim / Rear O2 Sensors (new)

table.name: Min. Steps for Rear O2 Activity Test
table.data: Min. Steps for Rear O2 Activity Test

table.description: Number of post-cat trim steps that must have been made before the rear O2 activity test (P0140/P0160) may fail with the trim at 'Post-Cat Trim - Max. Value (new)'. Read by Lambda_PostCat_Trim_Update, O2Cat_Monitor_PerBank_Main.

table.name: Post-Cat Trim - EEPROM Transfer Weight (new)
table.category: ID60 - Post-Cat Trim / Rear O2 Sensors (new)
table.description: Share of the post-cat trim learnt during the trip (difference between current and stored value) added to the stored value when it is written to EEPROM at power-down; 65535 = the current value is stored as is. Read by Lambda_SaveWindows_ToEEPROM.

table.name: Rear O2 Sensor - Activity Test Enable (P0140/P0160) (new)
table.category: ID60 - Post-Cat Trim / Rear O2 Sensors (new)
table.description: 1 = rear O2 sensor activity test (P0140 bank 1, P0160 bank 2) active, and a failed test also blocks the post-cat trim of the bank; other value = test not run, its readiness/support bits are cleared and the fault no longer blocks the trim. Read by O2Cat_Monitor_PerBank_Main, Lambda_PostCat_Trim_Conditions, OBD_FlagBitmap_F5F2_Build, OBD_FlagBitmap_F60A_Build, OBD_FlagBitmap_F616_Build.

table.name: Post-Cat Trim - Delay Factor (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.category: ID60 - Post-Cat Trim / Rear O2 Sensors (new)
table.description: Factor applied to the post-cat trim to give the delay of the lambda P-jump after the front O2 switch, as a function of engine speed and load; 65535 = trim used unchanged. Read by Lambda_DirectionCheck.

table.name: Rear O2 Activity Test - Max. Overrun Air Mass (new)
table.category: ID60 - Post-Cat Trim / Rear O2 Sensors (new)
table.description: Rear O2 sensor activity test (P0140/P0160): if the rear O2 signal has not risen above 'Catalyst Monitor - Rear O2 Lean Threshold (new)' once this air mass has passed during the current overrun fuel cut, the test fails. Read by O2Cat_Monitor_PerBank_Main.

table.name: Lambda Rich Bias - Min. Overrun Air Mass (new)
table.category: ID60 - Lambda Rich Bias after Overrun / Secondary Air (new)
table.description: The lambda rich bias after an overrun fuel cut is only started if the air mass that passed during the cut is above this value. Read by Lambda_AfterOverrun_ModeStart.

table.name: Lambda Rich Bias - Min. ECT (new)
table.category: ID60 - Lambda Rich Bias after Overrun / Secondary Air (new)
table.description: The lambda rich bias after an overrun fuel cut is only started above this coolant temperature. Read by Lambda_AfterOverrun_ModeStart.

table.name: Lambda Rich Bias - Min. Overrun Duration (new)
table.category: ID60 - Lambda Rich Bias after Overrun / Secondary Air (new)
table.description: Minimum duration of the overrun fuel cut for the lambda rich bias to be started when injection resumes: soft timer B31 (100 ms) armed at the start of the cut, its expiry sets O2Cat_Var_DBCE.0. Read by EngineState_Machine.

table.name: Lambda Rich Bias - Air Mass (vs Overrun Air Mass) (new)
table.category: ID60 - Lambda Rich Bias after Overrun / Secondary Air (new)
table.description: Air mass that must pass after the end of an overrun fuel cut before the lambda rich bias ends, as a function of the air mass that passed during the cut. Read by Lambda_AfterOverrun_ModeStart.

table.name: Lambda Rich Bias - Rear O2 End Threshold (new)
table.category: ID60 - Lambda Rich Bias after Overrun / Secondary Air (new)
table.description: The lambda rich bias (after overrun or after secondary air) ends as soon as the rear O2 signal of the bank is below this value with the rear sensor ready. Read by Lambda_ClosedLoop_Update.

table.name: Lambda Rich Bias - Duration after Secondary Air (new)
table.category: ID60 - Lambda Rich Bias after Overrun / Secondary Air (new)
table.description: Duration of the lambda rich bias after the secondary air phase (requested at the end of the secondary air sequence, started at the next front O2 switch): soft timers C16/C17 (1 s) of bank 1/2, whose expiry ends the bias. Read by SoftTimerB_Cb12_SecondaryAir_SeqA.

table.name: Lambda Rich Bias - Additional Delay (vs Air Flow) (new)
table.category: ID60 - Lambda Rich Bias after Overrun / Secondary Air (new)
table.description: Delay added to the post-cat trim delay of the lambda P-jump after the front O2 switch while the lambda rich bias (after overrun or secondary air) is active, as a function of air flow. Read by Lambda_DirectionCheck.

table.name: Lambda Rich Bias - Enrichment during Delay (vs RPM/Load) (new)
table.category: ID60 - Lambda Rich Bias after Overrun / Secondary Air (new)
table.description: Fuel enrichment added to the lambda fuel factor while the delay of the P-jump after the front O2 switch is running and the lambda rich bias (after overrun or secondary air) is active, as a function of engine speed and load. Read by Lambda_ClosedLoop_Update.

table.name: Misfire - Catalyst Damage Counter Step (vs Exhaust Temp. Model) (new)
table.description: Increment added, at the end of each 200-revolution window whose misfire rate exceeds the catalyst-damage limit, to the catalyst-damage misfire counter (byte_F674, limited to 3), as a function of the exhaust temperature model (word_DBD2, read without interpolation); the counter is set to 3 directly when 'Misfire - Catalyst Damage Low Zone Min. Ignitions (new)' is reached. Read by Misfire_Monitor_CountAndCylCut.

table.name: Catalyst Monitor - Ratio Weight (vs Post-Cat Trim) (new)
table.category: ID60 OBD - Catalyst / O2 Sensor Monitors (new)
table.description: Weight (1.0 = 256) applied to each catalyst monitor ratio sample before it is added to the accumulated result of the bank, as a function of the current post-cat trim value of the bank (read without interpolation). The sample is the smaller rear/front switching ratio multiplied by 'Catalyst Monitor Ratio Map RPM/Load (new)'. Read by Catalyst_Monitor_RatioCalc.
